options.name: As the monarchy fades into the pages of history, the republic returns to living memory.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Collaborator Counter-Coup in the Netherlands!
desc:
The Dutch Revolution and the internationally perceived hope and optimism which accompanied it were entirely squashed earlier today, as a resurgent force of local Pro-German military groups and remaining Wehrmacht garrisons, under command of Dutch collaborator Joop Glimmerveen, were able to successfully rally together and retake the nation's capital from Provisional Government forces, with revolutionary leaders being executed or imprisoned.

The newly restored collaborationist administration has already begun to quash local resistance, with any coordinated opposition rendered impossible in the wake of the massacre of resistance leaders. Onlookers from across the globe watch in terror as Dutch calls for freedom are silenced, and Germania no doubt breathes a sigh of relief.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Germany Invades the Netherlands
desc:
Like other natively Germanic territories, Reichskommissariat Niederlande has had a very unique relationship with Germany. The Dutch were viewed as Germans in all but name by the Nazis, making for a close relationship with Germany and being all but considered as a core piece of the Reich.

That was emphasized today when German troops crossed the Dutch border. Like the infamous Rotterdam Blitz, the Luftwaffe has begun flying over the country conducting “strategic” bombing campaigns. While the Netherlands have expected and prepared for an invasion, only so much can be done against the Wehrmacht. With no defensive terrain, the Dutch government has been painstakingly attempting to mount a defense, but seldom few international observers expect them to succeed. For many, it is not a question of if the Dutch will surrender, but when.

options.name: Will the Dutch people remain shackled?
They will see the futility in their resistance.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Christian democrats win the Dutch elections
desc:
The first Dutch election in three decades have ended in a rather predictable way, with the newly formed Christelijke Volkspartij under Frans Andriessen securing a majority in parliament. The CVP being a direct descendant of the old Christian Democratic parties that ruled the Netherlands before the German invasion.

In his first speech as Prime Minister of the Netherlands, Andriessen vowed to restore the Dutch way of life that the Germans had tried so hard to eradicate. He also stressed the need to join the OFN quickly in order to protect the nation.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Progressives win the Dutch elections
desc: The newly proclaimed Dutch Republic has held its first elections, with Bastiaan Fortman's Progressive Partij securing a majority. After years of occupation by the far right, the swing to the moderate left was widely expected by most observers. Speaking to a crowd in Amsterdam, Fortman proclaimed that they could now begin to rebuild a nation that would be equally free and fair, and promised to quickly join the OFN to secure the freedom and independence of the Dutch Republic.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The populists win the Dutch election
desc:
In a shocking result, the populist Veiligheid Voor Democratie party led by Hans Janmaat has won the Dutch election. Initially predicted to be an outsider, Janmaat's unorthodox policies have apparently proved popular.

Promising that the Netherlands would never again be a victim of occupation, de VVD has proposed to follow the example of Swiss neutrality by heavily fortifying the Dutch borders and building up the military. In his opening speech, Janmaat vowed that the nation would never again serve the Germans, nor would it become an American puppet. With open trade and closed borders, [FROM.GetNameDef] openes a new chapter in its history.

options.name: Dutch neutrality has returned in force

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Operation Red Dawn
desc:
Decades after the West Russian War, the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics has announced the invasion of Europe to the world under the careful guidance of Grand Marshal Georgy Zhukov. Codenamed Operation Red Dawn, the battle-hardened Red Army has crossed the vast borders of Moskowien, prepared to battle the Wehrmacht one final time.

In the city of [WRS.capital.GetName], Marshal Zhukov made a ferocious speech, calling upon all able-bodied Soviet men and women to join the fight against the German tyrants and liberate their sacred Motherland from fascist oppression. The German government has begun to mobilize against their old enemy, with the Führer, [GER.GetLeader], promising that the Soviet rebellion will be dealt with swiftly and mercilessly. The world watches on, holding its breath as the greatest rivals in all of human history battle it out for the future of Europe.

options.name: Their land, their people, their blood.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Second Great Patriotic War
desc:
The world is in utter shock this morning, as Grand Marshal Tukhachevsky of the recently-reborn Union of Soviet Socialist Republics has announced the beginning of hostilities against the German Reich. Border garrisons have been slaughtered, and German colonists are fleeing in mass towards the Reich proper. But even this may not save them, as apparent biological and chemical attacks have struck the Reich, killing thousands and severely disrupting supply lines.

The Führer is reportedly outraged and has instructed the Heer to slay 'ten Russians for every innocent German.' The OFN, too, has publicly condemned the attacks, though support for the USSR does not seem likely to slow. The unprepared Wehrmacht may stand no chance in the face of the Grand Marshal's vengeance, and international observers worry Tukhachevsky's campaign may inaugurate an attempt at worldwide revolution.

options.name: The dark specter comes for Europe.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Russian Republic Declares War on Germany!
desc:
Democracy in Russia has met its first great test as Alexander Yakolev, leader of the free Russian Republic, has officially declared war on the German Reich following a heartfelt speech in Syktyvkar. While many doubted true democracy would ever return to Russia in full, the Republic of Komi rose above the ashes and managed to unite the shattered Russian lands. Now, they face their greatest threat yet, seeking to push the 'fascist menace' out of Eastern Europe and liberate the oppressed peoples under German tyranny.

The Führer has denounced the invasion as 'another Judeo-Bolshevik plot to destroy the Aryan race' while international observers praise the Russian state's efforts in creating a legitimately democratic Russia. Whatever the case, it is clear that true democracy in Russia has reached its final test. Whether it shall overcome the odds and live up to its ideals remains to be seen.

options.name: Their foolish hopes shall lie shattered under the Wehrmacht.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Russian Republic Declares War on Germany!
desc:
Democracy in Russia has met its first great test as Konstantin Katushev, leader of the free Russian Republic, has officially declared war on the German Reich following a heartfelt speech in Syktyvkar. While many doubted true democracy would ever return to Russia in full, the Republic of Komi rose above the ashes and managed to unite the shattered Russian lands. Now, they face their greatest threat yet, seeking to push the 'fascist menace' out of Eastern Europe and liberate the oppressed peoples under German tyranny.

The Führer has denounced the invasion as 'another Judeo-Bolshevik plot to destroy the Aryan race' while international observers praise the Russian state's efforts in creating a legitimately democratic Russia. Whatever the case, it is clear that true democracy in Russia has reached its final test. Whether it shall overcome the odds and live up to its ideals remains to be seen.

options.name: Russia fights for freedom once more!

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Operation Sovereignty
desc:
In the flurry of events following the unification of Russia and the conquest of bordering lands, Svetlana Stalina's government has decided to declare war on the German Reich. The announcement was made to the Russian people over radio, with Stalina's government hijacking every radio nationwide to spread the declaration far and wide.

With the army already on its way, Stalina has called upon Russians to resist and fight back as the time for righteous rebellion has finally come, the government on its behalf, considering that Nazi governance over West Russia is a 'form of foreign meddling in the reconstruction's plans' has said that the undergoing military operations are part the de-radicalization process that will allow democratic rule to prosper in the future.

Germany on its behalf has indicated that the Heer will strive to advance to the A-A line and that the Russians will know the seamless power of a renewed Reich.

options.name: She will be forgotten like her father was.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Lady of Steel Turns West
desc: After a long period of preparation and various announcements of the Free Republic's desire to “restore democratic authority and order” to the occupied zones of Russia, the Russian Republic now finds itself at war with Germany once more. Led by Svetlana Stalina, the government justifies its actions as necessary to secure a peaceful future since what Stalina has called “the inherent radicalism” in the NSDAP will, in the eyes of the Steel Lady, lead the world to another global conflict if not stopped promptly. Germany has responded to the emergence of hostilities, indicating that Russia will not be a tough match and that the Heer will be in Syktyvkar in less than eight weeks. As rifles crackle and tanks hum over the fields of Moskowien, it seems that the last gambit for Europe's destiny is being played out; the free world can only hope for a desirable outcome.

options.name: The Steel Lady must be crushed!

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Soviet Federation Strikes the Einheitspakt!
desc:
Russia is once again marching westwards; not for Russia alone, but for the great, progressive superculture that has sprung up in the Garden of Marxism. A high-bandwidth radio message has beamed out to the world, declaring war against the 'reactionary anti-humanists' of the Third Reich and announcing the Federation's intention to spread its superculture across Eastern Europe.

The Führer has denounced the Federation as 'Slavic barbarians' and promises to defend the German people from the 'new manifestation of international Judeo-Bolshevik thought.' While some international observers describe the Federation as 'no better than the Bukharin regime,' the OFN seems poised to back the Federation in the latest example of Cold War realpolitik. As the Federation's soldiers march forward, so does the tide of progress. Whether humanity is prepared to swim the undertow remains to be seen.

options.name: “Nothing will stop us. The road to the stars is steep and dangerous, but we are not afraid!”.
Their technology will not be their salvation.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The March of the Workers
desc:
The world lies in shock once more as Svetlana Bukharina has officially declared the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics to be in a formal state of war with the German Reich. Although Russia exited a brutal two decades of warlordism less than five years ago, Bukharina holds the belief that her nation is ready for an all-out armed conflict with one of the world's superpowers.

Reactions to this declaration throughout the world have been varied. In Germania, the Führer has declared that 'the Untermensch's state will meet the same fate as her father's one did three decades ago,' promising a swift and decisive victory for their populace while the OFN has extended a cautious hand of support towards the Soviets. All biases notwithstanding, however, it seems clear that the future of Europe hinges on the outcome of this conflict.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The King's Gambit
desc:
All eyes are on the Union's Western theater as the final act in the long-running play of Eastern Europe reaches its endgame. Mikhail Suslov, Premier of the recently reunified Soviet Union, has formally declared war on Germany, citing border clashes and aggression as justification for what could be the greatest calamity the world sees this decade.

Though the puppetmaster may prefer skulking in the shadows, this war will be decided first and foremost by brute bludgeons and crude industry. Nevertheless, Suslov's particular skillsets have already asserted themselves across the Eastern theater, as several high-ranking German bureaucrats and officers have passed away from plutonium poisoning. The Russian people can only hope the chess master has properly calculated his position, for the fate of Russia and Marxism hangs in the balance.

options.name: The greatest gambit in human history.
The hardest game to win is a won game.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Great Eurasian War!
desc:
The drums of war sound once again from the shattered lands of Russia. Lev Gumilyov, Vozhd of the Eurasian State, has announced the beginning of Eurasia's first great test: the war against the German Reich.

Thousands of armored vehicles stream across the Moskowien frontier as German troops frantically attempt to resist the Eurasian onslaught. Buryats, Kalmyks, and Kazakhs fight side by side with Russians, indiscriminately massacring German settlers as they ride.

International observers are hesitant to support the Russian dark horse in its efforts to build a 'super-ethnic state,' while others openly support Gumilyov's efforts to crush the German Reich. The Eurasian State must prove itself in the fires of war or submit to the superior ethnos.

options.name: The binding of the continents approaches.
Two for the price of one.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Republic at War
desc:
Igor Shafarevich's Russian Republic has declared war on the Third Reich, citing genocide, colonialism, and Russophobia as their casus belli. Nearly two weeks ago, the President appeared on national television and radio across the Republic and offered a heartfelt plea for the Russian folk to support efforts to reclaim their territory and enslaved kin to the West. The Russian public voted in favor of the war following a brief plebiscite, enabling President Shafarevich to use his executive power to unilaterally order the Russian Armed Forces to engage with the OKW.

Soldiers driving American tanks and wielding Japanese-manufacturing rifles are moving into Moskowien, orderly, disciplined, and driven, as always. This war will not be an apocalyptic affair but a sanitized, cold-blooded struggle for national supremacy.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Clash of the Titans
desc:
The Chairman of the Russian National Soviet Republic, Ivan Serov, has declared the beginning of the Second West Russian War. Columns of tanks and rows of infantry have stormed Reichkomissariat Moskowien under the banner of the Ordosocialist state with only one goal in mind - the return of all former Soviet territories, with Serov's move away from traditional Bolshevism being a central part of this aim.

Chairman Serov has promised to the world that imperialism will be struck down by the power of Ordosocialism, with their first enemy being the evil empire that has terrorized the Russians for decades. On the other hand, a statement was issued from Germany declaring the new Russian state to be 'a gross perversion of National Socialism' and that the Wehrmacht would be across the Urals in less than two months.

options.name: The great test of Ordosocialism begins.
National Socialism will not be perverted in this way!

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The People's Tsar Marches for Liberation!
desc:
News floods the world's information networks: the Russian Empire has declared war upon Germany. Many expected this outcome after the ambitious Romanovs consolidated power in the landscape of warlordism and established a constitutional monarchy system. The Imperial Forces march with a reforged Russian spirit and formations crashing with songs praising their beloved Tsar.

While the forces of the Heer and Luftwaffe deploy to Moskowien to face off against Russian troops for the third time in thirty years, an engine of propaganda has activated, spreading information about Vladimir III's past collaboration with Germany. While the impact of such memetic warfare on the Tsar's forces is unknown, rumors have emerged that this action has had the opposite of the intended effect, as many moderate collaborators within Moskowien now look to join the Tsar's side of the war.

options.name: The Empire is back on its feet; let's see if they're made of porcelain.
For when the dust settles, the Tsar's compassion will fuel the fire of liberation.
This world has no more room for Romanovs.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The War of Imperial Restoration Begins
desc:
In 1918, Tsar Nicholas II and his family met their end at the hands of the Bolsheviks in the Ipatiev House. The Romanovs were considered a dynasty dead for good, and monarchism within Russia was considered gone with it. Those long-held beliefs have been decisively proven wrong today, however, as the reunified Russian Empire, now under the leadership of Tsar Vladimir Romanov, has promised to restore the Empire to its formal glory, issuing a formal declaration of war to the German Reich for the reclamation of their western territories.

The White Army marches west with eyes focused on the ruined Third Rome as the Germans hastily mobilize their Heer to throw the Russian onslaught back across the Reich's frontier. While some question the true motives of Tsar Vladimir's imperial ambitions, none can question the true scale that this war has wrought upon the peoples of Europe. Is this the resurrection of Russian hegemony or the Romanovs' dying breath?

options.name: Is this the rebirth of the Third Rome?
For the glory of the Tsar!
We showed them once, and now we must show them again.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Reliving 1914
desc:
The titan that was the Russian Empire - thought to be long dead just a decade ago - has been put back together piece by piece by Vladimir III, the last claimant to the Russian throne. Although the true surviving Romanov officially helms the Empire, it has long been suspected that true power in the country resides with the Solidarists within the government - suspicions that were all but confirmed when Alexsandr Solzhenitsyn, not the Tsar, announced the commencement of hostilities with the German Reich.

Germania has released a statement from the OKW in response, promising to "swiftly dismantle the decrepit monarchist corpse" in less than a month. Whilst international observers may disagree on Solzhenitsyn's internal motivations and goals, all agree on one thing - this could be the bloodiest conflict the world has seen since the Second World War.

options.name: A new dawn for imperialism, or a ghost from the past?
The Puppet Tsar will be brought to heel.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The New Bruderkrieg
desc:
It had been months since the Russiky Reykh became an observer of the Unity Pakt. International observers, foreign policy experts, casual newspaper readers, and several schoolchildren predicted that the Germans would use the Reykh as cattle. In only a few months, the Germans have exploited Deytch lands, infiltrated the Reykh's ranks, and redirected what little production remains to vomit cheap consumer goods into Germania, all in the name of racial brotherhood.

The same observers were baffled when Deytsche tanks crossed the border of Moskowien. Bizarre reports claim that Fyuhrer Gutrum Vagner has declared himself the reincarnation of Hitler and has attacked the Reich to 'cleanse its false Aryanism.' Burning villages dot the countryside like stars and masses of refugees have fled adequately into Ostland and Germany. In the end, only one National Socialist vision may prevail.

options.name: A strange kind of tragic irony.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Storm of the North
desc:
When the Neo-Pagan realm of Hyperborea successfully reunited Russia, there had been relative peace on the borders. It initially had seemed like the threats from high priest Velimir were nothing but empty promises. However, on a quiet night, German border patrol was caught off-guard by tanks and trucks covered in runes driving into the Reichskommissariats.

In response, German troops mobilized and set up defenses, and high priest Velimir delivered a speech promising to cleanse the world of the Asiatic Germans and their Zionist overlords and take back their rightful lands. Meanwhile, the Führer rallied the German people to defend their nation from the invaders, promising a quick and total victory over the barbaric lunatics. The world now watches in silence as dark clouds gather above the world's future.

options.name: There can only be one master race!
There can only be one master race!

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Russian Republic Marches to War
desc:
No one could have imagined that an anonymous poet would take the lead of the KONR's fiefdom or that said poet would lead the new Republic into a redemptive war against the Fascists whose weapons and money fed the ROA in the days of old. As tanks, trucks, and infantrymen embark on a crusade west, President Milety Zykov has announced that Russia is officially at war with Germany. Zykov's rhetoric, cloaked as it is in the principles of the Samara declaration, called for total self-determination in Eastern Europe and demanded that all Russians set aside their ideology and politics to support the cause of liberation.

Germany's answer was swift, as always. The Foreign Office has said that the Heer will 'obliterate the Jewish threat and hang every Zionist aggressor in the gallows of Moskau.' But the Army of Liberation has never lost a war, unlike the Wehrmacht.

options.name: The road to freedom isn't without sacrifice.
No matter how many times a snake sheds its skin...

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Leash is Slipped
desc:
The bastard sons of the Nazi conquests in Russia have turned their guns against their old patron. In a modest press announcement, Sergei Bunyachenko, President of the Russian Republic and leader of the Committee for the Liberation of the People's of Russia, has declared that 'the Liberation Committee must live up to its mission' before publicly declaring war on the Reich.

As the ROA's tanks and boots march into Moscow, Russia's vast industry prepares to chew and swallow her enemies. The bloated Kombinats, which form most of Russia's economy, have already declared mandatory overtime and seven-day work weeks as a temporary wartime measure, seeing production temporarily spike. Russia is undoubtedly economically and industrially prepared to retake Moscow. The only question is whether her commanders and soldiers have the honor and resolve to redeem themselves.

options.name: So goes the story of traitors.
In an hour of difficult trials we must decide the fate of our Motherland, our peoples, our personal fate.
An expected course of actions from the traitors.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The War for National Rejuvenation
desc:
Today, Kormichyy Mikhail Oktan and the leadership of the Russian State have officially announced a declaration of war against Germany, citing violations of trade laws, the occupation of 'spiritually Russian land,' and the need to 'put all of eastern Europe's citizens besides Russia's golden lamp.' Ramshackle troop transports, battered tanks, and half-starved soldiers now march into Moskowien in decades-old boots.

The ideal of a united Russia is a noble hope, one that still lights the smothered souls of those who survive in the Jailor King's demesne. Still, few believe that Oktan conducts this war for any national goal. More probable, he has found some way to profit from the war. Even dreams have a price to pay, and the Russian people will bear this nightmare's cost of blood and gold, not their miserly master.

options.name: So, how much does a Russian rifle go for on the black market?

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Great War of Russian Liberation Begins!
desc:
News has emerged from Eastern Europe that has stunned the entire globe. The reunited Russian state under the leadership of Grand Marshal Pavel Batov has declared war on Germany, ordering the Red Army to step forth and liberate their homeland from German tyranny.

In the city of Sverdlovsk, Marshal Pavel Batov stood before a crowd of thousands and made a rousing speech, speaking of the resilience and indomitable will of the Russian People. He then called all Russians across the Motherland to join the fight, serve Russia, and save their people from the oppression of the Reich. Germany has begun mobilizing millions of German men and sending them eastward to face down their old eastern foe. The world braces itself once more as Germany and Russia fight for the destiny of Eastern Europe and the world as we know it.

options.name: A Soviet general will meet his fall once more.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The All Russian Liberation War Begins!
desc:
In a passionate speech, President Boris Yeltsin of the Russian Federative Republic announced a war against Germany. Yeltsin stated that the Republic would use 'any means available' to expel the Germans from rightful Russian lands and make them pay for every day of oppression inflicted upon the Russian people. Marshal Batov reassured the world that no strategic weapons would be used in the first months of the conflict. The diarchy is working in unison to gather support for the cause of self-determination and popular salvation from the institutionalized genocide of Nazi rule.

The Reich has condemned the Russian invasion, calling Yeltsin a 'hawkish buffoon misled by his degenerate vices' and promised to halt Russia's advance immediately. Only time will tell if the savants of the Russian high command will be enough to turn the tides in favor of the Republic.

options.name: The phoenix is finally rising from the ashes.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Kaganovich issues Order No. 227
desc: For years, the Soviet Union, under the influence of the once-fringe Stalinist brand of Soviet Communism, has been rapidly militarizing and industrializing in preparation for the 'Second Great Patriotic War.' The world watched on anxiously, awaiting the seemingly inevitable conflict between the Union and the Reich until one day, that fateful day arrived. Taking the podium before the Politsbureau in the provisional Soviet capital of Tyumen, the Premier of the Soviet Union, [RUS.GetLeader], has announced the Union's declaration of war against the Greater Germanic Reich, calling upon the vast Red Army to cross the boundaries of Moskowien and to begin the liberation of their glorious Motherland by any means necessary. 'There will be no retreat, no rest, only the advancing march of the invincible Red Army.'

options.name: The whole rotten structure will come crashing down.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Khrushchev Declares War on Germany
desc:
An announcement was sent to the world from the central government of the new Union of Soviet Socialist Republics in Tyumen from Nikita Khrushchev, the General Secretary of the Soviet Union, declaring the start of the Second Great Patriotic War. Khrushchev announced his intentions of avenging the failures of the old union and redeeming the USSR through the vision of Joseph Stalin, a Bolshevik of the past ages who had died mysteriously during Bukharin's rule.

The Red Army now marches westward, intending to retake the old, battered capital of Moscow, which has suffered under the German yoke for over 30 years. The world now watches in fear and anticipation of a war that could reshape Europe's future.

options.name: The end of the Reich in sight?
The long march to Germania begins.
They will be crushed like Bukharin was.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Great Trial
desc:
After months of rumors and Russian preparation, reports have begun to surface of the first soldiers and tanks of the Black League marching across the border of Reichskommissariat Moskowien after decades of preparation by [RUS.GetName]. Initial reports are marked by ruthless tactics, unending waves of military forces, and unconfirmed rumors of chemical weapons and dirty bomb campaigns, even being extended to civilian targets.

The German Führer has made a speech in Germania decrying the Black League's 'senseless and brutal destruction' as total mobilization orders for the Wehrmacht begin to draw a massive force to Eastern Europe, with Russian leader [RUS.GetLeader] showing no signs of slowing down his offensive. As Russia's 'sacred war' sees its beginning, it may signal Europe's end.

options.name: Arise, vast country, against the cursed horde!

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Federation Invades the Einheitspakt
desc:
The world was stunned yesterday as the President of the newly formed Russian Federation, Vasily Shukshin, declared war upon the Großgermanisches Reich and their Reichskommissariats. The President has stated the need to liberate Eastern Europe from German oppression and to right the wrongs made so long ago.

The Reich, in response to the declaration of war, has begun a process of mobilization against their old eastern foe, stating that they would 'destroy the All-Russian Army within only a few weeks.' The world holds its breath as the two greatest rivals in all of human history, armed with nuclear weapons, battle it out for what may very well be the last war humanity shall ever fight.

options.name: For the liberation of all Russians!

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Federation Invades the Einheitspakt
desc:
The world was shocked yesterday as the President of the newly formed Russian Federation, Alexander Pokryshkin, declared war upon the Großgermanisches Reich and their Reichskommissariats. The President has stated the need to retake rightful Russian lands from the Reich and to eliminate illegitimate states such as Moskowien.

The Reich, in response to the declaration of war, has begun a process of mobilization against their old eastern foe, stating that they would 'destroy the All-Russian Army within only a few weeks.' The world holds its breath as the two greatest rivals in all of human history, armed with nuclear weapons, battle it out for what may very well be the last war humanity shall ever fight.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Kingdom of Rus declares war on Germany!
desc:
Every Russian bell chimed twice today as the Kingdom of Rus officially declared war on the Third Reich. King Rurik III offered a lengthy and heartfelt speech to his people, promising to end National Socialist tyranny worldwide and to restore Russia to its status as a great power. Thousands of armored vehicles race across the vast plains of Moskowien. At the same time, high-altitude bombers brought ruin to German supply depots and logistical hubs.

Germany has promised to swiftly deal with the 'Slavic incursion,' although rumors from within the Oberkommando paint a picture of disrepair and surprise. Despite its scrambled politics and seemingly contradictory policies, international forces seem poised to support the bizarre Kingdom. It remains unclear if this relic from the past has what it takes to stand up for its values or if the sands of time will consume it once more.

options.name: When we are tired, we are attacked by ideas conquered long ago.
An ancient relic dares challenge our might?

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Kingdom of Rus declares war on Germany!
desc:
Every Russian bell chimed twice today as the Kingdom of Rus officially declared war on the Third Reich. Queen Ronegda I has sworn on her life to an audience of millions that she would be the one to exterminate the Nazi tyrants and that her people would see Russia thrive as a Great Power. Thousands of armored trucks race across the vast plains of Moskowien while high-altitude bombers destroy German supply depots and logistics hubs.

Germany has promised to bring a swift end to the 'Slavic incursion,' though rumors from the Oberkommando paint a picture of disrepair and surprise. International observers are split in their assessment of the young queen; some doubt her ability to competently lead the forces of Rus, while others praise her as a firm, just ruler, a model of strength from which future queens shall follow. Queen Ronegda will pave Russia's future, for better or for worse.

options.name: The ghosts of the Rus will not save her.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Revolutionary West Russian War Begins
desc:
An unusual story has sped around headlines today - the Russian Free Territory has declared war on the German Reich. A strange byproduct of Russia's warlord era, the Anarchist 'Black Army' managed to unify the disparate lands of Bukharin's former Union under a banner of red and black. United by a shared will to liberate their countrymen, Russian soldiers have poured across the desolate Moskowien border in force, threatening to sweep all of Europe under their unending march.

The international community appears baffled regarding the inner workings of the Free Territory, with many experts expressing "severe misgivings" over the communes' 'decentralized' structure of command. Nevertheless, it's clear Germany has no intention of letting such an ideological threat exist on its doorstep. Whether Anarchism can survive its first climatic test against the hegemon of Europe remains to be seen.

options.name: Mother Anarchy's sons ride once more into battle.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Red Army Surges West
desc:
Vasilevsky, leader of the recently reunified Soviet Union, has declared a state of open warfare between Russia and the German Reich. Already, reports of skirmishes at the Moskowien border are streaming in, and the German high command scrambles for a hasty response to what could be the biggest crisis of this decade.

Soldiers from across the Union, be they Tuvan, Russian, or Uzbek, prepare to give their lives to exterminate European fascism forever. Their bayonets shine in the sunlight. Millions charge west, steel lining their vehicles as well as their hearts, for the world knows: if the Red Army does not succeed, Russia may be lost forever. This time, the Union will not fail.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Republic of Russia Declares War on the Einheitspakt!
desc:
After years of oppression and despair, whispers of hope have been heard across Moskowien as the Republic of Russia has formally begun the liberation of Eastern Europe. Andrey Sakharov, from his home in Tomsk, gave a powerful speech before a crowd of thousands. "By unleashing the individual's full potential, Russia has risen once more like a phoenix from the ashes! Within a mere decade, we have transformed our Motherland from a divided backwater into the most technologically advanced nation on the planet! People of the world! Witness the true strength of progress!"

In response, the Wehrmacht has been mobilized and rushed off to the fight against the technologically superior Russian Republican Army. The world watches on, intrigued, as the world's most advanced army battles the Reich.

options.name: The great test of Russian democracy.
Their technology cannot stand up to superior German will!

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Russian Republic Marches West!
desc:
War sirens rang across Europe as the republican forces of Russia crossed the border of Moskowien. Today, President Dmitry Sergeyevich Likhachov gave a speech in Tomsk's Parliament announcing a state of war between the Russian Republic and the German Reich, a fight for the grand liberation of Europe from the fascist yoke.

German Officials appear baffled by the notion that a government focused around, as they claim, 'growing trees' can match the might of the Einheitspakt's military-industrial complex. The Reich Foreign Ministry also provided remarks about the Russian Republic's salon system, stating that the next party to be elected would enforce a constitution that forces immediate surrender in times of warfare. Nevertheless, the Wehrmacht is on full alert. Its forces are already engaging republican tanks near the border of Moscow.

options.name: Sun rays break through clouds of thunder and shine upon Europe.
We have only to kick in the door...

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Commonwealth's Prestissimo
desc:
President Moisey Vainberg has officially announced from the Petrov Salon in the heart of Tomsk that there is a state of war between the Third Reich and the Commonwealth of Russia. As the realm of reason faces its inevitable destiny westward, the Humanist army and its steel caravans advance into Moskowien, sparing no opponent the beat of their virtuous march.

In a movement that surprised none, Germany has begun a propaganda campaign calling Vainberg a representative of the Judeo-Bolshevik elite, using his Polish heritage to tar and belittle him. Retaliatory attacks in his native Poland have already begun. The world watches as the definitive clash between the two titans of Europe rages on after more than a decade of silence. Whatever the consequences, Europe's future will be changed forever.

options.name: War comes even to the wisest of men.
Your humanity will be your downfall.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Russian Republic Turns West
desc:
Today, the world was stunned by shocking news when the United Russian Republic, under the leadership of Daniil Kharms and the Bastillards, declared war on Germany. The Bastillard Salon is known for its cynical, anti-populist policies, including rapid industrialization, minimization of democracy, and anti-workers' rights positions. In a government known for looking down on the unwashed masses, the Bastillards take elitism to a near ideological nature. Yet it is the common man who will fight and bleed in Moscow's streets; it is the despised proles who will steer Russia's fate in the whirlpools of the battlefield.

Daniil Kharms and his Salon have promised to break the New Order like dry twigs prepared for a bonfire. German officials have not given any official comments. Whether this is out of fear or indifference is yet to be seen.

options.name: Another battle for the future of Russia.
Not even worth a second thought.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The U.S.S.R Begins the Second Great Patriotic War
desc:
History seems to repeat itself again as the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics finds itself at war with the German Reich once more. Led by Genrikh Yagoda, Bukharin's former head of the NKVD, the Irkutsk government could indeed be considered the legal continuation of Bukharin's late USSR; it seems that in accordance with this, Yagoda has determined it necessary to right the old Union's greatest failure.

The Red Army has already begun its long march into the Reichskommissariats, with skirmishes reported near the cities of Astrachan and Yaroslavl. As a wave of fire and steel floods its way through the Reich's frontier, Germany scrambles for a hasty response to the final Russian challenge to their Eastern throne. The song of the Union has reached its crescendo, and both know only one may rule Eastern Europe.

options.name: The millions that will be buried under Moskowien's soil will be worth our victory.
Lenin's frail creation draws its final, futile breath.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Union of Soviet Republics of Declares War on Germany!
desc:
Many saw the October Revolution as a means to an end: the first step in a march of hundreds on the road to a society built not on the backs of its corporate elite but its working class. That great journey reaches its climax today, as Soviet Premier Valery Sablin orders his troops into a battle not just for Russia's destiny but for the very fate of socialism itself.

With Red Army soldiers crossing the border into Moskowien once more, the Reich has promised to "swiftly and unmercifully crush the Bolshevik hydra," no matter the cost. Whether this new, revitalized Union can stand a chance against its mortal foe once more, one thing is certain: the battle for Bukharin's legacy has just begun.

options.name: Can Sablin redeem the soul of his predecessor?
Bukharin's legacy shall lie in tatters forever.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Union of Soviet Republics Declares War on Germany!
desc:
Many saw the October Revolution as a means to an end: the first step in hundreds on the road to a more fair and equal Russia, a society built on the foundation of Lenin and Marx, one without racial prejudice and based on the uplifting of the proletariat.

Valery Sablin has taken the second step forward as he announced a declaration of war from his home in Ulan-Ude. Soviet armies flood the Moskowien border for one last gasp at a free Russia. The German Reich has proclaimed its steadfast dedication to 'ending the Slavic threat once and for all.' At the same time, OFN observers have expressed doubts about whether the unstable and fragile Reich can withstand another significant blow to its Empire.

As the fires of revolution spread across the German frontier, it seems the battle is finally going again - this time, for the fate of all of Russia.

options.name: Lenin's legacy shall be buried forever.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Empire Strikes Back!
desc:
All of Europe today watched with trepidation as Russian Tsar Mikhail II and Prime Minister Anatoly Sobchak announced from the Royal Palace that a war of ‘Imperial Reclamation’ has been declared on the German Reich with the promise to ‘retake His Majesty’s rightful lands and free his enslaved subjects.’ Reports of Russian tanks and aircraft crossing Moskowien’s border began coming in shortly after the proclamation.

German officials have stated that they will easily defeat the army of an enemy that was once ‘put down by mere Bolsheviks.' Meanwhile, Russian èmigrès and Cossacks abroad dust off their old uniforms and flock to their homeland to fight for their cause for one last time. The entire world stands anxiously as Europe’s hegemony of the past clashes with the that of the present; the fates of both shall be forged by the fires of war.

options.name: Will the Romanovs have the last laugh?
It’s time we finish what the Bolsheviks could not...

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Great Slavic Reclaimation War Begins!
desc:
Under the orders of the Russian Vozhd, Konstantin Rodzaevsky, and the Russian Fascist Party, the new Russian power has now begun its march west, declaring a "total reclamation of rightful Slavic lands from the oppression of the Wehrmacht." Rodzaevsky has now mobilized the entire All-Russian Army to march on Moscow and reclaim the rightful western lands of the superior Slavic peoples.

Rodzaevsky swore that this war would not end like the Soviet Union's war with the German Reich, as Russia no longer has been infected with the stain of Judeo-Bolshevism, which had supposedly 'weakened the spirit of the Slavic people.'

Whatever the outcome may be, there seems to be a sense of dread from all parts of the world as the two Nazi titans battle once more on the scared lands of Eastern Europe.

options.name: Two peoples. One ideology. One war.
They think their pretense of false Aryanism will save them?

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Vozhd Against the Führer!
desc:
None expected the poor, frozen expanse of Magadan to be the cradle of Russia's heirs, yet its Vozhd now stands not just as the ruler of Russia but as the potential master of Europe. Earlier today, Russian troops crossed the Reich's border in force, officially beginning the Second West Russian War in Europe. Matkovsky's careful diplomatic maneuvering and economic pragmatism has brought him to this point now, but this war cannot be won on the backs of his foreign supporters.

The Reich has responded quickly, mobilizing its reserves to defend the borders of Moskowien and sending forth its Luftwaffe across the vast stretches of Eastern Russia. Although it seems rational for most to root against German hegemony in Europe, some observers claim that should Matkovsky's forces prevail, his fascistic leanings and cold, ruthless touch will simply replace the unstable Nazi menace with a leaner, saner threat. With Russia's destiny hanging in the balance, only time will determine the two dictators' destiny.

options.name: Let us hope that this war will result in real change, not realigned chairs.
Survival of the fittest, one race against another.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Russian National Republic Storms Nazi-Occupied Europe
desc:
The tense peace between the Russian National Republic and the German Reich has shattered in the wake of millions of Russian soldiers advancing across the Moskowien border. President Nikolay Petlin has rallied the Russian people with the hope of fulfilling a 'solemn pledge' to liberate occupied Eastern Europe as the country shifts towards an unprecedented scale of mobilization.

The OFN has expressed its support for the Russian cause in their 'great crusade' against German tyranny, with many viewing the war as the culmination of the Free World's decades-long battle against Nazism. Initial reports are marked by unrelenting military assault as the Heer struggles to muster against Russian forces. Russia has joined the desperate fight to preserve the light of freedom, and this time, it may finally see the Reich toppled.

options.name: We will have liberty, or we will have death.
One last fight to preserve National Socialism forever.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The United States of Russia Invades the Einheitspakt
desc:
In a strange turn of events, the United States of Russia, under the leadership of the mercenary Mitchell WerBell III, has declared war on the Einheitspakt.

WerBell had made a speech from his home in Magadan, stating that much like his home country has Washington, Russia required Moscow. He further noted that the German Reich illegally occupied the Reichskommissariats and that the USR had every right to liberate their people from oppression before finishing his speech with the words "Ad bellum!".

The Wehrmacht has mobilized in response, moving toward the east and more than prepared to crush this new Russian state. Millions of Eastern Europeans brace themselves as history's greatest rivals battle it out once more.

options.name: One last clash against the American menace.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]A Holy War against the Einheitspakt
desc:
A bizarre proclamation from the Divine Mandate of Russia has just been announced today as its de-facto leader, Father Alexander Men, has just declared war against the German Reich and its Einheitspakt. The Father has made it clear to the world that it seeks to liberate the oppressed peoples of Eastern Europe from the shackles of German oppression.

As of this moment, numerous uprisings have sparked across the Reich's frontier. Although the German High Command remains confident about its war against the non-nuclear Divine Mandate, several analysts have stated that the Mandate's vast missile stockpile may hamper the German offensive and its nuclear arsenal. The world prays fervently for a quick resolution to the hostilities.

options.name: Religious zealots? The Untermensch have truly gone mad.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The U.S.S.R Begins the Third Great Patriotic War
desc:
Speaking to the world from Rykov, Premier Sergei Bessonov announced that the Presidium of the USSR has unanimously voted to declare war on the Third Reich. Citing racial and class oppression, numerous raids across the border, and alleged assassination attempts against high-ranking Soviet officials, Bessonov called on the Co-Prosperity Sphere and OFN to unite behind the USSR to "sequence fascist vulgarity and return to a period of international law and peaceful relations."

International observers have described Bessonov's USSR as remarkably similar in policy to the Union under the Bukharin administration. Optimists state that this incarnation of the USSR will have a fighting chance now that it marches to war on its terms; others insist that a government with identical policy and lesser manpower and industry cannot hope to reverse the defeats of the '40s.

options.name: Bukharin's legacy shall be crushed once more.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The White Army Marches West!
desc:
Storm clouds gather over the fields of eastern Europe as Tsar Nikita has announced a 'holy crusade for the stolen lands of the Empire.' The Tsar was shortly followed by his second, Boris Shepunov, who delivered an emboldened speech to the thousands of White Army soldiers who stood at attention, proclaiming that it was time to achieve their 'divine destiny' and usurp the tenacious Germans from their home, once and for all. The German Führer has sent the Heer eastwards and asserted that the young Russian state will be put to rest for good.

Reactions from abroad are mixed. Representatives from Tokyo have announced their support for the reborn empire and its herculean endeavor. Meanwhile, Washington remains silent on the matter entirely, and only time will tell whether or not they choose to intervene.

options.name: Let’s see if history will repeat itself.
We shan't be as merciful this time.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Red Specter Dominates Eastern Europe
desc:
After decades of exile into the fringes of Europe, Communism has made a triumphant return to Eastern Europe under the banner of the new Soviet Union under Mikhail Tukhachevsky. The red banner waving high over the ruins of the Kremlin, the Grand Marshal made a powerful speech before the world, citing the inevitablity of the International Revolution, Germany's defeat only proving the strength of Communism on the global stage.

While the Soviet Union revels in its victory, German society has been deteriorating as mass riots break out as the populace call for the replacement of the ruling Nazi party. As Nazi power in Germany wanes while the Red Specter consolidates its rule over the East, many are left wondering how the world will adjust to the fall of one radical regime and the rise of another.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The United States of Russia Victorious Over Germany!
desc: Metal gears and the power of money beat the damn krauts

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Kraków Uprising!
desc:
The idea of a free Poland was thought to have been completely destroyed following the conclusion of the German Civil War, a nation annihilated beneath the crushing boot of Nazi Germany once again. In recent weeks, however, the once lost Polish nation has slowly been waking up following Russia's victory in the Second West Russian War and the ensuing chaos consuming Germany.

In the city of Krakow, pro-independence protests became a mass uprising that went on to spread across Southern Poland lead by Karol Wojtyla and the rebuilt Polish Home Army. The German government was swift in accusing the Russian government of orchestrating the recent Polish Uprising, claiming that the [RUS.GetName] was taking advantage of the Reich's weakened state. Regardless of whether these claims are true or not, the Poles are fighting once more, their eyes focused on the city of Warsaw.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Polish Independence
desc:
After intense fighting throughout the once thought pacified lands of Poland, it would seem that the Polish people have at last secured their independence from Germany. Under the leadership of provisional President Karol Wojtyla, the Poles have defied the odds as the Polish flag is raised over Warsaw once more.

Receiving recognition from both the United States and the Russian Federation with the Japanese opening diplomatic relations, it would appear that for the first time in decades, Poland is at last here to stay. With Poland liberated from Germany, the Reich's hold on Central Europe seems irreversibly shaken as discontent and protests begin to rise throughout Northern Europe, leaving many to wonder if the Einheitspakt can survive the 1980s.

options.name: Let's hope China doesn't get any ideas...

title: [Get_newspaper_header][GGN.GetNameDefCap] Triumphant
desc:
Devastating news has befallen the Polish people once more as the last brave holdouts of the Polish Home Army are crushed yet again underneath the boot of their German occupiers.

Emboldened by the stunning defeat of Germany in the Second West Russian War coupled with rumored arms shipments from Russia, the Polish Home Army rose once more in open revolt, driving the disorganized occupation authorities from the countryside, steadily marching north towards Warsaw. Reacting quickly to the situation thousands of Wehrmacht troops flooded into Poland once more, pushing the exhausted Home Army back to Lwow, systemically clearing the city until nobody was left standing.

With this defeat, Poland is cast into darkness once more. Perhaps this time, forever.

options.name: The final, painful whimper of Poland.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Return of the Exiles
desc:
Today marks a new page in history, as the almost forgotten Polish Government in Exile, which first fled to the United Kingdom after the German Invasion, and then to the United States after Operation Sealion; once more return to what's left of their ancestoral land.

As the formerly exiled Polish government consolidates their control over the nation from the historical capital of Warsaw, International commentary have described this event as "The beginning of Poland, on a bloody, yet clean slate".

While the international implications of such a phenomenon are minimal, the symbolic value of a Polish homecoming is to be celebrated by Poland's massive international diaspora for years to come.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Arrow Cross Triumphs!
desc:
Dark clouds gather over the Danube as [HUN.GetLeader], enigmatic leader of the National Socialist Arrow Cross organization, declares victory in the Hungarian Civil War.

Classified as a "terrorist" movement by the former Imrédy Government, many believe the Arrow Cross was responsible for the mysterious disappearance of the Hungarian Leader shortly after the Reich's defeat. Broadcasting from the hollowed-out city of Budapest, Szálasi has promised to root out "Judeo-Bolshevik parasites" from Hungarian society through waves of mass reprisals and arrests.

As Hungary falls into the hands of yet another national socialist dictator, many question just how long its people can endure the pain of their shackles.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Smallholders Victorious!
desc:
Today the popular agrarian and anti-fascist resistance led by leader Ferenc Nagy have officially announced victory over all his opponents thus ending the Hungarian Civil War. At the scarred center-city of Budapest, Nagy declared in a rousing speech "Now that the spectrum of war is over, it's time for us to be united once for all ! Toward a new world ! For the Hungarian Republic, its people and its independence!"

Political parties outlawed and figures imprisoned under the Imrédy Government breathed in relief as their condamnations had been lifted and stated as illegal. To assure people's representation, a coalition of conservatives, liberals, social democrats and even communists merged into a provisional government until a permanent solution can be agreed on. With the rise of the young republic, the house of cards keeps falling as Germany faces the consequences of its defeat.

options.name: A light shines across the Danube.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Hungarian Revolution
desc:
Surprising news rings out over the Danube as Imre Nagy and the Hungarian Socialists stand victorious over its blood-soaked waters.

Suppressed for decades by the German-aligned satellite government, the Hungarian Red Army bided their time through consolidating support and amassing arms, seizing control over much of the countryside as a storm of fascist paramilitaries engulfed Budapest whole. Capitalizing on the under-equipped nature of their adversaries, Socialist forces swept westward, collapsing Szalasi's regime before forcing the surrender of Ferenc Nagy's democratic front in short order.

With the disintegration of all further opposition, Imre Nagy, having served the party loyally for decades now, has announced his intentions on electing a successor. Whether the new Socialist Republic can handle such a change in the guard however, remains to be seen.

options.name: The Danube is red, through revolution and blood.
The Danube is red, through revolution and blood.

title: Global_Conflicts.12.t
desc:
Following an announcement from the new German government, thousands of troops and tanks have begun pouring across the border into the newly-established Hungarian Socialist Republic to "restore order" and protect the local populace from "Judeo-Bolshevik enslavement".

Imre Nagy, broadcasting from inside his shelter in Budapest, has sworn to defend Hungarian socialism until the bitter end. While his bravery is certainly admirable, experts have concluded that it is only a matter of time before the Swastika is hoisted above the Danbube for good.

options.name: When you can't pick on someone your own size...
Even a half-dead wolf can still bear its teeth.

title: Global_Conflicts.13.t
desc:
It seems the "Landowners Revolution" was not meant to last as German tanks and mechanized forces pour into the war-weary nation in force, signaling the beginning of Germany's invasion of Hungary.

Emerging victorious after a brutal civil war, Ferenc Nagy's broad front of Liberals and Agrarians unanimously agreed on the removal of Hungary from the German-aligned bloc, hoping to reestablish relations with the free world on a new, independent basis. Those hopes have been dashed, with German warplanes turning an already-devastated Budapest into a city of wire.

With no meaningful capacity to resist, it seems Hungary's future is destined to be chained to that of the Reich's. Bringing an end to its new-found optimism through a storm of fire and steel.

options.name: The light of freedom grows darker.
Even a cornered wolf can still bare its teeth.

title: Global_Conflicts.14.t
desc:
The National Socialist cause could face a death blow today as German troops crash through hastily-prepared Hungarian defenses, marking the first broad stroke in the foreign policy of Free Germany.

Taking power through the bloody siege of Budapest, Ferenc Szalasi's "Arrow Cross" found itself alone with the fall of Klopfer's regime in Southern Germany. As brutal crackdowns in the countryside occupy whatever small army Hungary can muster, little much can be done to stop the approaching onslaught towards the capital, with civilians reportedly welcoming the invaders with heavy, albeit-concerned relief.

As the fires of war reach the Danube once more, it seems Szalasi's dreams of power have turned into a nightmare for the National Socialists in Hungary. One that he, and those still brave enough to fight, may never wake up from.

options.name: The butchers of Budapest now meet their fate.
The butchers of Budapest now meet their fate.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Hungarian Civil War
desc:
The chaos in the wake of collapsing German authority in Europe has claimed another victim, this time in the Heart of the Danube. Living under the ever-lasting specter of Nazism and going from one dictatorship to another, Hungary's people have known nothing but repression over the course of half a century. With the end of the Second West Russian War and subsequent collapse of the Hungarian economy, it was only a matter of time before the fires of revolution reached Budapest.

Fascist paramilitaries under the command of Ferenc Szálasi stormed the Hungarian Parliament, attempting to seize power under force of arms. The subsequent chaos and power vacuum has allowed opposition forces to quickly gain territory along the Danube, and it is now reported that all of Hungary is in a state of revolutionary violence.

options.name: The Steel Curtain tears itself apart.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]France Moves to Reclaim its Territory!
desc:
Languishing under the Reich's shadow for decades, France has faced nothing but humiliation since its involuntary introduction into Germany's 'New Order' at the end of the Second World War. With the sudden implosion of its old rival into civil war and subsequent collapse of its sphere of influence, [FRA.GetNameDef] now finally has a chance to rectify its near half-century's worth of pain, a chance they have acted on with certainty and haste.

Abandoned and isolated from reinforcements, the "Deutsche Militärverwaltung in Frankreich" has come under siege by the mobilized French Army, looking to reclaim its northern territories by any means necessary. With no means to sustain a prolonged resistance, it seems all but guaranteed that Germany's dominance in France will come to a short but dramatic end.

options.name: The Gods of War now find themselves mortal.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The French Army Victorious!
desc:
In an unsurprising series of short but fierce battles along the Seine, [FRA.GetNameDef] has successfully vanquished the Germans from its northern lands, beginning the process of repairing its national pride much to the dismay of Klopfer's regime in Southern Germany.

Coming under multiple avenues of attack, the "Deutsche Militärverwaltung in Frankreich" found itself unable to hold the French at bay, gradually withdrawing under a fighting retreat until its remnants fled across the border into Alsace, surrendering themselves to the rival government present in the region. The national tricolor now flies over all of Paris, bringing the French victory on a scale not seen since the end of the First World War.

With this spectacular victory France has now found itself whole again, albeit with the massive toll of reconstruction still waiting to be paid by its weary and exhausted public.

options.name: The tree of liberty only grows when watered by the blood of tyrants.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Germans Victorious in France!
desc:
In a shocking series of pitched battles along the Seine, [FRA.GetNameDef] has been forced back across the border once again with nothing to show for its dead, cementing German dominance in the West even as its homeland burns in the East.

With French victory a forgone conclusion at the start, a lack of coordination, proper equipment and a series underestimation of their counterparts lead to France's advance bogging down along crucial river crossings, shattering hopes of a painless victory and sapping morale across the frontline.

A fiasco of incompetence and under-preparation, France has lost its third war in the span of half a century, only furthering its woes at home and destroying any semblance of a national resurgence.

options.name: For those without spirit. For those without will.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Democratic Victory In Germany!
desc:
As the dust finally settles over the carcass of the Reich, a new Germany has risen from the ash, for as long as the Bundesflag flies high above the Brandenburg Gate, the legacy of Weimar may live on forever more.

The Republic of Germany has prevailed in the German Civil War, marking the largest seismic switch in European politics since the chaos following Hitler's passing. With die-hard resistance bands still reaking havoc in the countryside, the newly-formed Provisional Government has declared a state of Martial Law due to various attacks by Fascists and Communists alike. Despite this danger, the Republic has already announced new nation-wide elections to be held in the next few weeks, marking the first since the victory of Hitler's National Socialists. As the sun now sets across the former Reich, its citizens now find themselves not as the "master race", but as Germans in a new, equal Europe.

options.name: Brandts spirit still lives on in his people.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Communist Partisans Prevail In Germany!
desc:
The Revolutionaries of 1918 find themselves vindicated as the “People's Republic of Germany” has been proclaimed within the former Reich. Beginning as a disorganized worker rebellion in the Rhineland, the fractured cliques of militant socialists were able to unite together through a revolutionary wave of steel, sweeping away all fledging rival holdouts before finally proclaiming victory over all of Germany.

With the guns now finally silent, an "internal party congress" has been called to decide the fate of the former Reich. Planned to be held within the halls of the Volkshalle, Ernst Aust, Rudi Dutschke and Heinz Hoffman have all offered their participation.

With the majority of the former NSDAP leadership now lying in unmarked graves, it seems that Bormann's worst nightmare has finally come to pass. Germany, once the fascist hegemon of all of Europe, has fallen to Socialism.

options.name: The sons and daughters of Marx now stand alone.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Wehrmacht Remnants Triumph In Germany!
desc:
As the artillery batteries and machine guns fell silent over the former heartland of the German Reich today, a shocking victor has emerged and put an end to the anarchy and devastation of civil war, with Ernst Ferber's Wehrmacht forces declaring victory in Germania.

Hailing from the heartlands of the Prussia of old, Ferber's military authority first emerged shortly after the devastating failure of the Second West Russian War, where he and his former comrades were shunned and blamed for the failures of a Reich that had long been the victim of its own ambition. As the Fatherland imploded, dissidents swore allegiance to a new banner that promised to free Germany from the failures of Bormann and his successor, with the sole aim of protecting a nation on the brink of oblivion.

Those promises were validated as soldiers of the 'Ostfront' tore through the scattered militias and police forces of their rivals, and now, the world awaits a renewed Reich on the world stage.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Freikorps Veterans Prevail!
desc:
Black clouds shadow over the Reich as Heinz Georg-Lemms "Schwarze Bande" emerges victorious in the German Civil War. Composed mostly of veterans, with some dating back to the West Russian War, Lemm's "Freikorp" seized control in Breslau during the wake of the German Civil War. Ranging from well-trained soldiers to the old and young, the raving bands ruthlessly put down any resistance on their path to Germania, marking their trails with a mix of hollowed-out villages and crushed skulls.

Charred bodies, tortured souls, and cities of ash now mark the rule of the Freikorp, and as Lemm's circle slowly drifts into in-fighting and petty squabbles, the Reich's bandits now must face the ever-lasting consequences of their actions with apathy, or despair.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Klopfer Restores The Reich!
desc:
The free world stands in horror once more as Kloper's loyalist government stands victorious in the German Civil War. Composed of bitter veterans and fanatical youths, Werewolf forces crippled vital supply lines behind enemy lines, providing an opening that the exhausted Wehrmacht desperately needed. Through systematic bombings and concentrated attacks the NSDAP remnants were able to violently suppress all remaining opposition, capturing Germania in a bloody siege of the former capital.

As the dust finally settles over Germany, it's unclear just how Gerhard Kloper hopes to mend the ever-growing rifts within the National Socialist party. Despite the Reich's ever-present issues however, the soon-to-be Führer has organized a massive ceremony bestowing himself of Bormann's former title, albeit with a noticeable lack of the former Shutzstaffel present.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]First German Party Congress Begins
desc:
German citizens breathe sighs of relief today as the members of the socialist coalition and victors of the German Civil War have decided to put down their guns for good. Cooler heads have thankfully prevailed and the leaders of the new socialist parties have decided to run the first central party elections.

As tensions in the former Reich have finally cooled, people flock to the voting booths and candidates make their speeches to be the winner of the first ever elections in a truly socialist Germany. This election will surely decide the direction of German socialism for the years to come.

While most nations celebrate the end to violence in Europe, nations like Japan and the United States warn of the "dangers" that socialist ideals and extremism can bring. Despite the warnings, all of Europe can breathe knowing that the years of intense violence is now behind them.

options.name: The Red Star shines and shimmers.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]German Elections of [GetYear]!
desc:
Across the former German Reich, turnouts to the voting polls have hit record numbers in anticipation for what is the first true democratic elections in Germany since 1933. Poll stations across the country have seen nothing short of crowds reaching hundreds, with some bigger cities like Munich or Cologne reaching thousand person turnouts for their polling stations.

The elections ahead are dominated by the Conservative Party, the Liberal Democratic Party, and the Social Democratic Party, with each respective party reaffirming that they will bring a stable, working democracy to Germany.

The faces of some voters that have been waiting in line for days are overbound with joy and excitement for the future that lies ahead for them, with some early polling stations indicating a close race was ahead for the three parties.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]FDP Elected In Germany!
desc:
Today is a historic moment for the newly-born Free Germany as the Liberal "Freie Demokraten Partei" has prevailed in the Republic's first election. The new Party Chairman, Hans-Dietrich Genscher, has taken the chancellorship in a massive public ceremony, announcing his goal to rebuild the shattered nation "with utmost speed and impeccability." While some doubt the true legitimacy or intentions of German democracy, there is no questioning the true scale of this occasion in world history.

Internationally, the news has come as a relief to the free world. While relations still remain cold between the rival powers, Genscher has announced the beginning of diplomatic missions to the United States and Japan, stating that one day, "the haunting specter of nuclear annihilation may be finally put behind us all.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The KDPD Triumph!
desc:
Celebrations took place across Germany today as it was announced that the Conservative Party of Germany had won in the first elections in the nation since the Weimar republic. Walter Scheel's successful campaigning of progressive reforms had led him to win out in a tight race against the Liberal and Social Democratic parties, of who have conceded the elections.

Moreover, the Social Democratic Party and the Liberal Democratic Party have signaled their willingness to work with Walter Scheel's government no matter the issue, as it would appear the Conservative Party aims to take the middle road between the policies of both the Social Democrats and the Liberal Democrats. All across the country, hundreds of thousands of people took to the streets to commemorate this moment in history, while the Conservative Party settled in to begin a new democracy in Germany.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Gerlach Takes the Chancellorship!
desc:
Today in Berlin, the streets surrounding the former Volkshalle were filled to the sidewalks with cheerful citizens, as the Liberal Democratic Party of Germany declared it had won out in the first elections since the days of the Weimar Republic. Led by Manfred Gerlach, his reputation earned from fighting in the recent civil war as a partisan had earned him the respect of both the voters and his peers.

One of Gerlach's first actions as Chancellor was to commemorate the deceased members of each party since the National Socialist Party took over in 1933, with a ceremonial wreath being placed atop Willy Brandt's grave. Since then, hundreds of others have thrown roses at the grave of Brandt as well, showing their sign of respect for the man who tried to save Germany. Feelings of excitement and ecstasy have swept over the country, as the people of Germany await for their bright future that lie ahead.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]A Red Dawn in Germany
desc:
The First German Party Congress is over, and the Deutscher Arbeiterstaat has a new master: the bold and uncompromising Heinz Hoffman. Espousing a unique vision of undiluted Vanguard Communism coupled with German exceptionalism and rhetoric of immediate and Permanent Revolution across the entirety of Europe, Hoffman has united an odd coalition of zealous red guardsmen, officers, and centristic nationalists.

While the international Left dances uncomfortably with their new partner, unsure if a leader who seemingly rejects internationalism can be trusted, the capitalist and fascist powers of Europe are already seeking international assurances that their sovereignty will be defended from Hoffman's proposed Massenproletarischer Blitzkrieg. Even with Germany in ruins, it seems the coming decade will be marked by yet more tension, yet more fear, and yet another swing of the Sword of Damocles.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Birth of Soviet Germany
desc:
History often repeats itself. The Party State is in ascendancy in Germany, as the Bolshevist faction has won out in Volksrepublik Deutschland. Unlike in Russia, the new German Communist Party espouses Marxism-Leninism, a so-called ultra left tendency once championed by Stalin and Trotsky. Chairman Ernst Aust's underlings have put forth the so-called Red Morning programme, calling for immediate reindustrialization, immediate movement to state planning to support the transition to socialism, immediate preparation for counter-invasion by capitalist forces, and immediate and complete liquidation of the 'National-Fascist bourgeoise'.

With a new, red star rising in the center of Europe, the polarity of the Cold War has changed forever. But with Germany's leadership already hostile to the United States and Japan, this new chapter of the Cold War is unlikely to see a thaw.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Studentbund's Germany
desc:
The pages of history turn endlessly, and as the page has turned on the Third Reich, so too has it swallowed the elder generations. The new Germany now falls to the youth. Rudi Dutschke's faction of students and left-socialists have embarked on a programme of democratization, fighting to erect direct democracy, worker's ownership, and decentralized, local planning. Inspired by Marx and Rosa Luxembourg, Dutschke's 'revolution of all-conquering love' has been described as only one step away from anarchism, a drastic correction from state totalitarianism to potentially the leftmost country in the world.

It is a time of renewal in Central Europe. Still, there are whispers- whispers of dissent on the right, questions of how direct democracy can function in a nation indoctrinated by fascists for over forty years. Has the Decisive Revolution truly brought an end to history?

options.name: A whole Germany, built by producers and students.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Power Struggle Erupts in the Reich!
desc:
In the aftermath of the Reich's internal troubles and subsequent purges, one would think that stability and a semblance of unity might return to Germany with no foes left to oppose Klopfer's stranglehold on power. Yet even as the corpses of the NSDAP's enemies litter the fields and streets, a new foe has arisen from the most unexpected of places: The party itself.

It appears a splinter faction within the NSDAP has outright declared itself separate from Klopfer, citing his failures in keeping the nation stable and united, which led to the rise of radical elements and total collapse of what remained of Germany's sphere in Europe. Little is known about the new beliefs of this offshoot, but what is certain is that a new power struggle is brewing in Germania.

options.name: It seems they're returning to an old tradition.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Klopfer Purges The NSDAP
desc:
Over the course of the last few weeks, Gerhard Klopfer has come out on top of the power struggle which has gripped the German Reich. What has followed though has been nothing short of the largest purge in NSDAP history, as not just those who joined with Brandner have been cleansed, but any and all who so much as breathed his name have seemingly “disappeared”. In a television address, Führer Klopfer has stated that the party was finally cleansed of all anti-government subversives and of the Judeo-Bolshevik menace which “had been allowed to malinger in the party's ranks for far too long.”

With this announcement, rioting activity has drastically decreased. It seems, despite everything, Klopfer not only lives to tomorrow, but tomorrow as Germany's next Führer. In spite of the challenges that lay ahead of him, the uncertainty that follows him, as well as the silent judgment of the Sphere and OFN, Klopfer will take his first steps at the head of the still-kicking Thousand Year Reich.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Brander Assumes The Führership
desc:
In what can only be described as either a monumental shift for the German Reich or yet more of the same, Willi Brandner has ascended to the Führership. After outmaneuvering his primary opponent, Klopfer, Brandner has signaled his new grip on power with a nation-wide purge. Every sector, from the Wehrmacht to the Gestapo, has seen hundreds, perhaps thousands of bureaucrats and figureheads excised from the system.

In the meantime, Brandner has taken yet another radical leap. From the ashes of the orthodox NSDAP, Bradner has made the party anew. Many have called this a breath of fresh air, as for the first time in the Reich's history, a non-orthodox party-member leads it. Many others however claim that this is merely a facade, as Brandner regurgitates talk of a "thousand year Reich" over the radio waves.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Skirmishes in Breslau
desc:
First-hand reports from wartorn Germany are sparse, but news has circulated that a disloyal clique of former Shutzstaffel soldiers, acting on the orders of the former Reich's Minister for Food and Agriculture Herbert Backe, have seized Breslau in a bid to "restore stability and honor to the Reich".

With the Freikorp's inner circle fracturing more by the day, Ernst Kaltenbrunner, former Austrian SS leader and RSHA official, has been reported to have also organized against the Lemm Regime, with much of the surviving Shutzstaffel structure choosing to follow suit. Some analysts have suggested the possibility of an internal ploy to undermine and overthrow the Freikorp's rule, but with skirmishes already being reported across major road junctions, it seems that the fate of Germany now hangs in the balance of its captors.

options.name: The den of wolves now face themselves.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Freikorps Loyalists Restore Control
desc:
After dozens of bloody firefights and skirmishes across the entirety of eastern Germany, Heinz-George Lemm has successfully captured or killed any opposition within the former headquarters of the Freikorps, forever guaranteeing his position as the undisputed master of the former Reich.

Following the public announcement of his triumph, scarce reports have begun filtering out from fleeing refugees which paint a horrifying picture of mass purges of the government apparatus as well as the imprisonment or outright murder of anyone who is so much as suspected of harboring loyalties to anyone but Lemm.

options.name: A dark shadow stretches across central Europe...
