title: [Get_newspaper_header]Kaltenbrunner's Coup
desc:
Ernst Kaltenbrunner, leader of a clique of German government officials loyal to Nazi orthodoxy has assumed control of Germany following a coup d'état against Heinz-Georg Lemm's Freikorps government. Kaltenbrunner, whose SS skirmished with government forces in Breslau, signed a truce in exchange for promising to destroy former secretary of the Ministry of Reich Food and Agriculture Herbert Backe's cabal of Nazi extremists.

Kaltenbrunner seemingly betrayed Georg Lemm, as SS units loyal to him seized control of Germania and subsequently imprisoned and executed major Freikorps leaders, including Heinz-Georg Lemm. Germany is now under the control of a new German Worker's Party, but the new administration's ability to rule is threatened by party in-fighting and Herbert Backe's clique.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Blood and Soil Over Germany
desc:
Horror and despair consume Germany as its government is overtaken by what can only be described as agrarian extremists, eerily similar in ideology to Heinrich Himmler and his own esotericism. In the fires of the German Civil War, the Silesian Freikorp expunged all opposition and united Germany under their extremist ideals. The new Führer, Herbert Backe, has purged his main rivals in the Freikorps and consolidated power in Breslau.

Reports are growing scarcer by the day as the borders of Germany close, but some refugees claim that purges are being conducted across the nation. People accused of being “Judeo-Bolshevik agents" and "industrialist dissenters” are kidnapped off the streets, or else are shot and left to die. Experts fear that more harrowing stories will follow in the coming weeks and that the worst is yet to come. It seems an even worse monster has emerged in the ashes of Germany's defeat.

options.name: They don't ask for their love; only for their fear.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]France and Germany Enter Economic Partnership!
desc:
After a century of bitter hostilities, France and Germany have broken their cycle of hatred by entering into a joint economic sphere. Representatives from both nations made an announcement, quoting, "The time of French-German hostilities is at an end. Our differences shall be put aside for the sake of the European working class."

The two newly socialist nations have set a precedent for European politics. With the dissolution of the Pakt and the influence of Russia growing ever stronger following the Second West Russian War, Germany and France have decided that they are stronger together as a united front to stave off the influence of Russia and the OFN.

This move has sent shockwaves across the world, with nations like Japan growing concerned about the growth of socialism across the world. The United States gave tepid support while Russia refused to comment on these developments.

options.name: A red dawn comes to Western Europe.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Great Exodus
desc:
A mass exodus of men, women, and children from the former German Reich has begun as hundreds of thousands stream across the border to escape the chaos. With another civil war devastating the former German Reich's territories, much of the German population has fled to neighboring nations such as Sweden and Iberia, seeking refugee status. Many more are hoping to apply for asylum in the OFN, particularly the United States.

The economy of the former Reich's territories, already devastated from the civil war, has been further hampered by the loss of so many workers. For whatever power manages to rise from the fires of the German Civil War, this mass loss of manpower will hinder the reconstruction efforts that follow. Whoever prevails, the face of Germany has changed forever.

options.name: Another blow to the former Reich.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Germany Invades the Netherlands
desc:
Like other natively Germanic territories, Reichskommissariat Niederlande has had a very unique relationship with Germany. The Dutch were viewed as Germans in all but name by the Nazis, making for a close relationship with Germany and being all but considered as a core piece of the Reich.

That was emphasized today when German troops crossed the Dutch border. Like the infamous Rotterdam Blitz, the Luftwaffe has begun flying over the country conducting “strategic” bombing campaigns. While the Netherlands have expected and prepared for an invasion, only so much can be done against the Wehrmacht. With no defensive terrain, the Dutch government has been painstakingly attempting to mount a defense, but seldom few international observers expect them to succeed. For many, it is not a question of if the Dutch will surrender, but when.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Germany Invades Free Poland
desc:
This morning the Polish nation woke up to a sound all too familiar: gunfire and explosions. In a move seen as inevitable by international observers, the German Reich has once more invaded Poland. Citing the mistreatment of German citizens, the Wehrmacht has crossed the border en masse, and Poland once again finds itself in a desperate struggle for survival. The Nazis have only recently declared victory in the Second German Civil War, yet their leadership seems to have wasted no time in putting Poland back under the Jackboot.

Anticipating an invasion, Polish forces have been preparing for several weeks now. However, there is only so much that they can do to fight off the wounded, yet still deadly behemoth of Germany. The Polish people are crying out for foreign aid while the great powers of the world look on in concerned horror.

options.name: Is this the final chapter in Poland's story?

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Red Tide Moves Northward
desc:
Earlier today, frantic diplomatic cables from the newly-formed regime of Denmark indicated that key leaders have fled the country following the declaration of war by Germany's revolutionary government. The German revolutionary forces are expected to sweep across the nation in the coming days. Additionally, German forces declared that any key leaders of the ruling regime were to be rounded up and shot on sight.

Hundreds of thousands have left their homes in what is becoming a refugee crisis on the Swedish border. It remains to be seen how Sweden will react, as there are fears that Germany's warmongering will soon reach their shores as well. What is certain is that the red tide has yet to cease as it threatens to engulf all of Europe.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Price of Liberty
desc:
Earlier today, frantic diplomatic cables from the newly-formed regime of Denmark indicated that key leaders have fled the country following Germany's declaration of war. German forces are expected to sweep across the country in the coming days. Additionally, Germany declared that any key leaders of the new regime were to be rounded up and brought in for trial.

The German government has declared its intentions to re-establish a democratic government in Denmark, alongside a program of food rationing and reconstruction policies to rebuild the nation following what will likely be a short conflict. It remains to be seen whether Germany's efforts will bear fruit, but what is certain is that yet another European nation will be torn apart by war.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Germany Invades Free Denmark!
desc:
The Nazis have always espoused the idea that the Germans and the Danes belong to one Aryan nation with a similar culture, appearance and traditions, and therefore tried their best to chain Denmark and its people to the German Reich permanently. Today, history was repeated, as early this morning Luftwaffe aircraft appeared in the sky over Copenhagen, accompanying the Wehrmacht as they marched onto Danish soil.

The provisional government of Free Denmark, on behalf of the entire Danish people, has desperately attempted to appeal for aid, but the world, watching in horror at the invasion, seems to be powerless in stopping the Reich's advance, and it appears that Denmark is doomed to fall to the Nazi Empire yet again.

options.name: Nation by nation, the Steel Curtain is rebuilt.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Volksrepublik Invades The Netherlands
desc:
As the sun rose over the Low Countries this morning, an all too familiar sound followed shortly behind it, that of tank treads and marching boots as forces of the newly founded Socialist Germany bring the red tide to yet another one of its neighbors. Although the Dutch military has already begun to dig in wherever they can along the border, analysts worry the veteran forces of the Volksrepublik will be able to wrap up their northwestern neighbor in just a few weeks or less, as the first reports of skirmishes have all seemingly gone in favor of the Germans.

As Dutch victory seems increasingly unlikely, the world begins to wonder what the implications of a red flag over Amsterdam might mean, and more importantly where the red tide might be heading next...

options.name: The fires of revolution know no borders.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Bundeswehr Enters The Dutch State
desc:
It seems that although history doesn't repeat, it definitely rhymes as the news of the German invasion of the Netherlands has shocked the world. Citing an inability to acquire fair terms over a potential reestablishment of German interest in the area, Chancellor [REG.GetLeader] has condemned the government in Amsterdam over their “unwillingness to corporate” and “aggressive behavior” towards the new republic in Central Europe, saying in a recent press conference that the diplomacy had failed and that this was now the only course of action remaining.

Although Dutch resistance will no doubt be admirable, many suspect it'll be futile in the face of the Bundeswehr. With plans to establish a new reconstruction government in the area, some are left wondering whether the Germans are trying to save their former subjects from themselves, or are instead placing a new kind of chain over their necks...

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The End Of The German Garrison
desc:
In a fate most ironic, military forces of the German Republic have entered the lands of Poland not as conquerors, but as liberators.

Falling into anarchy during the Second German Civil War, Poland made one last attempt at liberation against the local Wehrmacht garrison. Tragically, they failed, with the world believing the Polish nation would never again see the light of day. Yet as the torch of liberty began to burn bright in Central Europe once more, it became clear the former soldiers of the Reich were living on borrowed time and that retribution would come to them sooner or later.

Today is seemingly that day, as the “Polish Garrison” is driven back on all fronts and is expected to be wiped out within the month, and a new Polish civilian government has begun to be established. However, some have begun to whisper that this “liberation” is nothing more than a concealed attempt at restoring German influence over the area...

options.name: Hitler's legacy, drowned forevermore in blood and steel.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Germany Invades Free Poland!
desc:
The revolution knows no borders...or so it was said, but was seemingly proven true today as the Nationale Volksarmee pours over the Polish border. Condemning the Polish government's supposed mistreatment and exploitation of the proletariat in their nation, an ultimatum for the immediate surrender of Polish forces was soon sent to Warsaw, being promptly rejected and triggering conflict one more between the two peoples.

Although the grizzled partisans and the veterans of the Second West Russian War from Kazakhstan are more than likely to give the Volksarmee more than just a bloody nose, many predict the conflict is not likely to last long due to the sheer numerical advantage possessed by the Germans.

options.name: A flag of crimson may yet fly over Warsaw...

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Red Invasion of the Wehrmacht Garrison
desc:
German forces have recently crossed into Wehrmacht-occupied Poland, with an official statement by the German revolutionary government proclaiming "an end to fascist Wehrmacht tyranny."

Bernhard Baatz, commander of the Wehrmacht garrison ruling Poland, decried the offensive, naming it a "degenerate threat" as he prepares to resist the German advance. Although the Wehrmacht defeated most of the Polish Home Army in the Second German Civil War, insurgent pockets remain and now have begun collaborating with the German government in order to topple Baatz's rule. As Germany reasserts itself, the old ways of Nazism crumble with each passing day.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Hammer and Sickle in Denmark
desc:
A red flag flies over Copenhagen for the first time in decades - this time not adorned with the Nordic Cross but imbued with the guiding principles of Marx and Lenin. After the split between the DKP and the Democratic Parties became too apparent, the leader of the communists, Arne Munch-Petersen, decided to consolidate his party rule permanently. While the democratic parties have been vehemently in opposition, they have been swiftly dealt with.

With Denmark now under Vanguard Party Rule and Germania in chaos, Munch-Petersen has the freedom to operate for the foreseeable future. With a period of breathing room established, he can rule the people of Denmark with utter impunity. Time can only tell if Germany will ever call its former brother back into the fold.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Danish Free Elections Announced
desc:
The Free World has rejoiced today after Denmark announced its move towards free elections. The news comes after the German garrison in the nation crumbled due to the lack of support from Germania amidst its collapse. Shortly after the announcement, the re-emergence of the Socialdemokratiet and Venstre parties reassured international observers, as both are moderate democratic organizations. The prevailing expectation among experts is that the two parties will have to fight tooth and nail for votes amongst an expected record-high voter turnout.

OFN observers have applauded the transition and issued congratulations to the budding democratic state. The rest of the world looks on, waiting with bated breath to see if democracy can survive so close to the chaos in Germania.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]German Garrison Holds On
desc:
Shock has spread worldwide today as Denmark's previously withering German garrison has consolidated its power and maintained control over the nation. Despite the lack of support from its home nation, the Wehrmacht troops have swept all resistance aside. With this resistance crushed, the garrison hunkers down to weather the storm. Statements made by top leaders within the garrison have reaffirmed their intention to wait for Germania's return 'by any means necessary.'

International observers have condemned the garrison for its harsh crackdown on civilian unrest amidst pictures of the brutality surfacing. Many believe the Germans have just prolonged the inevitable. Whether or not Germania returns, the garrison will wait for her with open arms for as long as possible.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Søren Kam Storms Copenhagen
desc:
Many analysts assumed that with the instability erupting in the Greater German Reich, the Danish nation would have been able to retake the reins of its own nationhood. When the malnourished German Garrison took power, many wondered how long the garrison could hold, with the death reels of the Reich taking a massive toll. In this chaos, Søren Kam and 'Danish National Socialism' have emerged victorious, with Kam being a veteran of the Second World War and an ardent anti-communist.

With many supposed communists already being reported as ‘missing’ by family members and close friends, the world glances at Denmark before returning to more pressing matters. The Danish people have been served to Kam on a silver platter, like lambs to the slaughter, their wishes being a mere afterthought.

options.name: Danes weep, but does the world?

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Balkan Internationale is Formed!
desc:
As turmoil continues to engulf Central Europe and Russian influence begins to creep westward, an oasis of reprieve has been forged in one the most unlikely of places. Representatives from the newly formed Hungarian People’s Republic and her like-minded neighbors have agreed to a formal alliance.

The Balkan Internationale, an alliance of military and economic cooperation comprised of socialist nations within its titular region, is a sphere meant to counteract influences from Moscow and Germania - should a victor emerge from the latter’s civil war.

As Central Europe continues its descent into chaos, it seems that the powder keg of Europe has finally cooled. Only time will tell what will become of this new coalition.

options.name: After a decade of darkness, a red sun shines.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Hungarian Civil War
desc:
Hungary became one of the few, if not only, free nations in the German sphere in the 1960s. Today, that all came crashing down with an attempted coup in Budapest. Arrow Cross paramilitaries marched on the Hungarian capital, sensing a moment of weakness due to the German defeat. It was carried out phenomenally, with several vital buildings taken without bloodshed. The fascists, however, underestimated the will of the Hungarian people.

Revolts have broken out across the country, which have escalated into a full-blown civil war. Ferenc Nagy has taken refuge in the southwest, declaring himself to be the heir of the legitimate government as socialist forces under Imre Nagy have taken up arms in the east. While the fascists may control the central part of the country, international observers note they now face a considerable challenge to cement their rule across the nation.

options.name: The dominoes fall one by one.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Walter Jens Ascends to the Führership
desc:
With the chaos of the Second German Civil War finally coming to an end, the now victorious Wehrmacht forces that mutinied against the Reich have now appointed a Führer of their own. Walter Jens, who joined the party in 1941 and served as a minor ally of Martin Bormann, now rules the battered German nation — at least ostensibly.

Jens' lack of experience has led many analysts to posit that the Wehrmacht remains in control, with his appointment serving as an attempt to obfuscate this fact from both the German public and the world. Regardless of the power he truly wields, however, this may signal the end of the turmoil that has engulfed the Reich since the end of the Second West Russian War and begin Germany's recovery from its recent devastation.

options.name: Führerprinzip, but who's really the Führer?

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Richard Von Shirach Installed as Next Fuhrer
desc:
Upon the bloody pacification of several dissident factions and the failures of the defunct Nazi regime, the provisional government led by the Wehrmacht has been reestablishing several components of the failed regime, even the various levels of bureaucracy that were problematic in Bormann's party. Despite these similarities, the Wehrmacht has kept all forms of leadership under strict supervision, including the newly elected Führer, Richard von Schirach.

Nephew of Joseph Goebbels and Bormann's right-hand man, Schirach is no stranger to National Socialist Orthodoxy and the management of the state. However, despite his willingness to lead, Schirach appears to merely be a begrudging figurehead for the Junta, a fact that appears to have caused tensions between him and the army.

options.name: The army and a puppet Führer.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Northwest Government Victorious!
desc:
As the gruelling war in Western China comes to an end, it would seem that the warlord Ma Jiyuan and the Northwest Government have emerged victorious, unifying the vast region under the banner of the White Sun. Following a victory parade in the provisional capital of Xining, Ma made a rousing speech to his people, denouncing the Imperialists in Japan and declaring the Nanjing government to be an illegitimate puppet regime.

In that same speech, Ma has announced that he will step down and organize elections, emphasizing the Three Principles and the redemption of his family name. Factions of the remaining Free Chinese, including mainline KMT, military men inspired by Chang Kai-shek, and survivors of the CCP have stepped up as potential candidates, each attempting to rally the divided ethnic, class, and ideological groups behind them.

The Sphere has yet to make a response.

options.name: To the legacy of Sun Yat-Sen!

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Sun Tse-Ping wins the Chinese Elections!
desc:
Sun Tse-Ping, a descendant of the first President of China, Sun Yat-Sen, has triumphed in the elections in recently unified Western China. Returning to China from his family's exile to California, Sun Tse-Ping has promised to liberalise all of China and to combat the poverty that plagues Western China in accordance with his late grandfather's principles.

In his victory speech in the Republic's capital, Xining, President Sun Tse-Ping denounced Japanese imperialism, declaring that the people of China can never know true freedom until the puppets are destroyed and the Japanese menace are repelled from their homeland once and for all. The Russian Federation and the United States congratulated Sun Tse-Ping. The Japanese criticised the President's reckless words, marking the first time the Sphere has acknowledged the new Chinese Republic.

options.name: An old face for a new China.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Chiang Chingkuo wins the Chinese Elections!
desc:
After a close race, the elections in Western China has come to a close as Chiang Chingkuo, the son of the late Chiang Kai-shek, has been declared the winner. Promising to democratise the nation and restore law & order to a troubled region over the coming years.

During his victory speech in the provisional capital of Xining, the new President made it clear that if what remained of free China was to stay free of the barbaric Japanese Empire, it would need to rapidly industrialise and militarise in order to ensure the defence of their remaining homeland.

The Russian Federation and the United States congratulated Chiang Chingkuo on his victory in the elections. The Japanese, on the otherhand, criticised the President's reckless words, marking the first time the Spehere has acknowledged the new Chinese Republic.

options.name: An echo of a failed past.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Xiannian's Coup
desc:
Shocking news has emerged from Western China as the long-thought extinct Chinese Communist Party remnants led by the infamous guerilla leader Li Xiannian has couped the Ma government and established Maoist rule over the decimated lands of West China.

Already, the new communist government has begun a mass roundup of political dissidents, with militant civilian demonstrators openly fired upon and vast swathes of the population subjected to "Re-education". The future of West China looks bleak.

Whether the regime can solidify its hold over China against a population completely opposed to its existence, remains to be seen. For now, the people of Asia hold their breath, for a new red sun has emerged.

options.name: Another failed attempt at Chinese democracy.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Capture of Konigsburg
desc:
Reports on the war in Eastern Europe have concluded that the Russian armed forces have breached into East Prussia occupied the German port city of Königsburg.

Analysts and world governments never expected the deadly continental war to culminate In the Russian National Reclamation Government entering mainland Germany, but it seems the end of war is inching closer and closer.

Officials of the Pakt have declined requests for comment, and independent reports have confirmed turmoil and mutinies within the Wehrmacht and civilian populace after the Fuhrer and his staff seemingly went missing. Whatever the case, the tumult of the war seems to be teaching its conclusion.

options.name: Alles ist verloren, starte sie alle...
Our vengeance is almost complete, nothing will stop us.
The end is finally in sight.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Fall of Ukraine
desc:
The Forces of the League have found themselves in control of the breadbasket of the Reich, The first time the Ukraine has been under Russian control since the thirties.Reports from German broadcasts claim Kiev, Kharkov and other major population centres have been completely decimated by bombing raids trying to trap Wehrmacht forces in their strongholds, The process of which has killed thousands of civilians already.

As expected, The Black League’s treatment of captured German forces has been cruel, With the colony’s Reichskommissar hanged in front of live television, and commissars giving ‘little to no punishment’ to soldiers found guilty of executing German prisoners of war or those who defy martial law. As the front moves ever westward, The world can only watch in horror as eastern Europe burns.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Fall of the Caucasus
desc:
Military broadcasts and Newspaper articles have confirmed that the majority of German forces have fled from the Caucasus area and while some garrisons appear to be resisting in the south, The invading Black League has, for the most part, completely secured all major cities and strategic zones. For many decades a Nazi colony, The Reichskommissariat’s massive reserves of oil has instantly given the Reclamation government a boost in morale and resources, And shaken the already nosediving Nazi economy even further!

Disturbing reports show a complete lack of regard for human rights for captured soldiers or civilians, with those refusing to comply with the League’s orders being immediately executed or reassigned to penal battalions. Regardless, It is clear that the Nazi government has lost a vaulable asset, And will possibly lose far more in the months to come.

options.name: Another nail in the Nazi’s coffin.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Fall of Ostland
desc:
As the League marches west into Germany, The Crown Jewel of the Reich has found itself under siege. Reports from both sides claim that fighting so brutal and intense that it could only be matched with the second weltkrieg itself took place as Russian forces attempted to push into Riga, Where they encountered heavy resistance by everything from elite German commandos to hastily conscripted Native militia. Televised broadcasts from Nazi stations, Now turned into propaganda outlets for the League show that Reclamation forces have been instructed to exterminate any and all settlements, particularly those with a majority German population. With reportedly thousands massacred by Russian troops.

As German forces no longer hold supremacy over Ostland, the Wehrmacht has fled to Poland as Millions of Germans and Poles are being conscripted to make one final hold against the Russian horde in the Vistula.

options.name: HEILIGER FICK, HOL MIR SCHÖRNER JETZT!

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Mass Purges In Russia!
desc:
As the fury of The Great Trial casts its fiery cloak over all of Eastern Europe, photos and news leaks coming in from Russia show disturbing reports of Russian Glavkoverkh, Dimitry Yazov, disposing of several high ranking officials from both the military and civilian administration. While no official reason has been given as to why, analysts believe that the purges are due to Yazov’s dissatisfaction with the performance of the war in Europe, which has slowly grinded down to an impasse similar in vein to the First World War.

The purges seem to reach all echelons of the military and government, a scale which hasn’t been seen since Hitler’s Night of Long Knives. Officials from Germany state that this outcome was ‘expected from an adversary as savage as the Slav’. Meanwhile, Yazov expressed assurance that he simply is ensuring that his government is free of ‘influence from outside forces’.

title: To Rule the Waves
desc:
Your Imperial Majesty, Most Honorable Sovereign of the Japanese Empire.

Ten years ago, Japanese and Malagasay forces suffered defeat at the hands of German Imperialists, a disgrace on your name that we may never truly lift. However, as the European powers continue to devour themselves, their diverted attention presents an opportunity for us to at least partially atone for our grave failures.

The garrison defending Madagascar is pitifully feeble. Our intelligence estimates that over eighty percent of their forces have been withdrawn to fight in the war in Europe. The rest are stricken by plague, starving, and lack the equipment to even feign resistance. They will surely cower and dissolve as soon as the great men of the Imperial Japanese Navy face them.

Under my orders, the Southwest Area Fleet has already been adequately supplied for the journey. Our planned path will take us far from the wary eyes of the Americans and their so-called OFN. A full fighting group of the finest Naval Marines are prepared to unleash their Yamato spirit for their Emperor and country. All we need now is your blessing. It is unlikely we will ever be presented with the opportunity to bring the light of the Rising Sun on the Indian Ocean again.

May your reign continue to abound with blessings.

Admiral Keiu Matsuo.

options.name: If you do not enter the tiger's cave, you will not catch its cub.

title: To Rule the Waves
desc:
Your Imperial Majesty, Most Honorable Sovereign of the Japanese Empire.

Ten years ago, despite the Malagasay spirit of resistance smothering their colonial ambitions, the tyrants in Germania seized the islands of the Indian Ocean from beneath our noses, a disgrace on your name that we may never truly lift. However, as the Reich is devoured from both within and without, their diverted attention presents an opportunity for us to at least partially atone for our grave failures.

The resident garrison of their unlawful territories is pitifully feeble. Our intelligence estimates that over eighty percent of their forces have been withdrawn to fight in the war in Europe. The rest are stricken by disease, starving, and lack the equipment to even feign resistance. They will surely cower and dissolve as soon as the great men of the Imperial Japanese Navy face them.

Under my orders, the Southwest Area Fleet has already been adequately supplied for the journey. Our planned path will take us far from the wary eyes of the Americans and their so-called OFN. A full fighting group of the finest Naval Marines are prepared to unleash their Yamato spirit for their Emperor and country. All we need now is your blessing. It is unlikely we will ever be presented with the opportunity to bring the light of the Rising Sun to every rock and wave that calls the Indian Ocean home.

May your reign continue to abound with blessings.

Admiral Keiu Matsuo.

options.name: If you do not enter the tiger's cave, you will not catch its cub.

title: Light in the North
desc:
Mr President,

As you are well aware, with the ongoing war in Europe, the German Reich's sphere of influence, ever dependent on the threat of force that they can no longer provide, has been crumbling. However, we could have never expected that out of the so-called 'Unity Pact', an applicant to our Organization of Free Nations would emerge.

Recently, the underground pro-democracy resistance group 'Milorg' successfully usurped power in Norway. Although the free nations of the world were unable to protect the Nordic nation in its hour of need over thirty years ago, they nonetheless have not forgotten the support the OFN has provided them since.

The new government has already submitted an in-depth roadmap towards the holding of free and fair elections in one years time. They have also established a diplomatic corps that is ready to begin dialogue with us. Moreover, their position in Europe holds vital strategic value in our fight against global tyranny, and should the Reich manage to retain even a semblance of the sphere of influence they once held, they will ensnare Norway in its grip again, most likely with extreme force.

It is for these reasons that I cannot overstate how important it is that we reciprocate Norway's desire to join the free world. Under Article 10 of the OFN Charter, we can expedite their entry into the OFN from months to just days. Given the circumstances in Europe, I doubt you disagree that such an article should be exercised.

Yours,

Representative Louis Lerner, OFN Liaison to the Kingdom of Norway.

options.name: Do we not fight for freedom? Let them in.

title: Light in the North
desc:
Mr President,

As you are well aware, with the ongoing war in Europe, the German Reich's sphere of influence, ever dependent on the threat of force that they can no longer provide, has been crumbling. However, we could have never expected that out of the so-called 'Unity Pact', an applicant to our Organization of Free Nations would emerge.

Although freeing themselves from German political oppression during the German Civil War, the Reich still successfully maneuvered the Nordic nation into their sphere through diplomatic promises and economic servitude, placing them in a chain made out of Reichsmarks instead of lead.

Now, however, with their masters distracted, Norway has sought one last chance to become truly free. Only through their ascension into the OFN can they ward off any threats from the Reich, be they military or economic. Furthermore, Norway holds vital strategic importance in our fight against global tyranny, being situated just miles from core Reich territory.

It is for these reasons that I cannot overstate how important it is that we reciprocate Norway's desire to join the free world. Under Article 10 of the OFN Charter, we can expedite their entry into the OFN from months to just days. Given the aforementioned circumstances, I doubt you disagree that such an article should be exercised.

Yours,

Representative Louis Lerner, OFN Liaison to the Kingdom of Norway

title: The End?
desc:
A tragedy! All throughout the world, we have been abandoned. Nations, once thought of as brothers and friends, now wipe their hands clean of our supposed filth, choosing instead to be seduced by the slave drivers in Washington and Tokyo. Our lands in the east, too, once core territories of the German nation, now fly the banner of the Slav!

In every corner of the world, fools, cowards, and traitors abound, failing to see our natural right to global hegemony, failing to fight for our blood and soil, failing to see through the poison-tipped lies of our enemies.

The Einheitspakt, the great pride of our first Führer, is but a shell of its once great self. But this is no time to delude ourselves with lies and grandeur while the formerly impenetrable rot seeps. No, now is the time to lick our wounds, both fresh and faded, and ready ourselves to strike again!

When our party was forced underground by feeble idealists fifty years ago, did we give up then? When our reclamation of our Eastern lands was challenged by London and Paris, did we let go of our ambitions? No, every time our Reich has faced adversity, we have risen to heights unseen! This time will be no different. Soon, our armies will march across the world once more. Soon, we will achieve victories not even our first Führer could've dreamt. Soon, no one will question us when we exclaim 'Last for one thousand years!'

Heil das Reich! Heil der Führer! Sieg Heil!

-Adolf von Thadden, Gauleiter Pommern's, speech before the Reichstag.

options.name: The past forsaken, the future foreboding.

title: Skeleton Crew
desc:
Martin picked at the dry skin on his thumb for what felt like the five hundredth time today. Ever since he had come to this forsaken island three years ago, he had been counting the days, nay, the seconds until he could leave. Whether he was on duty or in bed, the arrow of time passed painfully slowly. It didn't help that he was in a constant state of crippling hunger, a by-product of the territories' practical afterthought status. His uniform was faded and worn, his bed was hard and lumpy, even the cigarettes here fell apart before you could so much as grab them, let alone smoke them through. All he could do was stare at the infinite ocean and waste away.

When the war had reignited in Europe, he had been desperate to leave, but no. He was one of the 'lucky' ones who had to stay behind, except now his garrison was even more undermanned, undergunned, and undersupplied than before. Martin had no idea what made this slow and sweat-filled death 'lucky' compared to the quick and glorious one he might find in Moscow. All he wanted to do was to be out of this uniform and off this island. He'd do anything for a good night's sleep and three square meals. He'd do anything-

A hail of bullets whizzed past Martin's head, snapping him out of the hot meals and snowy pastures that had occupied his mind. Fuelled by nothing but adrenaline and basic training, he reached for his Mauser and fired at where he guessed the bullets were coming from.

Jammed. Of course it fucking was. Years of disuse and ocean salt had made his gun nothing more than a flashy showpiece. Now truly panicking, the starved soldier turned and began to sprint away from the shore. Unfortunately for him, his escape was quickly stopped by a group of Japanese soldiers who had managed to outmaneuver - and outwit - Martin, sending him tumbling to the jagged ground.

Covered in cold sweat and blood, and with a litany of rifles pushed into his face, Martin couldn't help but let out a chuckle at the unexpected way his mind-numbing service in the Wehrmacht had ended. At least the Japanese might actually feed him.

title: End of an Eagle
desc:
Great news! The dreaded Einheitspakt, the former master and overseer of nearly one fifth of the Earth's land, has finally, under the weight of its own greed and arrogance, been dissolved.

All throughout our country, men and women, young and old, left and right, dance and shout in the streets. Some of them were personally wronged by the Reich and its rabid subjects. Others were sons and daughters, fathers and mothers, brothers and sisters of those who were taken, becoming nothing more than fading memories and dried tears. And many more are simply sympathetic to the global fight against injustice and tyranny, proud to have done their part, be it big or small, to ensure fascism's greatest defeat.

However, in apartments and hamlets in scattered corners of the world, some instead shed silent tears. Perhaps they still believe in the rotten lies of the brown-clad devils, drunk on their nightmarish propaganda. Or, more charitably, they are simply overwhelmed by the march of time, a hallmark of their existence becoming history.

But whatever their reason, we will not let their misery impede our joy. So, a toast! Here's to a new order, one without suffering, oppression, or misery! And here's to the men and women who died so we may see such a day, and wish for such a tomorrow!

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Riots Erupt in the German Reich
desc:
Although unrest has always been an issue for the Master of Europe, with the collapse of frontlines in the nascent war, violent protesting has reached heights unseen since the death of Hitler. Be it Bonn or Breslau, liberals or anarchists, revolutionary movements have erupted in staggering numbers, with protestors even routing riot police in some cities.

The Reich has naturally played down the riots as "rowdy youths", while accusing the United States as the arbiter of their "Zionist violence". Despite Germania's calmness, however, with more and more men desperately needed at home being sent to the frontlines, one must wonder how the German Reich expects to handle this worsening crisis.

options.name: Look how they cower at our might!
They have no mouth and they must scream.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Japan Seizes Madagascar
desc:
Admiral Keiu Matsuo of the Southwest Area Fleet announced today that the Pro-German administration of Madagascar has been 'liberated from Western oppression.' According to reports, a series of amphibious invasions captured the colony with little effort, an unsurprising fact given the resident garrison's critical lack of supplies; most of its troops having been withdrawn to fight in Europe. Although the new naval administration has promised to eventually establish an 'independent Malagasay republic', reports of native partisans and Zaibatsu mining operations have cast doubt on these claims.

The Reich has condemned the seizure, stating it will reclaim its 'Lebensraum' as soon as it is able. However, with both internal stability and military morale plummeting, it seems unlikely such threats will ever materialize.

options.name: The Rising Sun shines brighter still!
The Reich's problem child meets its destiny.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Japan Seizes Mauritius and Réunion
desc:
With the Reich in chaos, both on the streets and in the battlefield, it seems that their territorial losses do not merely extend to Europe. According to Japanese reports, a series of amphibious landings seized the two German territories with little effort, an unsurprising fact given the resident garrison's critical lack of supplies; most of their troops having been withdrawn to fight in Europe.

German diplomats have condemned the seizure, promising to reclaim their "rightful territory" as soon as they are able. However, with the situation in Europe growing more dire by the day, it appears that Mauritius and Réunion, or "Meiji-kō" and "Kōmei-tō" as they are now known, will be lit by the Rising Sun for the foreseeable future.

options.name: The Rising Sun shines brighter still!
The Reich's problem child meets its destiny.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Food Shortages in the German Reich!
desc:
While many Germans have struggled to earn their daily bread since the economic woes of the 50s, the recent combination of strict rationing, foreign embargoes, and the loss of Ukrainian wheat to Russian advances have created frighteningly extreme food shortages. The price of bread, milk, and other basic necessities has more than tripled over the last week, and prices are predicted to continue to rise.

All throughout the country, riots and protests have swelled with masses of starving citizens, looting anything of nutritional value they can find. The Reich has once again denied any food shortage, attributing all "greed-ridden Untermensch" to "fifth-columnist gluttony". Despite Germania's dismissal, however, it seems that the Reich is inching closer to annihilation with every passing day.

options.name: The Reich's greed made plain for all to see.
Always three meals away from anarchy.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Milorg Coup in Norway
desc:
Despite its instability, many analysts had claimed that the northern government of Norway could never break from the German Reich without facing grave consequences. These analysts were proven wrong today, as Knut Møyen, leader of the antifascist revolutionary group known as "Milorg", announced from the steps of the Stortinget that the Reich-aligned Norwegian government has been overthrown in a highly organized, but almost entirely bloodless coup.

Despite the Reich's denouncement of his nascent regime, and scattered anti-Milorg forces still under siege, Møyen has already begun making overtures to the OFN and planning elections, promising his people that "the light of liberty will shine on Norway again." Only time will tell, however, if such a promise can ever be fulfilled.

options.name: Cowards and traitors the lot of them!
The Reich in a thousand pieces.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Norway Joins the OFN
desc:
Diplomats from the United States and the Kingdom of Norway have today, in a televised ceremony, announced that the latter is now a 'fully fledged member of the free world', shocking news from what was once thought to be an integral part of the German Reich.

The atmosphere in Oslo was electric at the announcement, with thousands of jubilant residents flying both Norwegian and American flags in the city's streets and squares. Again speaking to the nation, Prime Minister [NOR.GetLeader] praised the United States, saying that Norway "will no longer cower in the jaws of foreign tyranny." Despite new threats of reconquest from Germania, it appears that the era of Norwegian subjugation may finally be at an end.

options.name: More straw on the camel's back.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Norway Leaves the Pakt
desc:
In a surprising turn of events, Norwegian Prime Minister [NOR.GetLeader] today announced that, in light of 'popular sentiment', and 'changing diplomatic circumstances', the former integral Reich territory turned democratic alliance partner will rescind its membership in the Einheitspakt.

Washington has welcomed the news, calling the Pakt a "protection racket", and promising to renew its diplomatic ties with the Kingdom. Shockingly, however, Germania is yet to comment on the withdrawal of its self-touted 'Northern Brother'. Whether the war in the East or a defeatist outlook is the cause of this unusual silence, to many it signals the beginning of the end for Germany's global sphere.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The End of the Einheitspakt
desc:
The air hung heavy in Germania this morning. In a communique from the Reich's foreign ministry, it was announced that the Einheitspakt, once the most prominent political alliance in the world, will be 'reorganized to focus on internal affairs.' In essence, Germany's days as a global power are over.

Although many had predicted that the Reich's power would wane, few expected a fall from grace of this magnitude. However, with a complete defeat in the Second West Russian War, in addition to various other diplomatic and military failures, what was once thought impossible to the world has become inevitable. Now, as the remaining great powers circle overhead, and riots continue to spiral, the "Thousand Year Reich" stumbles into a new, frightful future, alone.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Isles Withdraw from the Pakt
desc:
With any illusions of the Reich's prowess evaporating in the wake of the Second West Russian War, both the governments of the United Kingdom and Ireland have, within hours of each other, elected to end nearly thirty years of cooperation with the former 'Master of Europe'.

The reaction has been different in each country, with the collaborationist British government violently reeling at their country's removal from Germania's sphere, While their Irish counterparts held mass celebrations. Now, as foreign diplomats and businesses move into the two countries en masse, it seems that the casualties of the most brutal war since the Second World War extend far beyond the battlefield.

options.name: Germany never did much for us anyways...
Domvile is rolling in his grave...
Keep smiling through, Just like you always do...

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Ireland Cuts Ties with the Pakt
desc:
With any illusions of the Reich's prowess evaporating in the wake of the Second West Russian War, the nation of Ireland, one of the few voluntary members of the Einheitspakt, has, in light of 'changing diplomatic circumstances' and 'popular sentiment', elected to rescind its observer status in the once hegemonic Pact of Unity.

Mass celebrations have been reported all throughout the island republic, with Protestants and Catholics alike rejoicing at the country's removal from Germania's sphere. Now, as American diplomats and businesses move into Ireland en masse, it seems that the casualties of the most brutal war since the Second World War extend far beyond the battlefield.

options.name: The Reich has always been an enemy of freedom.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The [ENG.GetName] Leaves the Pakt
desc:
With any illusions of the Reich's prowess evaporating in the wake of the Second West Russian War, [ENG.GetNameDef], one of the most committed and collaborationist members of the Einheitspakt, has, in light of 'changing diplomatic circumstances' and 'growing bolshevik terror', elected to rescind its membership in the once hegemonic Pact of Unity.

Mass panic has been reported from Dorset to Dundee, with Fascists of all stripes rioting at the country's sudden removal from Germania's sphere. Now, as foreign diplomats and businesses move into the country en masse, it seems that the casualties of the most brutal war since the Second World War extend far beyond the battlefield.

options.name: Domvile is rolling in his grave...
Keep smiling through, Just like you always do...

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The End of the Nazi Presence in Antarctica
desc:
Just days after Reich's complete defeat in the historic war against [RUS.GetName], the Unity Pact continues to crumble. As it loses its last vestiges of influence overseas, the issue of Antarctica has indeed fallen off the agenda at the OFN headquarters on the frozen continent.

All members of the OFN's research organizations in Antarctica unanimously agreed to the annexation of the defenseless territories within the German zone of control. To prevent the continued removal of valuable scientific assets to a weakened and unstable Europe, the marines swiftly annexed New Swabia. Reports indicate that there was no resistance from representatives of the demoralized 'Aryan researchers', and, most likely, not all valuable research findings were fully evacuated. Comments from Germania either deny these events or decline to comment.

options.name: Other research missions breathe a sigh of relief.
It took more than 30 years to finally drive the Nazis out of here.
The battle for the planet's largest glacier has been lost...

title: The Fate of Vyborg
desc: The city of Vyborg was won by the Soviet Union back in 1940 when Red Army troops triumphed over the Finnish troops. Although the city was eventually retaken by Finland during the Great Patriotic War, many of our Generals believe that with [195.GetName] back in the hands of the [RUS.GetName], we should put some distance between Finland and [195.GetName] and retake what is rightfully ours.

title: [ROOT.GetNameDefCap] Retakes Vyborg!
desc: As expected, our forceds have triumped over the smaller Finnish naiton once again. As a result of this great victory, Vyborg has finally returned to our glorious Motherland. The people of [195.GetName] will rest easier now, knowly they won't have to fear an attack from the north anytime soon.

title: Finland Victorious
desc: Despite the efforts of the Army, the Finnish defence has held and routed our forces. With Vyborg firmly in Finnish hands, their government has not only demanded we relinquish our claims to the reigon but also demanded we demilitarise [195.GetName]. With much of Russia exhausted from decades of warfare, our top advisors have urged the government to accept peace and to focus on rebuilding the naiton.

title: A New Capital for the [ROOT.GetName]?
desc: Now that the Russian people have finally triumphed over Germany, it is time to decide what the future capital of Russia will be. Much of our government have supported the move to return the capital of Russia back to Moscow but there are a great deal of people who believe we should keep the capital here in [ROOT.Captial.GetName].

title: Move the Imperial Capital?
desc: With holy Russia united under our rightful flag, several members of the imperial cabinent feel that the old fortress of Chita has outlived its purpose and have proposed that we move the empire's government in another city more fit to administer the new lands, which would also provide a superior base of operations for the upcoming war with Germany. After much heated discussion and infighting amongst members of government (as well as a personal interjection from our Tsar), the issue of a new capital has been decided...

options.name: Chita shall remain the capital of the Russian Empire for the time being.
Novonikolayevsk will serve the Empire's needs.
The graves of the old Romanovs shall become the foundation of a new Empire.
Vyatka is close enough to Moscow?

title: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] Calls for [ROOT.GetAdjective] Aid!
desc:
As the war between the [GER.GetName] and the [FROM.GetName] rages in Eastern Europe, we have remained as spectators to the fighting.

Until now.

[ROOT.GetAdjective] diplomats have approached our government, requesting weapons and aid in their effort against the Reich. Whilst many in our government sympathise with the Slavs of Eastern Europe who have long endured under the German boot, there are those who fear the consequnces we would face should the Reich triumph over the Russians once more.

options.name: Offer the [FROM.GetAdjective]s our thoughts and prayers.

title: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] Agrees to Send Aid!
desc: After much consideration by the [FROM.GetAdjective] government, they have decided to support our war effort against the Wehrmacht, sending us military equipment, planes and mechanised equipment to suppliment our armies in the struggle against the [GER.GetName].

title: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] Refuses to Send Aid!
desc: Despite our best efforts by our diplomats, the [FROM.GetName] has declined to support our effort against the [GER.GetName]. Our government is highly disappointed by this result but our High Command has urged us to move on from this diplomatic set back and continue on with the liberation of Eastern Europe.

title: A Letter from Russia
desc:
Recently, we have recieved a letter from the President of the Russian Federation, requesting Italian assistance against Germany. The Russians have made a case to our government, citing the constant meddling in the Italian sphere of influence by the Reich and its puppets.

While the Russians indeed make a strong case, the question for Italy now is whether we should risk supporting Russia in their war against Germany or leave the Northern Europeans to their war effort and maintain the Mediterranian status quo.

title: Italy Agrees to Aid our Struggle
desc:
After much debate and discussion by high ranking officals within the Italian government, the Italian Empire has eagerly decided to support the Russian Federation in its effort against the German Reich.

Keen on seeing the Reich suffer the consequnces of its meddling in Mediterranian affars, Italy has provided us with financial resources and investments to help support the Russian Federation's economy and assure Russian victory against the Wehrmacht is achieved with the door for future economic and diplomatic oppertunities in the future.

options.name: Our former enemy, our newest friend.

title: Italy Refuses to Aid our Struggle
desc:
After much debate and discussion by high ranking officals within the Italian government, the Italian Empire has decided to maintain their neutrality, determining that Italy and the Mediterranian nations do not wish to endure the wrath of the Reich and the potential fallout this could cause diplomatically for the Italian government.

This response has been met with disappointment by Russia and her allies.

title: The Fall of Theodorichshafen
desc:
In a magnificent turn of events, reports are coming in that the [RUS.GetAdjective] Army has solidified its control of the city of Theodorichshafen. Initially encircling the city, the [RUS.GetAdjective]s began a brutal siege, during which [RUS.GetAdjective] artillery bombarded naval and shipping ports to prevent supplies from entering the city via transport ship. By the time the [RUS.GetAdjective]s finally assaulted the city, the battered and beleaguered German defenders could put up little resistance. What was left of German high command in the city has reportedly fled across the water in hopes of reaching the mainland to continue the fight elsewhere.
The jewel of German occupied Crimea, Theodorichshafen served as the primary port for Kriegsmarine operations in the Black Sea. The city also acted as the largest hub of Germans on the Peninsula, with nearly the entire city consisting of German settlers and Kriegsmarine officers.
The [RUS.GetAdjective] government has proclaimed the renaming of the city back to its original name of Sevastopol, and have begun the distribution of pro [RUS.GetAdjective] flyers in the streets.

All Germans have been placed on a strict curfew, and all slaves captured by [RUS.GetAdjective] Armed forces have been set free. As the city lies in ruin, the [RUS.GetAdjective] government now must decide what to do with Sevastopol, and the Crimean peninsula as a whole.
With Slavs now as the minority, the task of reintegrating Crimea into the new [RUS.GetAdjective] state won't be easy, and is expected to be a violent ordeal. Local Germans have already begun resistance operations against the [RUS.GetAdjective] occupiers, destroying key infrastructure needed to access Sevastopol and the rest of the peninsula. German high command has announced plans to retake the city and reestablish Kreigsmarine presence in the Black Sea.

Yet for now, Sevastopol lies in [RUS.GetAdjective] hands. With it, [RUSGetUniqueNamePlain]'s grip on the Black Sea has been made absolute, as German naval forces have completely fled to the Baltic Sea. Experts are still uncertain of the wars course, but everyone understands that this is a great victory for [RUSGetUniqueNamePlain], and a crushing blow for the Reich.

options.name: The Black Sea beckons, and [RUSGetUniqueNamePlain] has answered its call.
We'll hold these bastards at the Dniepr.

title: The Fall of Riga
desc:
After weeks of brutal marching across Ostland, the [RUS.GetAdjective] Army has finally captured the port city of Riga. The city's defense was undermined by the lethargic remnants of the Wehrmacht, many of which fled across the Daugava River rather than face the oncoming tide of [RUS.GetAdjective] soldiers. Instead, Riga was defended largely by a motley assortment of militiamen and Hitler Youth. These ramshackle Volkssturm units were entirely combat ineffective, and the [RUS.GetAdjective] Army reports that over ninety percent have been killed or captured.

In the chaos of the Battle for Riga, a brief alliance of Latvian Nationalists and former UPO freedom fighters slipped into the city, sabotaging key supply areas and eventually assassinating the city's Staatskommissar. Due to unclear lines of succession, the Rigan High Command fell into chaos, and after days of infighting the beleaguered Junior Undersecretary of the Ostland NSDAP surrendered the city to the [RUS.GetAdjective]s.

The capture of Riga has been a major national embarrassment for the beleaguered Großgermanisches Reich. Citizens of various Einheitspakt aligned and neutral nations have been forced to flee across the Baltic to Sweden, prompting condemnations of the war's conduct from their governments. Many prominent NSDAP officials have been captured by the [RUS.GetAdjective] army, and are now being transported to the [RUS.GetAdjective] capital to face trial for their crimes.

Riga was the beating heart of Hitler's empire in the Baltics. The city was not only an economic giant, but also served as a major supply hub for the Kriegsmarine in the Baltic Sea. The German Empire's control of the region was tenuous before the war began, and with the loss of such a critical lynchpin it is unlikely that the Nazis will hold the area in their iron grip much longer. Dozens of groups ranging from far-right Nationalists to Landrut liberals to Communists are already urging the [RUS.GetAdjective]s to recognize their government in the bloodied remains of the Ostland Colony. The German hegemony over the area has been shattered forever.

The door to Prussia, and beyond it the slavering heart of the German beast, now lies open.

options.name: Eight hundred years of Kulturträger, refuted in a day.
Fall back to the Vistula, now!

title: The Fall of Smolensk
desc:
Despite the best efforts of the Wehrmacht, the city of Smolensk has fallen to the invading [RUS.GetAdjective] army. The frontlines only reached Smolensk recently, after weeks of gruesome warfare transformed the Moscow theater into a slog through corpse-choked mud. The infamous 51st Panzerkorps led the defense of the city alongside numerous professional and militia infantry formations. Unfortunately for the Nazis, the 51st found itself unable to reproduce its earlier successes in the [RUS.GetAdjective] terrain, as vicious rain turned the field of battle into an endless pit of thick, tarry mud. The numerous German tanks found themselves mired in filth, unable to maneuver or defend themselves. A series of lightning strikes by anti-tank specialists- some suicidal in their nature- ripped the fragile tank formations to shreds, allowing the [RUS.GetAdjective] army to overwhelm the city's defenses.

The [RUS.GetAdjective] victory was compounded by the liberation of a concentration camp located to the west of the city's border. Numerous individuals, including [RUS.GetAdjective] and Polish slaves, Jews, former Zorinist partisans, and even several senior members of the von Saucken revolt have been rescued from conditions described by the [RUS.GetAdjective] commander as "inhumanly evil". Photos of the camp are already circulating throughout the Sphere and the OFN, both of which have offered severe condemnations of the Reich's colonial policies.

The capture of Smolensk sounds the death toll for Reichkommissariat Moskowien at the very least, if not even greater swathes of the German colonial sphere. With the loss of the city, the Reich has completely lost control over the western approach to Moscow. The German strategy has failed, and the Wehrmacht now has little to no ability to project power eastward. The vast [RUS.GetAdjective] army has now secured control over the territory of [RUSGetUniqueNamePlain] proper. Unless the Wehrmacht succeeds in forcing a significant reversal, it is now likely that the war will end with Moscow and the surrounding territories returning to the [RUS.GetAdjective] government.

With the western border of Moskowien now controlled by [RUSGetUniqueNamePlain], further campaigns into Ostland and the north of Ukraine are now not only feasible but likely. Perhaps, with this action, the war has now come within a measurable distance of its end.

options.name: Our motherland will be whole again.
Once this is over, execute the Reichskommissar for his incompetence!

title: The Fall of Paulusburg
desc:
After intense fighting in the city of Paulusburg, it has been confirmed that the [RUS.GetAdjective] army triumphed over the German defenders, repelling them from the city and raising the proud banner of the Motherland in the heart of the Volga city. After crossing the vast Volga River, [RUS.GetAdjective] divisions were swift in storming the city, overwhelming the German defenders as the [RUS.GetAdjective] air force began a bombing campaign over the city, raining hell upon the hastily built fortifications from the skies above. The German High Command quickly fled the city before the city command centre had been captured by [RUS.GetAdjective] special forces, marking a [RUS.GetAdjective] victory.

The heart of the Volga River, the city of Paulusburg was an industrial centre and served as the capital of the Volga region and was one of the first major West [RUS.GetAdjective] cities to be colonised by German settlers with the remaining [RUS.GetAdjective] landmarks left rotting and broken, a dark reminder of the Soviet Unions failure in the Great Patriotic War.

The [RUS.GetAdjective] government declared its intension to revive the [RUS.GetAdjective] identity in the city, renaming the city Volgograd, spreading pro-[RUS.GetAdjective] propaganda throughout the city and reintroducing [RUS.GetAdjective] as the official language. German neighbourhoods are under strict martial law with reports of brutality and lynching of Germans, carried out by the empowered former [RUS.GetAdjective] slaves while local German militias form in the outskirts of the city to fight against the advancing [RUS.GetAdjective] army, sabotaging key infrastructure and [RUS.GetAdjective] military equipment.

The Wehrmacht has declared to retake the heart of the Volga-German region but for now, the city lies firmly in [RUS.GetAdjective] hands as the once divided Volga River basin lies under the complete domination of [RUSGetUniqueNamePlain]. Experts are still uncertain of the wars course, but all are in agreement that this is a great victory for [RUSGetUniqueNamePlain] and a crushing blow for the Reich.

options.name: Now.. what shall we name her?
We'll hold the other side of the river.

title: The Fall of Kiev
desc:
In what many future historians will likely consider being the Penultimate battles of the war, Kiev has fallen to [RUS.GetAdjective] troops. Following many defeats east of the city, the city itself was defended by whatever German units that have survived the [RUS.GetAdjective] onslaught, which were sabotaged at every turn by local Ukrainian resistance who were galvanised by recent [RUS.GetAdjective] victories in the east. Much like in the battle of Moscow, German troops attempted to hold the right bank of Kiev, defending the Dnieper from any crossing, only to be beaten back by the now clearly superior [RUS.GetAdjective] military. When the city was announced to be clear, the city's Slavic population turned out to welcome the [RUS.GetAdjective]s in full.

While the population are jubilant seeing their German rulers evicted from the ancient seat of Eastern Slavic Civilization, questions among the Ukrainian public have begun to be asked about Ukraine's future. Some call for complete independence and entering a defensive pact with [RUSGetUniqueNamePlain], scant few call for complete assimilation into [RUSGetUniqueNamePlain], and the myriad of other voices between those two points have come to light now that the majority of Ukraine has been liberated. Nonetheless, many Ukrainian groups have agreed to hold off on agitating for any particular path until the German threat is completely and utterly defeated.

Outside of Ukraine, the [RUS.GetAdjective] army's victory in fighting for Kiev has been remarked as perhaps one of the final death blows needed to bring the Germans to the negotiations table. As a result, many scholars and pundits have turned away from the question of "Can [RUSGetUniqueNamePlain] win?" and now ask," How will [RUS.GetAdjective] rule reshape Europe?"

A notable exception has been within Germany, whose government remains steadfast in their claim that the loss of Kiev is a temporary setback. However, even among the most adamant of the Regimes supporters, doubt has fully set in, and political actors across Europe are planning for their departure from Germany.

title: The Fall of Baku
desc:
Baku, one of the oil lifelines of the Reich has been severed from its overlord. Along with areas around it, the hard fighting through the mountain ranges of the Caucasus continue to rage on as the [RUS.GetAdjective]s reclaim the black gold they once possessed. The port city itself allowed for some German troops to row off to some of the other smaller outlying islands.

With the loss of Caucasus oil, the already precarious position Germany found itself in has been made even worse; having been cut off from Romanian oil only a few years prior.
Moreover, the gateway to the Middle-East is now firmly in [RUS.GetAdjective] hands; leading to many wondering when Iran cuts off their oil supply to the Germans too. With Germany's economic future plunged into uncertainty, who knows how the German populace will react?

For now, we know only three things for certain: the Panzers have been halted, the Luftwaffe grounded and the Kriegsmarine anchored.

options.name: The gears of the German war machine grind to a halt...
We still have enough oil in our reserves, right?

title: The Fall of Sankt Petersburg
desc:
Long ago the city of Sankt Petersburg had fallen into German hands, after years of siege. Millions had died, millions of Slavic people who had once fully populated the city perished in the cruel siege. The city was razed, and room was made for German settlers. Today, under the heel of [RUS.GetAdjective] invaders, the city returns to [RUS.GetAdjective] control.

The soldiers made their way through the slums were the last few Slavs remained, to the edge of the Baltic Sea where the German settlers lived. The fall of this city has been a striking blow to the stability of German's eastern colony, and the [RUS.GetAdjective]s do not plan to stop at just Sankt Petersburg. The Eagle's empire over the East is beginning its gradual collapse, as the [RUS.GetAdjective]s rip and tear their empire apart.

A problem with the [RUS.GetAdjective] control of the city sits in the air however, as the city is heavily Germanised as a result of civilian casualties in World War II  and the Nazi doctrine of Lebensraum making room for German settlers to flood into the city. It's not like the city could be Slavic majority again without some mass forced movements, or even worse, complete slaughter, but is that inhumane or not? That is a question only the [RUS.GetAdjective] liberators can answer.

options.name: We've got some remodelling to do.

title: The Fall of Tiflis
desc:
Tiflis, former capital of the Georgian ASSR has today fallen to the [RUS.GetAdjective] army: a relatively short battle in what can only be described as a war of attrition in the Caucasus, many predict that this battle will be remembered as the last major battle of the Caucasus front in the Second West [RUS.GetAdjective] War.

The [RUS.GetAdjective] army had been greeted by many partisans in the Caucasus that aided them in the hopes of ending the stratification established during the rule of Josias zu Waldeck und Pyrmont. With the size and strength of the partisans, the [RUS.GetAdjective] army always seemed 2 steps ahead of the Wehrmacht and the colonial garrison.

Encircled inside the city, the 22nd panzer division, supported by colonial regiments tried their best to stop the [RUS.GetAdjective] advance; holding out for an impressive amount of time while turning the city into a pile of rubble.

The peoples of the Caucasus welcome the [RUS.GetAdjective]s for now, and partisan groups have decided to lay their arms down for now as a show of gratitude towards the thousands of [RUS.GetAdjective]s that died liberating their homeland from the oppression of Nazism. Calls for independence remain, but for now, the Georgian people are pleased to be able to pronounce the name of their city once again.

options.name: Undoing that madman's mess, one step at a time.
Fighting in the mountains has never been our forté...

title: The Fall of Arkhangelsk
desc:
Surprising news has come from the [RUS.GetAdjective] front, as the port city of Arkhangelsk has been captured in a joint operation of the Kriegsmarine and the Wehrmacht. Several recently reactivated Kriegsmarine Stoßtrupp Battalions led the attack from the sea, infiltrating the city's port, sabotaging naval vessels, and compromising key defensive areas. Despite heavy casualties the marines were able to complete their objectives in less than four hours of brutal fighting. The Wehrmacht then began shelling the city and [RUS.GetAdjective] military positions from the western approach in an effort to force a crossing of the Dvina river. After nearly three days of artillery fire, the Wehrmacht deployed numerous EFA amphibious bridges, allowing several battalions of lightly equipped infantry to cross the Dvina and enter the city. The [RUS.GetAdjective] army was ultimately unable to resist, and the city surrendered after days of murderous house to house fighting.

The capture of Arkhangelsk is a significant blow to the [RUS.GetAdjective] war effort. Although no longer the political capital of the defunct West [RUS.GetAdjective] Revolutionary Front, Arkhangelsk remained both strategically and economically important as one of the few functioning major ports in Western [RUSGetUniqueNamePlain]. The small [RUS.GetAdjective] navy is unlikely to be able to continue to challenge the Kreigsmarine in the White Sea without control of the city. Rationing in the [RUS.GetAdjective] territories is now likely to become more severe, as important consumer goods once imported from the OFN or Co Prosperity Sphere will now have to travel by land through the port of Magadan in the Far East. While the war is far from concluded, the fall of Arkhangelsk has decisively shifted the momentum of the war behind the National Socialist juggernaut. Key positions in the Ural mountains, as well as the remnants of the [RUS.GetAdjective] heartland, are now exposed to possible Wehrmacht offensives. Without a significant and immediate reversal, it is likely that history will remember this battle as the end of an independent and sovereign [RUSGetUniqueNamePlain].

options.name: Saint Michael the Archangel, defend us in battle.

title: the Fall of Syktykvar
desc:
Despite overwhelming odds, reports from the [RUS.GetAdjective] front confirm that the city of Syktyvkar has been captured by the German Army. Once thought to be unassailable due to the presence of an enormous stockpile of chemical weapons, the center of the former Komi ASSR was robbed of its primary defense when an unexpected air raid collapsed the entrance to the Syktyvkar Arsenal. The Wehrmacht began its assault on the city within hours, forcing the [RUS.GetAdjective]s to rely on conventional weapons to defend themselves. Before the Germans were able to breach the city's perimeter, numerous criminal groups and ad-hoc militias associated with the former parties of the Komi Republic organized to defend their city. Eurasians, Ultravisionaries, Sovereign Democrats, and even survivors of Sergei Taboritsky's OVRI took up defensive positions together to resist the incoming Nazi army. While they fought bravely, their efforts were not enough. After a violent last stand in the National Museum of the Komi Republic, the remnants of [RUS.GetAdjective] armed forces in the city were crushed.

The [RUS.GetAdjective] government alleges that the Wehrmacht has engaged in widespread retaliatory violence against the civilian populace of Syktyvkar. Many survivors report killings of the families of militia and army members, as well as destruction of property, sexual assaults, and seizure of homes to quarter German personnel. Aerial photographs confirm that nearly forty percent of the city has been leveled. The Komi minority is also allegedly being targeted, with some reports suggesting deportations from the frontlines to an unknown fate in Eastern Europe. The German Foreign Office has refused to respond to these allegations.

International observers doubt that the [RUS.GetAdjective] government will be able to effectively resist the German Reich much longer. The city of Syktyvkar is located deep in the territory of Western [RUSGetUniqueNamePlain]. At minimum, the southern approach to Ukhta and the security of the Urals have been heavily compromised. At worst, the loss of a crucial supply hub will result in the conquest of all Western [RUSGetUniqueNamePlain]. Military experts do not believe the [RUS.GetAdjective] military will be able to effectively counter further German incursions at this time. A German victory is now assured- the only question is how much land they will be able to seize.

options.name: A place for all of us, now a home for none of us...
A disjointed coalition of fools stand no chance against an army.

title: The Fall of Astrakhan
desc:
In what marks one of the first major victories in the war, [RUS.GetAdjective] troops have liberated the city named Astrakhan. The city rested incredibly close to the Border that is now covered in [RUS.GetAdjective] troops. Additionally, as the town sits at the mouth of the Volga river, it serves as a critical launching point into the German-held Caucuses.

If the [RUS.GetAdjective] army can maintain momentum, it could mean cutting the germans off from the limited amount of fuel that has so far meant keeping the Reich afloat since the Oil crisis and sending the Reich into a death spiral. Only time will tell if this is a minor setback for the Reich or the beginning of the end of the empire that has held Europe under its Iron Boot for the past several decades.

As for the city itself, the local population welcomed the [RUS.GetAdjective] troops with celebrations. The elderly of the town speak of what they lost when the Germans first came; the oppressed peoples of the city from slaves to the small Buddhist population exchange gratitude with men that they see as liberators; and the young of the town have started to attempt to join the [RUS.GetAdjective] army in an attempt to liberate the rest of Europe from the German's Grasp.

For the rest of the world, This news has brought a great sense of reality to the situation now developing throughout Eastern Europe. War has returned, and the following months will shape history for Billions.

options.name: The Schweinhünde did it again. Plan a counter-attack.

title: The Fall of Grozny
desc:
As war tumbles across Eastern Europe, [RUS.GetAdjective] troops today have taken the city of Grozny. Many of the local German units have begun the process of withdrawal due to the [RUS.GetAdjective] onslaught. Still, the lack of fighting hasn't prevented the mixed response to what a significant portion of the local population regard as simply another army.

Unlike many other cities liberated from the German empire, the scene within Grozny has been far from Jubilant, while not outright hostile to the [RUS.GetAdjective] troops that now step in their streets; many recall previous [RUS.GetAdjective] occupations that were far from peaceful. While the [RUS.GetAdjective]s have taken the city, it will take much more effort to keep the city aligned with the central government. Nonetheless, the liberation of the town has grave implications for the remainder of the war.

With the city under [RUS.GetAdjective] rule once more, the Caucususes are now entirely open, and the critical vein that has kept the German Reich afloat amid the oil crisis will likely be cut in the following days. With another victory for [RUSGetUniqueNamePlain] locked away and the potential loss of the Oil fields, German victory has become dimmer, while [RUSGetUniqueNamePlain]'s has grown brighter.

options.name: "Sister, don't tell mom I'm in Chechnya."
The Chechens will pay for their treachery.

title: The Fall of Vyatka
desc:
Be it Vyatka or Rykov, the city has fallen. The Vodka distilleries created under the Tsardom have been shut down, Wehrmacht Jackboots march through the city, and most can't help but question-Why couldn't we stop this?

The Vyatka river has been polluted, the German army dumping [RUS.GetAdjective] soldiers into the water to poison it, the siege being a fierce and bloody battle. In the end, large-scale tank movements and artillery barrages forced the city defenders to route.

Unlike many other cities, Vyatka has no large-scale partisan front that has formed. The closest thing to a liberation movement is a clique of Red and White officers, working together to disrupt German supply lines; this is expected to fade quickly, however. The further the Germans march east, the more hope fades that we will ever reclaim our unified glory.

options.name: The pearl of the Vyatka, tarnished.

title: The Obliteration of Omsk
desc:
The last major city of Western Siberia has fallen to the German army. With the [RUS.GetAdjective] military in severe disarray, the Wehrmacht has surged ahead in recent days, capturing many villages and towns with minimal bloodshed.
