After sending various massive investments into the traitorous Samara Republic, the Oktan clique quickly found themselves with a nation to run, all in service of their own coffers. As capital flowed across the border, the Oktan clique grew increasingly confident in its own abilities, and so launched their failed invasion of the Reich's eastern territories.

Fatally, they seem to have forgotten the strength of their host. In no uncertain terms, the Reich has decimated the unprepared and incohesive mercenary army, leading to a great loss in profit of Oktan’s clique owed in the form of war reparations. As Russia finds itself without its western benefactor, their future appears more bleak than ever.

options.name: The businessman needs a tighter leash.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Reich Triumphs over the Reykh
desc:
In what most military analysts have considered the most predictable end to a war in the past twenty years, the Second West Russian War has ended in utter disaster for the Russkiy Reykh, with the state being forced to sign a peace treaty with heavy concessions given to the victorious Germans. Across Germania, victory marches have been held in most major cities. In Frankfurt, the mayor declared that the “people of Europe have finally won safety from the reactionaries in the Far East”.

The state across the Reykh is utter chaos as the illusion of ethnic superiority has been shattered beneath the might of the German military. Warlords and anarchy sweeps the countryside as the cities are gripped by strikes. The future of the Russkiy Reykh appears to be short-lived.

options.name: They had no chance of winning.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Hyperborean Might Fails
desc:
As the guns settled on the Second West Russian War, a treaty was signed in Riga between Germany and the nation of Hyperborea. The state of Hyperborea lies in ruins from the loss of almost all of their military might. The drums of war had been beaten all since the reunification of Russia, and yet they have been broken and cast asunder by the might of the German military.

With the economy of Russia reeling with this new defeat etched in the blood of her people, the world looks to see whether this Hyperborean state has long to live. Many experts believe that Russia is soon to shatter, and with it a new age of anarchy will reign supreme over the Russian people. As Germany celebrates its victory, Russia spirals into chaos.

options.name: Damn, now the Germans have an edge...

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Black League Defeated
desc:
The Great Trial has proven to be another loss in the long list of defeats by the Russian state. When the Black League stormed over Germany's eastern border, many throughout the world expected the Russian National Reclamation Government to thoroughly thrash their perceived nemesis. However, after a quick reversal following a particularly harsh winter, the German military managed to recoup its losses.

During their massive retreat towards the interior of the Russian Reclamation Government, many atrocities were committed by the League. The razing of Vyatka alongside other prominent West Russian cities led to widespread international condemnation. The Black League is now alone in their crusade against the Teuton, and as the Wehrmacht approaches the capital of Omsk, some wonder what may occur when the Germans reach the city.

options.name: The free world weeps for Europe.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Russian National Republic Defeated
desc:
The Russian Republican Army set out against the German Reich in an attempt to reclaim not only their nation's territory, but its pride and place on the world stage. However, with the Heer marching further and further into Russian territory and seemingly victorious over the nation for the third time in three decades, it appears their efforts have been in vain.

Vozhd of All Russians, Mikhail Matkovsky, was absent at peace negotiations and has yet to address the nation in the wake of such a shattering defeat, citing health concerns. Despite this, officials within the Republic have announced their continued faith in his leadership in the crisis that is sure to follow. The OFN has released a statement decrying the Reich's "act of Nazi aggression" and expressed token well-wishes towards the Vozhd's government, but few expect the Republic to survive the coming days.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Reich Triumphs over the Federation
desc:
Following the shocking death of Russian president Vasily Shukshin, vice president Alexander Pokryshkin announced today in Novosibirsk that the Russian Federation would be prepared to negotiate a surrender with the German Reich. The free world mourns the loss of its greatest hope to unseat the Reich from its European throne since the 1950s as the Russian people despair over the death of their inspirational leader.

A jubilant victory parade has taken place in Germania following the announcement, and experts have predicted that German leadership will be given carte blanche over the next few years as a result of this triumph. The OFN and the Sphere, on the other hand, are making emergency contingency plans for the Federation following Shukshin’s untimely demise, possibly fearing - or in the Sphere’s case, hoping - that Russia will collapse into ruin.

options.name: We may never be whole again.
The German menace secures its evil empire.
The light in Europe goes out once again.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Defeat of the Communes of the Faithful
desc:
The ongoing battles in the Urals provided strategic momentum for the Wehrmacht, and its command succeeded in securing the surrender of the last motivated forces of the Divine Mandate of Russia. Although all reports of the Russian Patriarch's acceptance of capitulation at the start of the negotiations were dismissed as enemy propaganda, an official communiqué from Novosibirsk confirmed everything.

In his difficult radio address to his demoralized soldiers, Alexander Men said the following: "My faithful brothers and sisters, sons and daughters of Christ, I ask you to stop the bloodshed. Our mission is to save Russia, so we are surrendering not to betray our people, but rather to preserve them where we have not yet lost them!" The population reacted neutrally to this news, but the military was very reluctant. It's difficult to predict what will happen next internally, but it is becoming clear that the dream of a unified, religious Russia has collided with harsh reality.

options.name: Our many sins have led to this...
Ketzer können den arischen Geist nicht überwinden!
As expected, God isn't on the side of the anarcho-socialists.
The shepherd failed to save his distressed flock.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Tukhachevsky's Red Army Victorious!
desc:
In a speech given at Kaunas, Grand Marshal and Premier of the Soviet Union Mikhail Tukhachevsky triumphantly announced to millions watching that the Red Army had successfully beaten back the "fascist vermin" of the German Reich and claimed victory in retribution for decades of occupation. The German government, meanwhile, appears to be in a state of total chaos as the Wehrmacht desperately flees back to Germania.

While international observers have celebrated the defeat of the Reich, concern has emerged over the reconstruction policy of the resurgent Union. Waves of mass purges have begun across Eastern Europe, and German Ostdeutsch are being deported and fleeing from occupied regions en masse, with reports of chemical and biological weapons still ravaging the landscape. It seems that although victory has come to Russia, it has not abandoned its destructive ways.

options.name: The German hordes have been vanquished!
The eagle crashes to the earth.
What will become of Eastern Europe?

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Mathematician's Triumph
desc:
It is a dark day for National Socialism as German soldiers trudged back to their homes, defeated, following the announcement of the Treaty of Riga. The president of the Russian Republic, Igor Shafarevich, made a grand speech in Minsk, proclaiming that “Russia will finally see peace and prosperity return.”

In Germania mass riots have broken out as revolting army units protest the “weak and useless” government. In America the reception has been much more positive, with most American cities erupting into spontaneous celebration at the German defeat, despite the American government's private disapproval of Shafarevich’s authoritarian methods. In Eastern Europe a mass wave of land redistribution from Ostdeutsch to oligarchs is planned, alongside harsh punishments for Communist insurgents. The Russian Bear has won, but it shows no signs of losing its teeth.

options.name: The bear returns triumphantly to the world stage.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Red Army Victorious in the Second West Russian War!
desc:
The Red Army stands tall over Europe as the USSR officially announces their triumph over the German Reich, reclaiming the territories of Bukharin’s Soviet Union for the Union and avenging Russia's defeat in Operation Barbarossa.

Now heralded as the “Marshal of Victory,” Georgy Zhukov, long-tenured leader of the USSR, has issued a series of long congratulatory speeches honoring those who sacrificed their lives in the struggle against the Fascist menace, ensuring that their fight was not in vain. Rampant celebrations among the soviet republics have now been compounded with plans of reconstruction and rehabilitation for the newly-liberated regions, arising a feeling many feared lost forever. As the candles light up across Europe once more, Russia can finally feel its hope returning.

options.name: 30 Years. 3 Wars. Millions of our comrades finally avenged.
The third time is the charm!

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The People’s Union Triumphant
desc:
Jubilant celebrations have erupted across the Russian People’s Union as Batov announced the immediate surrender and collapse of German resistance in Eastern Europe. With the seemingly unstoppable tide of steel having granted the Union several victories in the initial stages of the war, they were able to capitalize on the disorganization and panic that beset the Wehrmacht. The victory has washed away much of the suffering and anguish from the preceding decades, replacing it with a feeling of euphoric triumph over their oppressors.

As rebuilding efforts commence across the newly regained territory, Germany finds itself filled with unrest as the once indomitable German military has been defeated by a once-thought inferior army. Chaos looms on the horizon for the Reich, while the rest of the world looks on with joy as the modern Suvorov has freed the old world.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The USSR Victorious in the Second West Russian War!
desc:
Sergey Bessonov has, broadcasting from within the Soviet Presidium, announced his victory in the Union's long-awaited struggle with the German Reich, effectively reversing Russia's territorial losses incurred 30 years earlier during Operation Barbarossa, and returning the Soviet Union to its position as a World Power.

Reforged by an isolated group of NKVD and Red Army remnants in the Siberian Far East, Bessonov assumed command per-expulsion of the previous Premier Genrikh Yagoda. In contrast with the infamous NKVD Captain of the east, Bessonov has concentrated power around the Party Apparatus rather than himself, advancing the cause of Bukharin within his iron will.

The German Reich alternatively, is in turmoil, with opposition elements blaming [GER.GetLeader] for the Reich's spectacular defeat.

options.name: Glory to Bessonov! Glory to the Soviet Union!
30 years of war. The same combatants, but the opposite result.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Victory of the FSSR in the Second West Russian War!
desc:
The Federation of Soviet Socialist Republics has overcome the German Reich in the Second West Russian War, liberating the former territories of the Soviet Union and cementing Russia's place as the World's premier technological power in the process.

Russia's army, in part due to the use of experimental “wonder weapons,” has secured an impressive victory against the Wehrmacht, in part through the revolutionary will of its leader, Premier [KOM.GetLeader].

With this declaration of victory, the doctrine of Ultravisionary Socialism, and the Soviet Union at large, has entered into a golden age of intellectual prowess. With an endless drive for societal advancement, the FSSR has wasted no time in announcing new plans for the growth of its Soviet "Superculture" within the acquired territories.

options.name: A victory for Russia, socialism, and humanity!
Has the power of the Aryan mind failed us?
Russia has thrust itself into a new, bold future, but will the world follow it?

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Victory of the USSR in the Second West Russian War!
desc:
The newly-reformed USSR has emerged victorious in the Second West Russian War, sending a message not just to the limp fascists of Europe, but the entire world order as we know it.

Burning with desire to avenge the crimes of the past 30 years, Suslov’s Red Army has overwhelmed their German foes with weapons forged in the detailed societal development undergone to modernize Russia under the Soviet Party. Often described as the "Puppet-Master" of the Presidium, the Premier has claimed this victory as the climax of the “immortal science” laid out by socialist theorists before him, promising to expand the triumphant revolution within Russia to those "enslaved by the global imperialist world system". As Eastern Europe smoulders, a new, red dawn arises over the horizon. One to burn those in the way of Suslov's machinations for good.

options.name: The gaze of the Premier shall tear the world asunder.
They clearly failed to learn their lesson!
30 years later, the Soviet Union rises again.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Victory of the USSR in the Second West Russian War!
desc:
The Soviet Union has emerged victorious from its war with the German Reich, redeeming not just Russia, but Bukharin's lineage in the eyes of history.

Originating from a group of socialists within the former Republic of Komi, Nikolai Bukharin's daughter, Svetlana Bukharina, arose to power driven to learn from her Father's mistake. The new Premier has crafted a uniquely open and egalitarian socialism, combatting the Union's material scarcity with a focus on building a societal foundation future generations of Soviet children can thrive upon. Progressive policies on women and minorities in particular stand in stark contrast to those of the now-reeling German Reich, bringing a new hope to those formerly-enslaved underneath the all-encompassing Aryan boot.

options.name: Bukharina will soon meet the same fate as her father.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Black Army Victory in the Second West Russian War!
desc:
In a stunning turn of events, the Russian Black Army has won a resounding victory against the German Wehrmacht, cementing "army-directed" Anarchism as the authority by which the disparate communities of the east shall be governed under. Recently centralized under the leadership of Ivan Stepanov, the reformed Black Army overwhelmed the paralyzed German garrisons with their quick mobility, securing vital logistical hubs before the Reich could effectively respond.

Stepanov's "Security Council of the Free Territory", has declared this a defining victory for their peculiar strain of broadly-defined Anarchism, leaving the German Foreign Ministry in a stunned silence, unable to even acknowledge this humiliating defeat publicly.

options.name: Mother Anarchy has raised a family of proud warriors.
A liberation, or the victory of a kinder oppressor?

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The USSR is Victorious in the Second West Russian War!
desc:
The Soviet Union has prevailed in its eternal war with the German Reich, cementing the victory of the Stalinist ideal not just within Russia, but all of those who look to follow the new "Man of Steel." The Red Army, its offensive potential slowly rising like an orchestra of fire of steel, enveloped the Reichskommissariats in a tidal wave of armor the overwhelmed administrations could not hope to escape alive.

Previously considered "Revisionists" by the more orthodox factions of the CCCP, Lazar Kaganovich's adherence to the principles of the late Joseph Stalin has finally redeemed Russia's place as a world power, but with no mention to those who've been sacrificed to make his cold vision a reality.

options.name: The Man of Steel can now finally slumber.
They caught us off-guard, we must have our revenge!
Seems familiar, but I can't quite place why.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Anarchist Victory in the Second West Russian War!
desc:
In a stunning turn of events, the Russian Free Territory has won a resounding victory against the German Wehrmacht, cementing Vanguard Anarchism as the governing body that the disparate communities of the east shall be united under. Helmed by the idealistic leadership of Pyotr Siuda, the reformed Free Army overwhelmed the paralyzed German garrisons with their quick mobility, securing vital logistical hubs before the Reich could effectively respond.

Siuda, leader of the "Russian Anarchist Council", has declared this a defining victory for their peculiar strain of broadly-defined Anarchism, leaving the German Foreign Ministry in a stunned silence, unable to even acknowledge this humiliating defeat publicly.

options.name: Mother Anarchy has raised a family of proud warriors.
The specter of Anarchism rises in the east.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The USSR Victorious in the Second West Russian War!
desc:
Genrikh Yagoda has, broadcasting from within the Soviet Presidium, announced his victory in the Union's long-awaited struggle with the German Reich, effectively reversing Russia's territorial losses incurred 30 years earlier during Operation Barbarossa, and returning the Soviet Union to its position as a World Power.

Reforged by an isolated group of NKVD and Red Army remnants in the Siberian Far East, Yagoda's Union managed to centralize its authority through the use of ruthless crackdowns and centralized state development. As the acting Premier Yagoda has created an iron party apparatus around himself, advancing the cause of Bukharin within his iron will alone.

The German Reich alternatively, is in turmoil, with opposition elements blaming [GER.GetLeader] for the Reich's spectacular defeat.

options.name: Glory to Yagoda! Glory to the Soviet Union!
30 years of war. The same combatants, but the opposite result.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Victory of the USSR in the Second West Russian War!
desc:
The Soviet Union has prevailed in its eternal war with the German Reich, cementing Khrushchev's unique brand of Socialism as the way that Russia shall be governed. The Red Army, its potential slowly rising like an orchestra of fire and steel, managed to defeat the German Wehrmacht at a great cost in material and men.

Deposing the followers of Stalin under Kagnovich's clique, Nikita Khrushchev is only Premier through the will of the NKVD that keep him there. While by no means a utopia, the USSR has focused on unraveling the Stalinist apparatus through a soft wave of liberalization, enacting "gradual" rights for minorities and rehabilitating Stalin's image among the public, albeit with no mention to those lost within the cogs of his well-oiled machine.

options.name: The hammer and sickle fly high above the yellow fields of our Homeland.
Khrushchev is weak, this Union will fall just like the first!
The old order is cast away, and Khruschev’s USSR has stepped onto the stage.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Soviet Union Triumphant
desc:
The invasion of the Einheitspakt by the Red Army was very much expected, but many predicted that the optimism of the new Soviet Union led by Valery Sablin would be crushed by the black boots of the German Heer. Through a series of guerilla warfare tactics and armored spearheads, they punched through the poorly-defended German lines in the East and retook the former territories held by the Soviet Union, forcing Germany to surrender and proving the doubters wrong.

The Soviet Minister of Foreign Affairs, Otto Braun, promised that the peoples of Europe could once more begin to see the light of freedom through communism, adding that the lands of the new Soviet Union would be rebuilt to their fullest potential. Chaos reigns in Germania as it appears that a new order is rising over the ashes of the old world.

options.name: The Reich’s iron grip has been broken.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Victory of the Russian Republic in the Second West Russian War!
desc:
The Russian Republic has officially won its war against the German Reich as it occupied the former territories of the eastern Reichskommisariats. Led by democratic parties originally from the small Komi Republic, the democratic leadership successfully defended democracy, first from internal threats and then from countless warlords on its path to unifying all of Russia. Now, with the western lands liberated, celebrations have erupted across the Republic.

The government has announced plans for the extension of democracy and emergency aid to these new territories. Meanwhile, the emergence of a new democratic superpower in the old world has had profound implications as pro-democracy protests sweep across Europe, even within the heart of Germany. The torch of liberty shines brighter than ever as it appears the old world is at last free.

options.name: Europe breathes its first free breath in more than 30 years.
The people of Eastern Europe join the free world.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Victory of the Russian Reconstruction Government in the Second West Russian War!
desc:
The Russian Reconstruction Government has officially won its war against the German Reich and occupied the former territories of the eastern Reichskommisariats. Led by Svetlana Stalina, daughter of a Soviet official and ostensible democrat, the Reconstruction Government is in fact a dictatorship committed to the eradication of all “extremist” ideologies. It appears that its mission is a success, as it has won a war against the heart of one of the most extreme ideologies on the planet, National Socialism.

True to its name, the Reconstruction Government has announced plans for reconstruction in the new territories, including suppression of political opponents and the deportation of any remaining German populations. The loss of the eastern territories has struck a massive blow to Germany’s economy, prestige, and military, and it remains to be seen how the German people will react.

options.name: Finally, the Nazi extremists have been beaten back.
Get me the OKW on the line now!

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Democracy Returns to Eastern Europe
desc:
The guns grow quiet upon the Baltic coast and the fields of Ukraine as the German army slowly retreats back to their homeland following the signing of the Treaty of Riga. In their stead, the burning torch of democracy and freedom shines where only darkness once prevailed. The Russian Republic, born in Frozen Tomsk with the dream of pluralistic democracy, has announced an economic liberalization program alongside democratization across the reconquered territory.

In Germania, chaos has broken out as army units revolt against what they see as weak leadership, and students supporting a variety of liberal and socialist causes launch renewed protests. Global observers predict a rapid collapse of German control over Europe, with civil revolts in many of the Pakt’s satellite nations. It remains to be seen what the future holds for the German people.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Russian Federative Republic Is Victorious!
desc:
In an unexpected turn of events, the Russian Federative Republic under President Boris Yeltsin has emerged victorious in its war against the German Reich. Russian forces have finally defeated the Wehrmacht after months of brutal fighting across Eastern Europe. Russia is celebrating the victory, with parades and festivities held in cities all across the triumphant nation. During a speech addressed to the people of Russia, President Yeltsin praised the bravery and sacrifices of Russian soldiers and civilians who contributed to this victory.

The rest of the world is offering their congratulations to the Russian nation on its hard-fought victory. Back in Germany, the Einheitspakt is fraying at the seams as German cities are wracked with chaos. For now, Russia can bask in the glory of their hard-won triumph over what was one of the most powerful nations the world has ever known.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Russia Declares Victory in Europe
desc:
Borderline riotous celebration across not only Eastern Europe but the whole of the free world has broken out as the Russian National Republic formally announced that victory has been achieved over the Einheitspakt in liberating their colonial territories. President Nikolay Petlin has extolled the nation's success as the end to decades of struggle against the forces of fascism and tyranny.

Authorities from the OFN, who have given steady support to the Republic's war effort, gave their deepest congratulations and promised strong financial aid to rebuild liberated Europe. Meanwhile, Germania has been sent into a spiral of panic and unrest as millions of Wehrmacht soldiers attempt to return to the Reich and untold numbers of Ostdeutsch settlers begin to follow suit. The light of freedom shines over the old world once more, unlikely to fade again.

options.name: The torch of liberty is held high, defiant and undaunted.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Victory of the Eurasian State in the Second West Russian War!
desc:
The Eurasian State has officially prevailed in its crusade against the German Reich, driving the so-called "Atlanticists" from Russia's heartland and claiming Moscow as the new capital of Eurasia.

Originating from Lev Gumilyov’s "Passionariyy" clique in the Republic of Komi, Eurasia is a far-right state guided by the belief that the inhabitants of Russia are ethnically and politically tied to the ancient peoples of Asia. Utilizing a stratified hierarchy to unite the disparate Eurasian peoples into one "Superethnos," Gumilyov has showed no sign of stopping his triumphant legions wherever they shall roam, raising considerable concerns from the international community, and the world as a whole.

options.name: The greatest pleasure is to vanquish your enemies, and chase them before you.
Only the Russians could come up with such a perversion of our ideology!

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Zykov Brings Liberation to Eastern Europe!
desc:
Russia has regained her glory as the German surrender is announced by a triumphant Miletiy Zykov. As the Russian Flag is raised over the liberated lands, Zykov has begun promising immediate reforms for the new territories. Local representation will bring democracy to all of Russia, and secret police forces will protect that democracy by snuffing out communists and collaborators before they become a threat.

Foreign observers have been generally positive. The wider American populace has been very positive, even going so far as to hold celebrations of their own. Germany, meanwhile, is fraught with chaos as returning soldiers demand answers for how they could have been defeated by a supposedly inferior foe. A powder keg has been lit beneath the German state, and it remains to be seen what the consequences will be.

options.name: The Steel Curtain is sliced in two.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Imperial Victory!
desc:
Russia can finally celebrate as the German Reich has announced their surrender to Imperial forces in Riga. Finally, after decades of humiliation and strife, the Tsar Of All Russians, Vladimir III, has declared victory over the German menace. Already a national holiday has been declared as the bars fill with men and women celebrating their victory.

For decades the people of Germany had to live under the boot of National Socialism. Many now see this as their time to strike as socialists, democrats, and more have taken to the streets to protest the failure of fascism to succeed against the Russian menace. Meanwhile, America and Japan congratulate the Imperial government of Russia for defeating their sworn enemies as the rest of the world wonders what is next for Europe.

options.name: Since when could Russians win wars?
The Russian eagles soars above the clouds.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]A New Empire Rises
desc:
Joyous news comes from the liberated city of Moscow as Tsar Mikhail II announces victory in the Imperial Reclamation War. The determination and experience of the White Army proved too much to bear for the Wehrmacht as more and more eastern territory was lost to the Russian advance. A day of celebration was declared throughout the country as a parade was held through Trinity Square, finishing with a speech by the Tsar in front of the heavily shelled St. Basil’s Cathedral to rouse his newly liberated people.

German officials refused to comment on their defeat despite reports of public unrest growing throughout the Reich. The nations of the free world and even some members of the Sphere offer congratulations to the Tsar and his nation for their great victory. It seems that Russian monarchism and the Romanov dynasty are back.

options.name: I hope I made them proud.
From the ashes of the bear, the two-headed eagle re-emerges.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Hyperborean Victory in the Second West Russian War!
desc:
When Russia's people finally unified under the banner of "Hyperborea," the world mocked what most observers considered a pariah state. As the guns fall silent over Europe and Velimir's legions now stand triumphant over the primordial lands of the Rus, they have been stunned into a bewildered silence. Cowering in the face of a threat even greater than the one that came before it.

Originating from the so-called "Aryan Brotherhood" in Perm, the man simply known as "Velimir" came to power through the assassination of its previous "Fyurer" Gutrum Vagner, promising to unite the "Slavic master race" under the flag of a mythical ancient civilization known as "Hyperborea." Possessing a drive to liberate the ancient homelands of the "Aryan" in the Middle East, the world cannot tell where, or how, Velimir will strike next.

options.name: This shall be the end of Germany.
Exchanging one 'master race' for the other.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Kingdom of Rus liberates Eastern Europe!
desc:
The Kingdom of Rus celebrates its victory over the German Reich after the Germans finally declared their surrender. Despite its unusual origins, the Kingdom's ability to fuse Soviet modernism with old Tsarist traditionalism has helped in creating a powerhouse that eventually overpowered the weakened Reich both militarily and economically.

Many of the liberated peoples of Eastern Europe were skeptical at first regarding their liberation at the hands of a long forgotten kingdom, but their doubts were soon quelled as Rurik III personally announced that all liberated citizens shall be equal in the Kingdom of Rus along with guarantees of a wide net of social welfare and civil rights. Already, the OFN has hailed the Kingdom of Rus as 'a bastion of liberty in Eurasia' with several delegates sending letters of support and congratulations. The future is bright for the people of Europe.

options.name: His idealism will be his downfall.
A beacon of hope in the East.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Kingdom of Rus Triumphs over the Reich!
desc:
The Kingdom of Rus' soldiers march triumphantly throughout the towns and cities of Eastern Europe as they parade their victory over the German Reich. Already, the banners of the defeated Reich are being torn down and replaced with those of the royal coat of arms of Queen Ronegda I who has begun solidifying her rule over Eastern Europe. In Germany, chaos reigns as soldiers return home, furious at the failure of their government to properly support the war.

With the expansion of the Kingdom comes the burden of integrating newly gained territories. As such, Queen Ronegda has ordered troops to remain garrisoned and for the Oprichniki to weed out any resistance to her rule, be they German werewolves or otherwise. The brutality of her rule coupled with the stratification of the Kingdom's society has left many analysts wondering how the liberated people will react to their supposed liberator.

options.name: A Kingdom of Iron reigns in Europe.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]White Army Victorious!
desc:
After more than half a century of humiliation, the Russian White Army now stands as the undisputed champion over Eastern Europe. Several White Army generals posed for photos after the signing of the Treaty of Riga with the Tsar himself holding the framed treaty.

Despite the defeat of the German Reich, many western observers have begun to question the policies of this new Russian Empire. Particular interest was given to its connections to Manchuria and the rest of the Japanese Co-Prosperity Sphere as both nations were the first to give their congratulations over Russia's victory. OFN watchdogs have raised the alarm over the possible repression that the peoples of Eastern Europe might face due to the harsh stratification present in the Russian Empire. Despite this, the victory is a blow to Nazi power over Europe, and the shadow of fascism recedes over the old world.

options.name: Our military strength failed in our hour of need.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Sergei Bunyachenko Defeats Germany!
desc:
Sergei Bunyachenko of the Russian Liberation Army has announced to the world that he has received word of Germany's surrender. In the same speech, he announced a series of trials against traitors in the eastern territories, along with the deportation of any Ostdeutsch remaining in the occupied land.

International observers’ reactions have been mixed to this victory. While most of the free world have welcomed the German defeat, many are concerned about the ROA’s ties to fascism and their former collaboration with the Germans. In Germania, mass protests from revolting army regiments as well as student unrest has provoked mass chaos. Germany's woes are not at an end yet as its domination of the continent slips further away.

options.name: We have triumphed over the German rats!
Better than the Germans at least.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Mercenaries Victorious
desc:
The mercenary leader of the United States of Russia, Mitchell Werbell III, has announced that they have triumphed over the Germans in their bid to reclaim past Russian territories lost during the Second World War. With Einheitspakt forces being pushed back and the administrations of the Eastern European Reichskommissariats in total collapse, the United States of Russia has achieved an unexpected victory. The German government has remained silent on the matter of their recent defeat, presumably scrambling to stave off internal disorder and collapse.

Mitchell Werbell III has announced that all former Russian territories re-taken by Russian forces will be rebuilt and reorganised into territories that are easier to administer. It has yet to be seen how such a mercenary democracy will take shape, but nonetheless, much of Eastern Europe has risen from the shadow of Nazi rule.

options.name: Russia is back on the world stage.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Matkovsky Triumphant
desc:
The Russian flag proudly soars to the west today as the German government announced its surrender to the resurgent Russian state. Matkovsky and the RFP have never been particularly Germanophilic, and this resounding victory for them has firmly cemented this. Following their victory, Matkovsky announced harsh penalties for any collaborators from the former territories.

In Germany, chaos has broken out as both revolting army units and students, inspired by liberal and socialist ideas, have sent many cities into full blown riots. The OFN has been split on this victory, with some viewing it as a victory against National Socialism, while others view this fascist government as a threat in of itself. However, to ordinary Russians, their country has avenged seventy years of humiliation.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Apprentice Kills the Master
desc:
In a strange turn of events that is surely one of the greatest feats of irony in history, one Fascist state has replaced another. Throughout the last decade, the Rodzaevsky government has managed to reign in a fractured Russia, transforming it into a country that strikes fear into non-Russians and the international community alike. In the process of such a consolidation; Russia has rapidly reindustrialized and developed a fearsome state security apparatus responsible for vast crimes against humanity.

This process culminated with the formal surrender of their national mentor, the Germans, as the east returned to Russian hands. Germany is in chaos at their loss, and the world watches on in horror as the old world is drawn deeper into darkness, the light of liberty perhaps forever scorned from this land.

options.name: The world kneels for our country.
The next generation will show the Slavs their place.
The new world weeps for the old.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Victory of the Russian National Soviet Republic in the Second West Russian War!
desc:
The Russian National Soviet Republic has prevailed in its war against the German Reich, establishing the superiority of Ordosocialism in Russia and shattering the Reich's hegemony over Europe.

Led by the self-professed "New Marx" Ivan Serov, the RNSR is governed by a bizarre fusion of Russian and German ideologies, professing extreme Russian ethno-nationalism and a state-directed Marxist economic system valuing the "eternal struggle of the worker" over tailoring to "hereditary reactionaries." Denounced by leftists and fascists alike, the victory of Ordosocialism may truly cement Serov's manifesto as the next step in socialist theory, despite its more "reactionary" tendencies.

options.name: Serov has saved not just socialism, but all of Russia.
Only the Russians could come up with such a perversion of our ideology!
A crimson sun dawns over Europe.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Artsezo Victorious!
desc:
Shadows descend over Eastern Europe today as Vladimir Artsezo reveals to the public the Treaty of Riga, with vast swathes of Germany's eastern territory being turned over to the Artsezo regime. Mass curfews, show trials, and public executions have already begun across the conquered land, with Artsezo using fear to keep the Eastern European populace under control.

Fiefdoms are being drawn by the Artsezo regime, many of which are given to kleptocrats who have near total autonomy. Policies of compulsory work, exorbitant tax rates, and near enslavement of the citizenry by ruthless corporations has left many wondering if Eastern Europe is better off under its new regime. It appears that, although land has changed hands, Eastern Europe still does not know peace.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Western Conquest
desc:
To many, it seemed an utter impossibility that the Russkiy Reykh could even function as a state, much less conquer the German lands to the west. Now the world is in utter disbelief that both have occurred. The nation, ruled by Gertrum Vagner, has declared that the "German-Capitalists" have been dethroned. He went on to announce further Russynization efforts throughout the conquered territory.

With the reclamation of former Russian territory, German settlers are confused on where to go. Many are staying behind in their new homeland as others frantically return to their ancestral lands. In Germania, there is nothing but silence and anxious apprehension at what will follow. No public reports have been published after the war’s end. Freedom remains extinguished in Europe as a new fascist power rises in the old world.

options.name: The German Army lost to that...?
The only thing lost were hopes and dreams.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Divine Russia Stands Victorious
desc:
After a decade of occupation in Eastern Europe, the Russian people are finally reunited with their saviors - The Divine Mandate of Russia - the victor of the Orthodox Reclamation War. Having successfully defeated and disarmed the garrison forces in the Reichskommissariat Moskowien, Russian Christians severed all enemy supply lines and turned the tide of the war in their favor.

Be that as it may, a peace treaty was signed, under which the German side relinquished hundreds of thousands of square kilometers of territory from the Reichskommissariats - part of its eastern "Lebensraum" - to the Blessed Peacemakers. The scale of the Germans' defeat is staggering, and the consequences of such a defeat will be felt by the Reich's economy for a long time to come. From now on, the world is greeted by a united and peaceful Orthodox Russia, which faces a long period of reintegration, healing, and, most likely, the re-baptism of these liberated vast lands.

options.name: This is truly a miracle of God-let us believe it, brothers and sisters!
Nein, die arische Rasse sollte über allen mythischen Göttern stehen!
No one in the world believed in them, but they believed in the LORD...
Blessed are the peacemakers; they have triumphed.

title: [Get_newspaper_header][RUS.GetNameDefCap] Invades Romania!
desc:
News has emerged from Eastern Europe as war between [ROM.GetNameDef] and [RUS.GetNameDef] has broken out. This comes after the Romanian government refused to hand over the Ukrainian majority lands of Odessa and Nistrenia, which has left the leader of [RUS.GetNameDef], [RUS.GetLeader], no choice but to mobilize the [RUS.GetAdjective] Army and liberate the predominantly Ukrainian region by force.

Nations sympathetic to Romania such as Germany, who have recently lost their Eastern Empire to the rising [RUS.GetAdjective] state, were swift in condemning the [RUS.GetAdjective] government, calling [RUS.GetNameDef] "a warmongering state that needs to be stopped". Regardless of international opinion, it would appear that the [RUS.GetAdjective] forces that had broken the Wehrmacht are now heading towards Bucharest.

options.name: Hold the line against the coming storm!

title: [Get_newspaper_header][RUS.GetNameDefCap] Triumphs over Romania
desc: After several clashes between the [RUS.GetAdjective] and Romanian armies, [RUS.GetNameDef] had — as many international observers expected — emerged triumphant, securing the lands of Nistrenia and Odessa alongside getting revenge on a nation that had participated in the invasion and collapse of the Soviet Union. The Germans were swift in condemning [RUS.GetNameDef], referring to the state as "an immoral nation who has abused its power by striking smaller and relatively weaker nations". The protests of Germany, however, fell on deaf ears as celebrations erupted across Russia. In [RUS.capital.GetName], [RUS.GetLeader] made a rousing speech in response to the nation's victory over Romania. "Once more, the [RUS.GetAdjective] people have enforced justice against an old foe and liberated millions of Ukrainians from occupation!"

title: [Get_newspaper_header][RUS.GetNameDefCap] Occupies Romania!
desc:
Shocking news has emerged from Europe as [RUS.GetNameDef] completely occupied Romania. What was originally a conflict over the lands of Odessa and Nistrenia, regions heavily populated by Ukrainians, escalated as [RUS.GetAdjective] armies continued their advance, eventually capturing Bucharest and establishing a friendly government.

Many nations, predominantly Germany, have been vocal about the war in Romania, referring to the [RUS.GetAdjective] state as a threat to the stability of Europe that is taking advantage of smaller countries unable to defend themselves. [RUS.GetNameDefCap] replied that the Romanian government gave them no other choice but to occupy the nation, or else a belligerent nation would have continued to exist along its border.

options.name: The [RUS.GetAdjective] sphere of influence grows larger.
They left us with no choice.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Republic of Russia Declares War on the Einheitspakt!
desc:
After years of oppresion and dispair, whispers of hope have been heard across Moskowien as the Republic of Russia has formally begun the liberation of Eastern Europe!

Andrey Sakharov, from his home in Tomsk, gave a powerful speech before a crowd of thousands. "By unleashing the full potential of the individual, Russia has risen once more like a phoenix from the ashes! Within a mere decade, we have transformed our Motherland from a divided backwater into the most technologically advanced nation on the planet! People of the world! Witness the true strength of progress!"

In response, the Wehrmacht has been mobilised and rushed off the fight against the technologically superior Russian Republican Army. The world watches on, intrigued as the most advanced army of the planet battles the Reich.

options.name: The Great Test of Russian Democracy

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Russian Federation Collapses
desc:
The dust has finally settled in Russia following the nation's disastrous defeat in the Second West Russian War. The Russian Federation, once a shining beacon of hope for the people of Russia, has officially collapsed, as new governments emerge from the remnants of the Russian homeland. Millions across the globe watch on in horror as anarchy grips Russia once more.

This comes after the failure of the Russian Federation to retake the Russian city of Moscow from Germany, which was followed by the suspension of democracy by the unelected Alexander Pokryshkin, prompting internal unrest which soon reached a boiling point. Millions across the remains of what was once Russia weep as the dream of a united Russian state is buried with the late Vasily Shukshin, perhaps forever.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Compromise over Transnistria Reached
desc:
Negotiations in Moscow took place today after the governments of Russia and Romania agreed over the territorial claims that Ukraine holds against Romania. In the agreement, the Romanians offered to transfer the state of outer Transnistria to the state of Ukraine and renounce any claims over the region.

[NOVGetOdessaStatusWorldEvent]

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Russian Federation joins the Organisation of Free Nations!
desc:
In a press conference in Moscow, Russian President Vasily Shukshin has declared that after some negotiation, the Russian Federation can finally begin the process of formally joining the Organisation of Free Nations!

The American government has responded to this development with great enthusiasm, happy to have the touted Fourth Power join the ranks of the OFN. "The Russian President and I have become great friends recently, his eagerness to ensure the freedom and safety of his people is admirable and I look forward to working with him going forward" President [USA.GetLeader] commented in response to this new development.

As American and Russian flags wave in Moscow and Washington, some are worried about the increased tensions this will cause, with having a powerful American ally now on the doorstep of both the Einheitspakt and the Co-Prosperity Sphere.

options.name: The Free World just got even bigger!

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Birth of the Collective Security Treaty Organisation
desc:
The Russian Federation, recently arisen from the ashes of the Soviet Union, has seemingly defied all international expectations with the founding of the Collective Security Treaty Organisation, a military alliance spearheaded by the Federation aiming to stop all incursions into Eurasia by the Einheitspakt and the Co-Prosperity Sphere.

President Shukshin declared in Novosibirsk that the Russian Federation and her people needed to be in charge of its destiny going forward, stating “Russia needs to bear the weight of its responsibilities once more. We must be able to take action when it is necessary and to be able to remain neutral without bearing obligations to foreign nations”.

The Einheitspakt and the Sphere have not been receptive of the formal entry of another superpower into the Cold War, declaring Russia's recent actions to be upsetting the already fragile global balance.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The West China War!
desc:
Since the late 1940s, Japan has held a stranglehold over the Chinese government. While the Mainland is under de jure control of the Republic of China, western China has notoriously maintained de facto independence as a series of unrecognized warlord states. The Russian Federation has recognized the Ma Clique; a KMT-remnant headed by the Ma Clan as the legitimate government.

The Clique has since taken military action against several notable warlords, and the Tibetan government. Military shipments from Japan to Tibet are sent through airlifts. Other warlord factions have refused Japanese support. The response from the Einheitspakt is entirely neutral. The OFN, however, has shown some interest in the development of a rival government to Japan. Will a beacon of hope rise in China?"

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Mountain War
desc:
Another war long in the making has broken out in the mountains of the Caucasus. The centuries-long conflict between the Turkish and Armenian peoples burns bright once more.
\The war comes after the recent seizure of Reichkomissariat Kaukasien by the Russian Federation following its victory in the Second West Russian War. Many international observers have accused of reigniting the conflict through openly supporting the Armenian rebels.

As soldiers and partisans clash in the hills and mountains of Armenia, this conflict may very well determine if the world will witness the rebirth of a free Armenian democracy, or the eradication of Armenia as a people and a concept.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Steppe Alight!
desc:
On the vast plains of Mongolia, civil war rages as the Mongolian people under the leadership of Mongolian democrat, Natsagiin Bagabandi, rallying the Nomads of the plains and the remnants of the former Peoples Front under the banner of a free Mongolia.

The Japanese Empire has dismissed the rebellion as a minor revolt, stating that the military forces of Mengjiang are more than equipped to deal with the rebels. The international community, however, is far more sceptical of Mengjiang's strength, taking note of the unusually modern military equipment the Mongol rebels wield on the battlefield.

As the steppe burns once more, some are left to wonder whether the Co-Prosperity Sphere will continue to dominate East Asia or will this conflict be the first of many that will lead to the downfall of Japan's Empire.

title: [Get_newspaper_header][RUS.GetNameDefCap] Declares War on Kazakhstan!
desc:
What many across the steppes of Central Asia feared for years has come true. Russian tanks and troops flood across the border into Kazakhstan yet again.

With Russia unified into a single state, the question of Kazakhstan's continued independence had been hotly contested by both Russian and Kazakh states. Eventually, tensions resulted in an ultimatum demanding the complete demobilization of the Kazakh Armed Forces. The Kazakhs refused, cutting off all ties with the Russian state and mobilizing its army to the border.

While the international community denounced the ultimatum as nothing more than continued Russian aggression, nothing could prevent the declaration of war that shortly followed. While the Kazakhs may give it their all, a swift conquest and subjugation is all but assured.

options.name: Don't say we didn't warn them!
The Russian eagle spreads its wings once more.

title: [Get_newspaper_header][KAZ.GetNameDefCap] Joins the [RUS.GetFactionName]!
desc:
After a tense round of negotiations in the Kazakh capitol it has now been officially announced that Kazakhstan has joined the [RUS.GetFactionName], reestablishing Russia's influence in Central Asia once more.

Many across the world feared that a united Russia would merit yet another incursion into Kazakhstan for the sole purpose of reintegrating the steppe country back into the motherland, as it had been for hundreds of years shackled to the Imperial Tsar or Soviet Chairman. But, with Operation Barbarossa and the collapse of both Russia and Kazakhstan into Warlordism, that dominance had finally been broken, with both countries suffering massively as a result.

That suffering has instead manifested into a brotherhood. Forged out of the fires of anarchy Kazakhstan and Russia now stand together as one, solidifying Russia's influence in Central Asia once again while granting Kazakhstan its long-sought independence. Whatever the future may bring for this new brotherhood, it is clear now that the cycle of Kazakh subjugation has been definitively shattered. It seems after centuries of slavery and suffering, the people of Central Asia can finally breath once more.

options.name: We stand not as subjects or masters, but as brothers.
It seems time heals all wounds after all.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Democratic Revolution in Germany!
desc:
In the aftermath of the Reich's crushing defeat in Eastern Europe, what was once thought to be small scale student protests and riots has finally escalated into an outcome seldom few anticipated: the end of the Third Reich.

Earlier today, a group of protestor-led militias rallied around the leadership of anti-fascist resistance group Reichsbanner Schwarz-Rot- Gold, led by "Spartakus," or partisan Willy Brandt, and stormed the Volkshalle, routing the remaining Nazi government. Brandt declared in a speech soon after that the Reich was now "defunct" and that in its place now stands the newly established German Republic.

The Führer has fled Berlin as sects of the Wehrmacht clash over whether to side with Brandt's government and paramilitaries terrorize the country. While Germany now breathes free, it does not breathe easy.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Martin Bormann Has Died
desc:
The Reichstag has announced a four-month mourning period following the tragic death of Führer Martin Bormann from terminal lung cancer. The news of his loss comes as a shock to the German public, who were uninformed of the Führer's worsening health. The news comes amidst rapidly worsening terrorist attacks on the Reich's officials and infrastructure.

The brutal dismantlement of internal factions within the government has left the throne in Germania open to Martin Bormann's chosen successor, however, they must contend with open disloyalty in the streets and increased pressure from abroad. The USA and Japan are sure to take advantage of this moment of weakness, with the Russian bear growing ever more dangerous as well. The specter of change looms over the Reich, and one thousand years may be too short for Bormann's successor.

options.name: Who will keep the German Eagle flying now?

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Gerhard Klopfer Succeeds the Führership
desc:
The Reichstag has announced its endorsement of Gerhard Klopfer, the former Deputy Führer, as the successor to the late Martin Bormann. As expected from a man of such high authority in the Reich, he has enjoyed the vast support from the predominantly conservative bureaucracy and military to secure his own reign in the Reich.

At the doors of the Volkshalle, Klopher lionized the former Führer's commitment to maintaining the Reich's prosperity and security from traitors among its government and army. Klopfer also promised the expansion of policies to achieve complete recovery from the economic shocks of the Oil Crisis, and to crush the resurgent leftist terrorist movements nipping at the Reich. Through this, the Führer has guaranteed that Germany will be able to resume greater projects as the Reich marches into modernity.

options.name: The Reich's protege shall continue its one-thousand year reign.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Reinhard Gehlen Succeeds the Führership
desc:
Following the death of Martin Bormann, the Reichstag has finally announced that the head of the Strategische Unterstützungspolizei, Reinhard Gehlen, has been recognized as the next Führer. Bolstered by the OrPo's extensive influence and government administrators who fear the surge in anti-fascist terrorism within the Third Reich, Gehlen spoke before the Volkshalle promising a future for the Reich and its people free from “Judeo-Bolshevik infiltration and terrorism".

Some suspect that Gehlen will consolidate his power by expanding the Reich's security services throughout the Pakt and in the fatherland, perverting Hitler's legacy into a deformed memory of National Socialism. Still, others are hopeful that the terror bombings and riots will cease under his watchful eyes.

options.name: The Reich's watchman gazes over his new empire.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Kurt Waldheim Succeeds the Führership
desc:
The Reichstag has announced that the acting head of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Kurt Waldheim, will serve as the next Führer. A dark horse in the power struggle within the Nazi Party, Waldheim was spared by Bormann despite his reformist biases, supposedly due to betraying Baldur von Schirach. His rise to prominence is openly supported by powerholders such as the Wehrwirtschaftsführers and what remains of the German intelligentsia.

Waldheim has announced an emphasis on accelerated detente with the world's superpowers. Whispers also suggest that Waldheim may revive the "Koalition Der Nationen" concept developed by Speer's bloc. Regardless of his intentions, the first Aryan diplomat must navigate a world defined by Hitler's bellicose policies, and soon to be wracked by a new war in the East.

options.name: You may cooperate, or you may submit.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Klopfer's Purge
desc:
The Reichstag has declared the start of a comprehensive purge within the Nazi Party under the direct command of Führer Klopfer, a necessary countermeasure to prevent infighting among the ranks of the government. These purges have expanded to sweeping through non-government civilian organizations too, following the instability suffered from the Oil Crisis, the resurgence of student protests, and the death of Martin Bormann.

Throughout the streets of Germany, increased OrPo and Wehrmacht presence has accompanied the purge, intending to quickly quell the student riots and to deter leftist terrorist cells. International observers report not only the brutalization of protestors but the demotion, imprisonment, or exile of their families. Remnants of the reformist and militarist factions have been publicly executed along with their wives and children.

options.name: Treason will be torn out by the roots.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Gehlen's Purge
desc:
Terrible news has come from Germany. A third purge of "traitorous and Communist elements within the Reich" has begun at the direction of Führer Gehlen, who was reportedly injured in a bombing by an RAF cell in Germania. The bombing killed several civilians, local OrPo officers, and high ranking bureaucrats, but failed to eliminate its primary target.

Along with the bloody purge of civilian, military, and bureaucratic ranks, Gehlen has ratified the Vaterlandsschutzgeset, a law containing expansions to the OrPo's legal powers and provisions which would loosen extrajudicial searches and arrests on dissident elements within the Reich. Although the law has been accepted with warm praise from the Nazi Party, international observers note that early critics of the law were not present at the signing, some of which have not been seen in public for several months.

options.name: The Reich's watchful eyes will never rest.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Waldheim's Purge
desc:
Citing a noticeable destabilization in the Nazi party following the Reich's defeat in the Second West Russian War, the Führer has launched a swift purge of subversive elements within his government. Using documents salvaged from the Bormann and Hitler regimes' archives, Waldheim's government has sentenced numerous officers, politicians, and bureaucrats to imprisonment or death for corruption and treason.

Lost amidst the German media's focus on these "traitorous elements" are measures being taken against non-governmental dissidents, especially student protestors. Student protests have notably quieted recently, and several major leaders in the protests have quietly disappeared. Instead, young men and women loyal to Führer Waldheim have been promoted in the German media, and encouraged to "keep an eye" on their classmates.

options.name: The Reich's welcoming hand has closed into a fist.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]General Heusinger's Coup
desc:
In the aftermath of the Second West Russian War, public and institutional faith in Martin Bormann's successor has never been lower. Spurred on by fears of stagnation and reprisals, a clique of National Socialist army officers led by General Heusinger have couped the civilian government in Germania.

Führer Heusinger has promised to use military discipline and Aryan might to rejuvenate and rebuild the German nation. New public works and the inauguration of "economic struggle" are the basis of his public policies. Yet, Heusinger's brief leadership has also been characterized by the bloody assassination of the remaining Bormannites and their supporters. Tensions are only expected to worsen as the radicalized Wehrmacht tightens its grip over Germany's husk.

options.name: For the Fatherland, against Judaism and sloth.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Speer Resigns the Führership
desc:
Overwhelmed by backlash to the Reich's defeat in the Second Russian War, Führer Albert Speer has officially declared his resignation citing “overwhelming health concerns". In a statement before the Reichstag, Speer appointed a new government "consisting of honorable men who will fulfill the obligation to continue our national struggle".

Notable members of the new government include Deputy-Führer Kurt Kiesinger, the new Reich President, and Helmut Schmidt, who has been appointed Reich Chancellor. The leaders of the "Gang of Four", a group of bureaucrats believed to have worked from the shadows to restore German democracy, have revealed a comprehensive plan to "restore the prosperity we enjoyed under Hitler". Early plans include the acceleration of liberal-democratic reforms and the elimination of eugenic and racial policies.

options.name: The Sun sets on Hitler's New Order.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Volkshalle Address
desc:
In the aftermath of the Reich's defeat in the Second West Russian War, Führer Albert Speer has taken the reins of government once more. In a speech before the Volkshalle, Speer declared that "Jewish and liberal-Bolshevik sabotage" was responsible for the disaster in Eastern Europe. Speer stated that disloyal elements assassinated intelligence assets, intercepted key orders, and muddied military trade deals in order to overthrow the Reich.

All promise of progressive reform in the Reich has been shattered. Helmut Schmidt and Hans Speidel have been swiftly arrested, and a new Sondergericht seems to be growing on the horizon. Ties with radical student movements have been repudiated as weak and naive, and radicalized settlers returning from the East are already calling for the Führer to dismantle all liberal influence in Germany.

options.name: This is how democracy dies, with quiet gasps for help.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Speer Resigns the Führership
desc:
In the aftermath of the Reich's defeat in the Second West Russian War, Führer Albert Speer has unexpectedly declared his resignation citing “overwhelming health concerns". In a statement before the Reichstag, Speer appointed a new government "consisting of honorable men who will fulfill the obligation to continue our national struggle".

The new government seems to have been primarily formed around Deputy-Führer Kurt Kiesinger, the new Reich President. Other notable members include Otto Ernst Remer as head of the Wehrmacht and Martin Mussgang as Reichschancellor. Foreign Minister Helmut Schmidt is notably absent from the lineup, leading many to suspect he may have been forced out of the halls of power. When asked to comment on the matter, Kiesinger stated that "in the new Reich, men earn the position they deserve."

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Wehrmacht Putsch
desc:
The streets of Germany are filled with Wehrmacht patrols and tanks. Marshal law is the order of the day, as Reichsmarschall Hans Speidel has seized control of the government.

Following the Reich's defeat in the Second Russian War, the National Socialist government was unable to effectively bring an end to the chaos. Infighting between Führer Speer and his own cabinet only exacerbated the matter, as bureaucratic dysfunction and rumors of bloodless coups condemned Germany to rapid decline. The military, bloodied and angered by what they saw as a loss due to civilian interference, threatened most of the NSDAP into public mass resignations. While the Wehrmacht will undoubtedly prove more effective leaders than Speer, Speidel's "apolitical Führership" is not necessarily a liberalizing force, and advocates of a free Germany may yet see their hopes dashed.

options.name: In the New Order, speeches stand no chance against tanks.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The New Sondergericht
desc:
Despite the Reich's victory in the Second West Russian War, Führer Albert Speer has announced that treason and dissent resulted in "unacceptable military and political deficiencies" during the conflict. A second Sondergericht has begun. Many dissidents in the radical wings of the party, including former Minister of Foreign Affairs Helmut Schmidt, far-right figures such as Theodor Oberlander, and apolitical leaders such as Hans Speidel have been arrested and put on trial for treason and sedition against the Reich.

As the German masses bay for blood, international observers denounce the thinly-veiled pogrom as nothing but a purge of the most democratic elements of the government. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has guaranteed that the Reich will not return into stagnation, and will still be “open for trade”.

options.name: The Reich shows its true colors.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Speer Resigns the Führership
desc:
In the aftermath of the Reich's victory in the Second West Russian War, Führer Albert Speer has unexpectedly declared his resignation citing "overwhelming health concerns". In a statement before the Reichstag, Speer appointed a new government "consisting of honorable men who will fulfill the obligation to continue our national struggle".

Notable members of the new government include Deputy-Führer Kurt Kiesinger, the new Reich President, and Helmut Schmidt, who has been appointed Reich Chancellor. The leaders of the "Gang of Four", a group of bureaucrats believed to have worked from the shadows to restore German democracy, have revealed a comprehensive plan to "continue Führer Speer's legacy" and "build a Reich to last a thousand years". Early plans include the acceleration of liberal-democratic reforms and the elimination of eugenic and racial policies.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Willy Brandt Assassinated!
desc:
Willy Brandt, leader of the German Democratic Revolution, is dead.

The Reichsbanner head was fatally shot at a political rally early this morning in what Berlin is deeming a "deliberate and politically motivated attack" by the reactionary "Werwolf" terrorist organization. The Bundestag has declared an official state of emergency as various paramilitary groups and militias fight in the streets. Socialist agitators, Nazi sympathizers and even sects of the remaining Wehrmacht have begun to openly clash and seize control of local regions.

Panic and fear has swept across the former Reich as any semblance of control continues to violently collapse, plunging the already-reeling nation into a sense of anarchy. With the nation in tatters, it seems that Brandt's dream for German democracy may be swept into the pages of history just as quickly as it began.

options.name: A dark shadow creeps over Germany.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The German Civil War Begins!
desc:
Incoming transmissions from inside the capital of Germania have confirmed rumors of a massive struggle occurring within the Reich. With Reichsbanner unable to assert its authority any longer, the reality has become clear: the German Reich, Europe's largest empire in history, has fallen into civil war.

Despite attempts by Germania to restore order following Willy Brandt's assassination, Werwolf paramilitaries to the south began an armed rebellion against the new democratic coalition, destroying all hopes of a peaceful resolution to the conflict, with various other factions gnawing to claim every piece of land possible while Genscher’s Republican Army fight tooth-and-nail to keep Germania secure.

The fires of war have ended the New Order, and brought the tumultuous start of another.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Argentina Takes the 1974 World Cup!
desc:
In a nail-biting match, the Argentine National Football Team secured a narrow victory against the Deutsche Fußballnationalmannschaft. The long journey to the championship has been a challenge to the team, but under the guidance of the team's coach, César Menotti, they have proved their worth on the world stage and to their fellow countrymen.

Their opponents, the national team of Germany, took the defeat graciously, as the German coach Georg Buschner was seen shaking hands with his adversary. Upon his return to [64.GetName], however, Bushcner announced his retirement, citing his deteriorating health, although rumors have circulated that the German government demanded his resignation following the defeat. For the most part, the world is jubilant as Argentina has shown her mettle on the field, and the German nation now wallows in defeat on the sports field.

options.name: A devastating blow to German pride.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]1976 Tangshan Earthquake
desc:
In the early morning today, a catastrophic 7.6 magnitude earthquake hit the Tangshan province in China. The nation's President, Gao Zongwu, has called for immediate and drastic aid and directed significant state funds to the affected area. Experts estimate around 100,000 have died, but with thousands missing and more in critical condition, this number may rise exponentially shortly.

The response from the Co-Prosperity Sphere has been sympathetic yet muted, with Tokyo giving token funds to the reconstruction effort but remaining hesitant to provide crucial aid with the effects of the oil crisis still lingering over the country. The Manchurian and Mongolian governments, who also saw significant damage from the disaster, also petitioned for aid, but no more Japanese money seems to be forthcoming, and no end seems to be in sight for the beleaguered nations of East Asia.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Ted Bundy Caught
desc:
The notorious Campus Killer Theodore Robert Cowell, better known as Ted Bundy, has been apprehended by local police in the Florida city of Pensacola. Bundy had been arrested on multiple prior occasions but has consistently escaped custody until now. The killer is notorious for strings of murders and kidnappings of young women, possibly dating back to the 1960s. Surviving victims describe Bundy as incredibly charming and charismatic, which he used to lure women to their deaths.

Following his arrest, ties have now been made to several other disappearances and murders in various states and counties across several years. Bundy has been imprisoned awaiting trial at an unannounced date. While the case itself may take time to be held, few expect anything but a guilty verdict with the slew of evidence against him.

options.name: He escaped custody how many times!?

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Invention of the MRI!
desc:
A monumental victory for modern medicine has been revealed today in the MRI, or magnetic resonance imaging machine, formally presented to the world by American chemist Paul Christian Lauterbur with his partner, British physicist Peter Mansfield. The device allows for detailed scans of human anatomy never before possible in science, allowing for a more straightforward diagnosis of several conditions, particularly in the brain.

With this astounding achievement, the United States has increased project funding and assisted the duo in producing prototypes for use outside of project testing. The response in the scientific community has been resoundingly positive, with the practical use of the device for hospitals sure to come shortly the world over.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]SALT Agreement Signed
desc:
A series of talks between the United States and the Empire of Japan over many weeks have culminated in the SALT Agreement, or Strategic Arms Limitation Talks. Two separate agreements were reached between the superpowers, the Treaty on Anti-Ballistic Missile and the Interim Agreement and Protocol on Limitation of Strategic Weapons, aimed towards lowering nuclear production and preventing any escalation in the nuclear arms race between the two powers.

With these treaties and agreements, the world begins to breathe more easily and take the initial steps to ease away from the risk of nuclear annihilation. However, many speculate behind closed doors as to the staying power of the treaty, especially as any genuine disarmament is prevented by Germania's refusal to participate, and its role as a starting point for further talks cannot be understated.

options.name: A first step, but not the last.
The clock moves away from midnight.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]World Trade Center Opened in New York
desc:
Early this afternoon, the towers of the new World Trade Center have been formally opened to the celebration of many in the United States and abroad. Several figures in local and national politics, in addition to NYC real estate moguls, were present at the opening of the building, now classed as the tallest in the world. Minoru Yamasaki, a Japanese-American citizen who has become a local hero and image of the American Dream, has also earned many congratulations.

Many countries have congratulated the United States on opening the economic hub, particularly within the OFN, and the Japanese government has extended special praise to Mr. Yamasaki. It appears ties within the global community have only continued to grow in equal step with the new heights reached by the twin towers.

options.name: A new commercial hub in the Big Apple.
They'll never match the elegance of the Volkshalle!

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Sydney Opera House Opening
desc:
Yesterday, the Sydney Opera House, a multi-venue performing arts center in the heart of Australia, was opened to overwhelming applause and is already beginning to be regarded as one of the most distinctive and iconic buildings of the 20th century. The Opera House occupies all of Bennelong Point in Sydney and is set to hold its debut venue in a few months.

The Opera House is jointly operated by three companies and is estimated to become one of the most popular attractions in Sydney. Many heralded the site as a new cultural center and wonder of the world in a land few know for its artistic contributions to the world. The Australian Prime Minister is expected to visit the first venue held at the Opera House in the coming months as a new center of the arts makes waves in New South Wales.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Civil War Engulfs Kazakhstan
desc:
International interest in Central Asia has been renewed after decades of silence as order in Kazakhstan faces utter collapse. Previously under the control of remnant Soviet authorities, various factions have seized vast swaths of the country and the former SSR's territory has been reduced to the deserts of the steppe.

While most eyes appear to be far from the nation, more regional powers have taken a great interest in the development. The Polish diaspora authority in Uralsk has directly intervened in the conflict, attempting to 'pacify' the region, while the fledgling states that constitute former Russian territory have begun to intervene directly in a gambit to see what international interests they have protected. The Steppe has been set aflame, and its fate rests in the hands of the solemn few desperate enough to fight for it.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Rocky Releases in Theatres!
desc:
Americans across the country shuffled into cramped theaters for a chance to see the country's next big Hollywood hit, a small-time production by the name of "Rocky".

Produced by actor-director Sylvester Stallone, the film follows the career of Rocky Balboa, a struggling boxer on the streets of Brooklyn, and his quest to topple the reigning champion, Dolph Eichmann. While the challenger faces many setbacks on his journey, including the death of his best friend Apollo Creed, the story concludes with Rocky toppling Eichmann in the Reich's capital of Germania, claiming the championship for himself and his country.

While panned by some for its overtly pro-American sentiments, "Rocky" has proved to be a massive box-office hit both domestically and internationally, cementing America's cultural significance in the ongoing Cold War.

options.name: They can only beat us in fantasy!
An inspiring tale, or American propaganda?

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Release of Gray Dusk
desc:
Today, flocks of Americans are visiting the movie theaters for a recent film to hit the reels: Gray Dusk. Set in an alternative universe, the German Reich had successfully launched a naval and air invasion of the United States. The movie, set in rural Colorado, is centered around a group of high schoolers-turned-resistance fighters engaging in a guerilla campaign against the invading Germans.

While the movie has set box office records within the United States, critics have pointed out the unrefined nature of the film, as it comes across as 'cheesy' more than a genuine film. Despite massive success at home, the viewing of the film was outright banned within Germany, including its sphere of influence. Conversely, some success has been found within the Asian market, signaling to Hollywood that Asia could be a new, unexplored market for future film releases.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Fourth Power Emerges
desc:
The United States and Japan have announced a startling discovery today. Geological facilities in Alaska and Hokkaidō have detected a sudden and intense uptick in seismic activity coming from the Russian Arctic. The seismic event lasted 4.8 seconds, had no aftershocks, and airborne radiation was picked up shortly after. All of this could only mean one thing, [RUSGetUniqueNamePlain] has successfully tested a nuclear weapon.

Germany has already condemned the Russian State, claiming that it is a very blatant step toward hostilities with the Reich. However, the Russian government assured that this was only done so as to ‘protect their sovereignty against outside aggressors’. Tensions begin to rise between the two European powers, who have had a score to settle since the end of World War Two.

options.name: We will do what we must...
A clear sign of their vile intentions!
The clock once more ticks to midnight...

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Russian Incursion into Manchuria
desc:
Tensions in East Asia have boiled over following a Russian incursion into Manchuria. Hasty reports from the ground reveal that multiple divisions have crossed into Hailanpao, engaging in combat with local Kwantung forces.
