The cities of Blagoveshchensk and Nikolayevsk have suffered continuous shelling, with reports suggesting that Russian troops have been using the local supply routes to overwhelm the forces.

Xinjing and Tokyo have condemned the incursion, branding it as an "indisputable violation of sovereign Chinese territory.", with Xinjing confirming that its forces have been already mobilized to respond to the incursion. Tokyo for its part has yet to mobilize its own forces, seemingly confident in the abilities of the Kwantung Army to defeat Russia which only just emerged from decades of civil war.

options.name: A necessary fight for the liberation of Russian people.
Hopefully not the start of another war.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Russian Incursion into Manchuria
desc:
Tensions in East Asia have boiled over following a Russian incursion into Manchuria. Hasty reports from the ground reveal that multiple divisions have crossed into Niuleimanho, engaging in combat with local Kwantung forces. The cities of Blagoveshchensk and Nikolayevsk have suffered continuous shelling, with reports suggesting that Russian troops have been using the local supply routes to overwhelm the forces.

Xinjing and Tokyo have condemned the incursion, branding it as an "indisputable violation of sovereign Chinese territory.", with Xinjing confirming that its forces have been already mobilized to respond to the incursion. Tokyo for its part has yet to mobilize its own forces, seemingly confident in the abilities of the Kwantung Army to defeat Russia which only just emerged from decades of civil war.

options.name: A necessary fight for the liberation of Russian people.
Hopefully not the start of another war.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Black League over Manchuria
desc:
In the wake of the swift and thorough Russian incursion across the Manchurian border, the Black League has secured a decisivie victory over Manchuria. After losing their last stronghold in the region, the Kwantung Army has conducted a disorderly retreat across the Amur River while being harassed by the Russian air force. The invasion, which saw intense urban combat and artillery barrages across a wide front, has led to the greatest destruction seen in the region since the Second World War.

While the Black League has yet to formally acknowledge any hostilities, Tokyo lifted its uneasy silence by declaring that any further incursion on Chinese territory will result in an immediate response from the Japanese Military. As the guns fall silent, an uneasy peace returns to Manchuria while both sides entrench themselves along the river.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Manchuria over the Black League
desc:
In the wake of a swift and brutal Russian incursion across the Manchurian border, the Kwantung Army has achieved a decisive victory, driving the Black League back across the Amur River. After intense urban combat and relentless artillery barrages, Manchurian forces successfully held their ground, launching a counteroffensive that shattered Russian supply lines and forced a chaotic retreat.

The battle, which saw devastation not witnessed in the region since the Second World War, has left much of the borderlands in ruins. Despite their victory, Manchurian forces remain on high alert, with defensive positions being reinforced along the river in preparation for any renewed hostilities. Tokyo, breaking its uneasy silence, has issued a stern warning that any further Russian aggression will be met with full military force.

options.name: It wasn't supposed to be like this.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Black League Invades Central Asia
desc:
The Omsk-based government of Russia has launched a full-scale invasion of the entire Central Asian region with the stated goal of reclaiming what it sees as rightful territories. The outbreak of war was deemed inevitable by many following Russia's gradual unification in the sixties. Though the invasion was met with condemnations from Tokyo and Germania, there seems to be little appetite in either capital to intervene in yet another war in the footsteps of the breakup of the USSR.

With this move, Russia has effectively established its own Monroe Doctrine and asserted itself in its own historical backyard. While unable to intervene, Pakt and CPS forces are nonetheless reinforcing their positions near Kazakhstan to deter future hostilities.

options.name: We must shore up our defenses in Kaukasien.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Great Central Asian Earthquake of [GetYear]
desc:
Thousands are feared dead following an earthquake with its epicenter near Kzyl-Orda in Kazakhstan. With tremors being felt well beyond the nation's borders, early reports by semiologists indicate that this is by far the most devastating earthquake to hit the region since 1911, a claim that's been disputed by Russian authorities.

This disaster has led to calls for the secretive Russian National Reclamation Government to open its airspace and allow aid into the war-torn region which was recently annexed by Russia following an invasion. The RNCG for its part has downplayed the severity of the event and reassured the international community that it has the situation under control and refused any form of what it sees as foreign meddling into its domestic affairs.

options.name: We can't hide this for long.
After more than three decades of war, haven't they endured enough?

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The RNRG invades Finland
desc:
Forces of the Russian National Reclamation Government have crossed the borders of the Republic of Finland today amid a heavy strategic bombing of Helsinki. In a statement from a spokesman for the Russian government in Omsk, the invasion is an overdue response to what it describes as Finland's systemic genocide against Russians since the state's independence in 1917 and declared that the Black League's intent is to bring Finland back under Russian control.

The international response to the invasion has been muted as Finland's allies deliberate on how to help the beleaguered Nordic state without the crisis escalating into a new general war in Europe. Finland fights alone as it finds itself in a death struggle against the irredentist Russian state.

options.name: Every inch of Russian territory must be reclaimed by the Motherland.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Sweden Intervenes In the Russo-Finnish War
desc:
Following the outbreak of the latest Russo-Finnish war, the government in Stockholm has declared its formal support for Helsinki by enforcing its 1942 defense pact. As of now, the government of Sweden is in a de facto state of war with Russia. The announcement was swiftly followed by the Greater German Reich pledging to let aid enter Finland through its Reichskommissariats without formally committing to sending troops to the conflict. In a joint message by defense officials from Sweden and Moskowien, these actions are meant to preserve European freedom against eastern totalitarianism.

With the war expanding, it's clear to international observers that this crisis is likely merely the first act in a greater war between Russia and Germany, this time fought on the soil of one of Germany's minor allies.

options.name: We will bury them alongside their Finnish cronies.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Helsinki Surrenders To the Black League
desc:
The surviving remnants of the now defunct Finnish government have offered their unconditional surrender to the government in Omsk, something that was all but a formality after the complete destruction of the Finnish state and the complete rout of its armed forces. Following the general collapse of the Finnish army in the most recent Russian breakthrough, Pakt-aligned forces have been evacuated from the country.

The government in Omsk has already declared that Finland is to be made to pay for its crimes against Russia, particularly in relation to its occupation of Karelia following WW2. As the Black League enacts a policy of harsh suppression and Russification in Finland, many see this conflict as merely the prelude to a new general war in eastern Europe.

options.name: Our revenge against the Finnish has only begun.
We were caught off-guard and must prepare for war.
Europe's youngest empire has ceased to exist altogether.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Finland Triumphant In Finno-Russian Hyperwar
desc:
The hyperwar between Russia and Finland reached its shocking conclusion today as the tiny Finnish army flushed out the last holdout of the Black League's forces in Siberia. The outcome of the war has been described as farcical with many observers claiming that the only explanation for this is God commanding it to happen and reality being forcibly bent as a result.

Whether the outcome was the result of divine intervention or strategic genius, most people now agree that Suur-Suomi will pick up the mantle as the liberator of Eurasia now that it has the Black League's nuclear arsenal at its fingertips. Whether the next Finnish hyperwar will be against Korea in the east or Germany in the west remains to be seen.

options.name: Our revenge against the Finnish has only begun.

title: Nuclear War Declared
desc:
The unthinkable has happened.

The Germans have called the Black League’s bluff and they have failed remarkably. As German soldiers began the March on Omsk proper, the Earth shook. Hundreds if not thousands of nuclear weapons shot out of their silos.

As they silently sit in orbit slowly making their way towards the German homeland, the Reich has started preparations to remove what they believe to be “stains” on the world map. Ladies and gentlemen, this will be the end of not only news reporting but the Earth as we know it.

Thank you for reading.

options.name: May holy flame cleanse the world!
The free world shall be protected!

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Terror Attacks Across the Reich
desc:
Across territories of the Reich, devastating terrorist attacks on key installments have taken place near simultaneously. In Germania, key government buildings were targeted by small explosives in just a matter of hours. In addition, other targets such as railroad junctions and Heer supply depots were also hit. The attacks are being particularly concentrated within the German Reichskommissariats.

The perpetrators have identified themselves as members of the "Army for Russian Liberation", who advocate for the return of former Russian lands to the Omsk-based Russian government. In turn, they have long decried Germany's treatment of the occupied Russian lands. Their cause has received consistent support from members
of the Organization of Free Nations, most notably the United States.

options.name: How will the Führer respond to this?

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Unternehmen Herbstdonner
desc:
In a move perhaps only unexpected to the Russians, Pakt forces have begun a massive counter-attack across the entire front, aimed at driving back Russian Black League forces from the Moscow frontier, German-held Ukraine, the Baltics, and Finland. Dubbed "Operation Autumn Thunder", the offensive has seemingly carried massive buildup and has involved, for perhaps the first time, almost complete coordination between Pakt air, ground, and sea assets working in tandem against the Black Leagues' Armies.

Caught completely off guard, it is rumored Russian formations have already begun to break, a rumor firmly denied by Russian High Command who state that whilst the counter-attack was unexpected, it will be "duly repulsed".

options.name: Chaos takes hold and Russia continues to burn...

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Plot Revealed
desc:
As the fury of The Great Trial casts its fiery cloak over all of Eastern Europe, photos and news leaks coming in from Russia show disturbing reports of Russian Glavkoverkh, Dimitry Yazov, disposing of several high ranking officials from both the military and civilian administration. While no official reason has been given as to why, analysts believe that the purges are due to Yazov’s dissatisfaction with the performance of the war in Europe, which has slowly grinded down to an impasse similar in vein to the First World War.

The purges seem to reach all echelons of the military and government, a scale which hasn’t been seen since Hitler’s Night of Long Knives. Officials from Germany state that this outcome was ‘expected from an adversary as savage as the Slav’. Meanwhile, Yazov expressed assurance that he simply is ensuring that his government is free of ‘influence from outside forces’.

options.name: They are all guilty of the unforgivable crime: failure.
They’re destroying themselves! Now is our time to strike!

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Great Mistrial
desc:
Years of fighting and countless millions of casualties on both sides has finally come to a close today with an exhaustive nuclear exchange between the Black League and the combined arsenals of the other superpowers. Although the German Reich has claimed nominal victory following a complete nuclear annihilation of Russia, it remains a pyrrhic triumph.

From the streets of Warsaw to the bunkers buried deep in the Urals, Eastern Europe lies in shambles. The exchange has brought countless cities to ruin and completely halted any sort of ground fighting. With [RUS.GetLeader] missing and presumed dead, many expect the Black League to face complete governmental collapse. Even though the German Reich still stands, it remains a husk of its former self. With hundreds of millions of dead across the world, and many more missing, the future for humanity is bleak.

options.name: For the madness of one, the world paid the price.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Fall of the Black League
desc:
The Great Trial has finally come to an end. After countless months of brutal warfare through Russia and countless millions of casualties, the flag of the Black League flies over Russia no more following the collapse of the League’s so-called National Redoubt. German soldiers breached the final line of fortified cities earlier this month and fought block by block, mountain by mountain to assert control over the Urals and what laid beyond them. As the last holdouts were captured, the Black League and its apocalyptic plans have fallen.

Even as [RUS.GetLeader]'s remains were identified in the ruins of Orsk and the Black League faces complete annihilation, the fight hasn't ended. Countless remnants of fanatic devotees of the former government have already established themselves across Russia. Although the Great Trial has come to an end, the war is far from over for Germany.

options.name: nihil vidi post me, et finem ante me vidi.
Eurasia breathes a sigh of relief.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Fall of the Black League
desc:
The Great Trial has finally come to an end. After countless months of brutal warfare through Russia and countless millions of casualties, flag of the Black League flies over Russia no more following the collapse of the League’s so-called National Redoubt. A joint OFN-CPS invasion force breached the final line of fortified cities earlier this month and fought inch-by-inch over the inhospitable Siberian wastes and what laid beyond them. As the last holdouts were captured, the Black League and its apocalyptic plans have fallen.

Even as [RUS.GetLeader]'s remains were identified in the ruins of Orsk and the Black League faces complete annihilation, the fight hasn't ended. Countless remnants of fanatic devotees of the former government have already established themselves across Russia. Although the Great Trial has come to an end, the war is far from over for Germany.

options.name: nihil vidi post me, et finem ante me vidi.
Eurasia breathes a sigh of relief.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The United States and Japan Declare War on the Black League
desc:
In a joint statement issued from the OFN and CPS military leadership, it was stated that military units from both Japan and the United States have begun operations against Black League. At dawn, tanks crossed the border between Manchuria and Siberia, marking another escalation in the ongoing war between Russia and Germany.

This comes after warnings issued from both Washington and Tokyo were addressed to the Russian government, calling for an end to the use of chemical and biological weapons throughout Europe. However, in an act of defiance against global pressures, Russia has refused to abide by international law. It seems that, once more, humanity has found itself in a global struggle against itself.

options.name: Perhaps there will be a war to end all wars...

title: [Get_newspaper_header]1976 Innsbruck Winter Olympics!
desc:
On 4 February 1976, the opening ceremony of the XII Winter Olympic Games took place in Innsbruck, Austria, accompanied by a unique "double flame" ceremony. This was the second time the Winter Games had been held in the city since 1964, and these Olympic Games were the first in history to be "saved" after the original host city, Denver, withdrew due to public opposition to the funding plans. In total, the Games brought together over 1000 athletes from 37 countries; ice dancing and the men's 2000-metre speed skating event featured in the programme for the first time.

In the medal table, Italy, with its professional skiers, led comfortably with 13 gold medals, followed by Switzerland, which won all five luge events. The guests were genuinely surprised by the little-known athletes from [RUS.GetName], who won five gold and silver medals to finish in third place. Host nation, [GER.GetName] came fifth, whilst its luge and alpine skiing athletes achieved outstanding results.

options.name: Twin flames etched legacy; ice and snow forged unity.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Ibuka Masaru Announces 'Police Reform Plan'!
desc:
Today, [GetDateText], news emerged from Kantou: Under the leadership of Fujitsu Limited's Ibuka Masaru, the State of Kantou - once a corporate state - officially announced plans to expand its police force. Kantou officials justified this as necessary 'due to unstable external conditions,' but astute observers recognize this as Ibuka safeguarding his engineers' paradise. When journalists inquired with the Chief Executive's office for reasons behind this move, they remained silent. Under this policy, the Kantou government is rapidly deploying advanced weaponry, with some institutions already receiving heavy equipment and an air force beginning to take shape.

Both Tokyo and Nanjing have declined to comment.

title: REPORT: BRAZILIAN SITUATION
desc:
REPORT MADE BY: ROSELDO FRAGA 

Dear president, We studied the situation in the Federative Republic of Brazil, We need to be very cautious, and not attack them (for now), but the tensions are growing, and that's bad for the world and for our continent as well. It can end very badly without warning, Mr. President remember that we are in a cold war againist Brazil and we need to win the majority of proxy conflicts. 

END OF REPORT.

options.name: Thank you for letting us know.

title: Rebuilding the Army
desc: My ideas are running out.

title: The Guido Administration
desc: Following the abrupt removal of Arturo Frondizi, José María Guido assumed the presidency under exceptional circumstances. Backed by the military and lacking a direct electoral mandate, his administration sought to preserve constitutional order while navigating a volatile political landscape. The suspension of elections and the balancing act between civilian governance and military influence defined his tenure.

options.name: A round of applause for President Guido

title: The Return of the Order
desc: After months of political uncertainty and the suspension of democratic processes, the government has managed to partially restore the country's institutional functioning. Although tensions have not disappeared, key administrative mechanisms have been reactivated and presidential authority has been strengthened. The population, still cautious, looks forward to the return of a more stable state structure.

options.name: At what cost will it be to do that?

title: The (controlled) elections of 1962
desc: With mounting pressure to restore democratic legitimacy, the government has agreed to hold national elections. However, key political factions remain banned from participating, and the military continues to exert influence over the electoral process. These elections are basically a little more rigid than normal, prohibiting the participation of the Federal Union, the Peronist Party and the Communist Party. In short: we've rickrolled the people

title: How Much We Attack?
desc:
Argentina is very unstable politically and this makes the military increasingly hungry for power, so it's your decision, dear player, how much do we attack?

Choose carefully, as the path you take can have both positive or negative consequences.

options.name: I'd better go with Frondizi (democratic path)
Perhaps with a bit of historical humor it can be understood (historic path)
Let's see if it's really as interesting as the game tells me (Poggi path)

title: The Attack
desc:
The country is at a crossroads. Three figures are emerging as potential leaders, each with their own vision for the future. Who will you follow?

the Arturo Frondizi's path is very interesing, with new crisis and focuses (is short for now), the Guido's path (the historical) that a little bit longer, Poggi's path (the most short of the paths). Choose whichever of these options you want.

title: Several blows. All military
desc:
Our nation is primarily known politically for its coups d'état. In 1930, José Uriburu overthrew constitutional president Hipolito Yrigoyen, establishing a dictatorship that lasted only two years. He was succeeded by Justo, a more conservative and less authoritarian president. In 1943, the GOU took over the country, overthrowing Ramón Castillo (Roberto María Ortiz's successor). No elections were held until 1946. Peron won, but the military grew increasingly distrustful of the new president, so much so that they staged their most recent coup d'état in 1955.

The risk of another coup d'etat is unnegable, the military are hungry of powertaking advantage of the national discontent.

title: Military Coup d'etat Attempt Failed
desc: On the contrary, as expected, the coup attempt has failed miserably. The military high command remains loyal to President Frondizi, and the rebellious officers have been arrested. The people, tired of constant instability, have expressed their support for the constitutional government. However, the situation remains tense, and the government must take measures to prevent future uprisings.

title: Meeting with Frondizi
desc:
President Frondizi sits across from a delegation of uniformed officers in the quiet of the Olivos residence. The air is heavy, the ticking of a clock the only sound between their measured words.

Their faces are stern, their voices cloaked in patriotic rhetoric, yet beneath the polished language lies a clear warning: the military’s patience is running thin. They speak of duty, of safeguarding the nation, but the undertone is unmistakable — the government’s authority is fragile, and time is slipping away.

Frondizi listens carefully, weighing each phrase, his mind racing through the precarious balance between democracy and the looming shadow of intervention. He knows that every gesture, every word in this room, may tip the scales of Argentina's future.

The meeting stretches on, a tense dance of veiled threats and cautious replies, until silence settles once more. In that silence, Frondizi realizes that this encounter is not merely a conversation, but a crossroads that could define the fate of his presidency.

options.name: I guess the government doesn't have much time left

title: Frondizi Administration (first term)
desc: after the fall of the colorados, the Frondizi's administration They have a free door for new elections, We were trolling the military so they don't reach the top of the power of Argentina, the Frondizi's term is on a good state for the elections for 1964

options.name: A New Dawn for our nation

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Frondizi survives the crisis
desc:
Today, recently in Argentina, something unexpected happened, a failed coup d'état led by the Argentine army, this caused the people to distrust the armed forces, making the Frondizi government continue in force. When President Arturo was reportedly kidnapped from the Casa Rosada for several hours on Tuesday morning, it appeared that he had finally been ousted. The subsequent hours brought about confusing reports about military activity, which was clarified the following day.

Frondizi, appearing to speak from the Campo de Mayo garrison west of Buenos Aires, claimed to have been forced to take action against a wide conspiracy, and thanked General Juan Carlos Onganía for his help in saving the government. A total cabinet reshuffle followed a few hours later, bringing about a government much more in line with Frondizi's personal views. Meanwhile, thousands of officers were reportedly detained and forcibly retired on the orders of General Onganía, apparently bringing an end to the prevailing crisis within the Army.

options.name: Muito obrigado, Frondizi, por salvar a democracia
Democracy (for now) is safe in South America
A stable Argentina serves our interests
Democracy (for now) is safe in South America

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Guido assumes power
desc: Political tensions finally erupted in Argentina. Under pressure from the military high command, Frondizi was forced to relinquish power. Amid an institutional vacuum, the interim president of the Senate, José María Guido, assumed the presidency and promised to stabilize the country. However, his legitimacy is questioned by much of the population and international actors.

options.name: Time will tell if this will last.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Raúl Poggi takes over Argentina
desc:
Political instability has reached its peak. After months of institutional crisis and popular distrust, General Raúl Poggi has executed a swift and effective coup d'état. The armed forces lined up behind him, and today, in a televised speech, Poggi declared himself president of the nation. He promises to restore order, morality, and Argentine greatness. The streets are silent. The world watches cautiously.

Never Gonna Give You Up, Never gonna let you down, Never gonna let you down. 

A victory for the democracy, and later we have elections for mantain Frondizi or a new candidate, this is a new reality.

options.name: I don't need it, I definitely don't need it

title: Skoropadskyi's Coup
desc:
Due to Oleksandr Ohloblyn's unpopular policies and obvious signs of collaboration with the nazis, in particular, aiding and abetting in racial cleansing-the mass extermination of the Jewish population during World War II in Babyn Yar-and his clear dictatorial tendencies, Danylo Skoropadskyi, a descendant of the last hetman of Ukraine, Pavlo Skoropadsky, with the support of the free Cossack troops and the direct assistance of Stus's United Struggle faction, arrested the elected president on suspicion of treason...

Exactly 46 years ago, on the night of April 29-30, 1918, Pavlo Skoropadskyi also staged a coup against an ineffective government to save Ukraine. It is a strange coincidence, but it seems that fate decided to give Ukraine a reliable pillar of support for society - a hetman.

Now only Danylo will decide the next years of an entire nation that has placed its trust in the hetman. Step by step, plan by plan, brick by brick, Ukraine will rise like a phoenix from the ashes of ruin. The UHS will surpass all other political forces in building a new, strong, globally important Ukrainian Hetmanate!

options.name: Glory to Hetmanate! Long Live Skoropadskyi!

title: Skoropadskyi Strikes Back!
desc:
Dziuba couldn't believe it. The situation had quickly spiraled out of his control. It was all over. He should have foreseen the consequences of starting repressions against the fascists. It was one thing when all failures could be blamed on the controversial Ohloblyn, but it was quite another when it came to a respected general in the army, a hero of the civil war, and Stus's right-hand man.

Taras Bulba-Borovets refused to submit to our repressive policy against despotism in the country, and together with Stus and Danylo Skoropadskyi, they formed a coalition, supported by 80% of our army, and are already demanding in front of the government building on Khreshchatyk in Kyiv that Ivan Dziuba renounce all presidential powers granted to him by the people.

If he agrees to the military's demands, he will face life-long house arrest somewhere in Bila Tserkva, but if he refuses, citing his right to continue performing presidential functions, he will be arrested and imprisoned.So he chose the path of freedom and voluntarily renounced the position of President of the Ukrainian People Republic.

However, when Stus arrived at the parliament to take the oath, Danylo Skoropadskyi appeared with loyal, well-armed units of the "Free Cossacks". He announced to the entire parliament that from now on he would become the Hetman-leader of the new Ukrainian Hetmanate, and anyone who did not agree with this would be immediately thrown out into the street and stripped of all ranks, like useless trash. The first to recognize the new Hetman was General Taras Bulba-Borovets, because he saw in him the energy and salvation that the Ukrainian land had been waiting for so long. Vasyl Stus agreed only on the condition that he be given the status of Prime Minister in the Hetmanate.

options.name: Ukraine was saved from socialism in time

title: The Fate of the Dniester and Bug Administration
desc:
It was a special report for Danylo Skoropadskyi, concerning Transnistria, or more precisely, the occupied part of Vinnytsia and the entire Odessa region, together with the former Moldovan autonomous region of Transnistria within the Ukrainian SSR.

Indeed, these ethnically Ukrainian lands are a strategic hub for trade on the Danube, and the port city of Odessa serves as the most important transport and trade hub in the Black Sea, the importance of which cannot be overestimated.In short, we have acquired a real territorial treasure, and now we are faced with the task of deciding the future fate of these lands right now.

There are two strategies that our ministers have encountered. This region, half destroyed by war, is teeming with rebellious Romanians, Moldovans, Germans, and Greeks who refuse to obey the new authorities. These minorities, which have grown in number over more than two decades of occupation, make up half of the region's population, and we will have to deal with them right now. In another scenario, we will pass these problems on to the Dniester and Bug Administrations so that they can persuade these settlers to live in peace and harmony with Ukrainians, or to move to Romania under the "suitcase-train station-Bucharest" program.

These two options are equally effective, and it is up to Hetman Danylo to decide whether it is better to assimilate the locals into our state and personally restore the region's economy, or to shift this burden onto our puppet government.

options.name: We Will Deal With Romanian Terrorism By Ourselves
Place These Problems on the Shoulders of the Local Administration

title: Final Full Integration of Transnistria
desc:
More than a year after the defeat of the Romanians and Germans in the Transnistrian Civil War, it seems that the local administration has finally managed to pacify the region. All that remains is to consolidate our success, restore the long-lost administrative and territorial apparatus by dividing the region into three provinces within the Hetmanate, and integrate local troops into the Armed Forces of Hetmanate.

Although a small number of Romanian terrorists still remain in the Transnistrian region, information about their cells and places of uncontrolled border crossing with Romania has been provided to us by loyal local residents and the local administration. We expect the region to finally calm down in the coming months.

It's time to build trade ties through Odessa. First, we'll get in touch with Turkey so they give us free passage for trade ships through the Bosphorus Strait, and also with the Italian-Egyptian protectorate so our ships can go through the Suez Canal. From now on, we're part of the global trading community!

options.name: The Port of Odesa Is Now Ukrainian

title: First Time In First Grade
desc:
It was a special and long-awaited day for Petro, because finally, after the reconstruction of the once prestigious elite school in Kyiv, which had been closed for several years, he could continue his education without hindrance.Thanks to the efforts of the local city administration, with state investment, a massive restoration of schools across the country has begun.

Galina, the boy's mother, packed the necessary school supplies into his backpack and gave him a generous allowance for the week to donate to further repairs and purchases of books, Ukrainian literature, and educational textbooks for the school. In these post-war times, decades of occupation have resulted in significant illiteracy among the local population. Although teachers were selected based on passing an exam demonstrating sufficient knowledge of their subject, especially fluency in the Ukrainian language, there were cases of teachers lacking experience compared to teachers in other European countries.Wishing him all the best, Galina asked her son to study so that his father would always be proud of him.

Due to traffic problems, the boy was late to the bus station and ended up being the last to arrive in class. All the other first-graders were already sitting at their desks, and the homeroom teacher was trying to keep the class quiet and orderly until the last pupil arrived. Carefully opening the door to the sunlit classroom and seeing his homeroom teacher, Oksana Volodymyrivna, the boy apologized for being late and expressed his gratitude that the others had waited for him. Oksana Volodymyrivna invited her last pupil to the center of the classroom and said; 

- "Childrens, this is your 14th and last classmate, Petro. Please treat him with respect, kindness, and honor so that our class becomes the friendliest group in our school!

options.name: After that, the Whole Class Eagerly Began to Befriend Petro

title: Support for ROA?
desc:
Since we are currently continuing to work closely with reformist nazis, why not use the same approach with other forces that have dealt with them in the past, such as the ROA(Russian Liberation Army)? At present, we do not have sufficient information about these reformers and do not know their motives, which poses the risk that they may deceive us and drive us into even greater dependence from Germania. At the same time, decisive opposition to their intentions will result in us losing the support of the german elite, so what should we do?

In fact, the hetman was not the only one in this position. ROA general Andrey Vlasov is also in similar conditions in the east, the leader of the russian warlord state, located mostly near Samara city, had to deal with germans most part of post-war period. Danylo, no matter how much he hated the bolsheviks, was ready to compromise with Russian collaborators at a time when it was so necessary for the Hetmanate. Although the general already had one foot in the grave, Vlasov sent a reply from his capital in Samara, agreeing to provide all the details of his flirtations over the years with all supporters of nazi ideology in exchange for comprehensive assistance.

The essence of the agreement is the permanent presence of the Hetmanate volunteer corps in case of wars by the ROA for the unification of Russia. As soon as the ROA unifies Russia, the Hetmanate will be able to recall the volunteer contingent back to Ukraine. In return, former Russian collaborators promise to immediately recognize Ukrainian Hetmanate independence and, after unification, to begin fruitful cooperation aimed at developing a non-german economic sphere of influence in Europe, Asia, and other countries. In addition to this, we should consider the benefits for our newly formed armed forces of studying mountain warfare in the Urals, warfare in the swamps and cold tundras of Siberia, and warfare in conditions of lack of infrastructure in the Far East of Russia.

In Danylo's personal opinion, russian wars for unification with the support of one of the most attractive forces for the hetmanist movement, the ROA, will be beneficial in the long term. Although there are fears in the government that after the death of Vlasov, his successor will not want to confront the Nazis and will ultimately refuse to fulfill the agreements after the unification of Russia. Now all that remains is to weigh all the options and make a final decision...

options.name: ROA are Soldiers, and They Don't Forget the Assistance Provided by Hetmanists During the Wars
The Russian Empires Have Always Acted Against Us, Nothing Will Change After Their Unification

title: Results of the Second Year of the "Breadbasket" Program
desc:
"The new year of our extremely useful program for society continues to develop and exceed our expectations from last year.

The time has come when our Ukrainian individual farmers are able to independently manage their farms and profit from them. Food produced on agricultural land, in villages, and in state cooperatives is sold on the market, and a significant percentage of these transactions goes to the budget. However, the costs of developing agricultural entrepreneurship are not low.

It's also impossible not to notice periodic monthly jumps in inflation, which isn't and won't be stable, so it is necessary to be cautious about investments, possibly limiting them for some time. The problem of increasing ukrainian consumption of grain crops and other foodstuffs is becoming more and more acute. The state's task is to at least maintain parity between food production and consumption, so that it is not necessary to purchase foreign products.

Despite the constant increase in annual consumption demands of the population, our economy continues to grow rapidly. Our ministry has prepared a new action program to combat inflation, but in return we will be forced to reduce state support for agricultural cooperatives."

- With respect to His Excellency the Hetman, Minister of the "BreadBasket" Program, Mykhailo Starozhetskyi.

options.name: "I Approve Your New Action Plan, Reduce Investments If Necessary..."

title: Results of the First Year of the "Breadbasket" Program
desc:
"The first year of consumer spending since the start of state subsidies for the ukrainian agricultural sector has passed, and the first results are already visible. According to statistics, we have improved agricultural production methods, increased our grain reserves, and it appears that they have almost covered all of our national needs.

However, the process of eliminating external influence on our domestic food security sector is still far from its logical conclusion. We hope that in a few years we will be able to fully and, most importantly, independently feed our large and ever-growing population, despite the restrictions of the Second Treaty of the Brest-Litowsk Agreement.

There are many other positive aspects of the state program "BreadBasket". The main one is the increase in local GDP in the regions, which contributes to the growth of the economic power and independence of the Hetmanate. In addition, we can highlight the creation of thousands of new jobs, mainly in villages, as well as the prospects for selling our products to our neighbors, and in a few years, to all of Europe and beyond!

However, we are currently facing difficulties in providing all our citizens with basic necessities, such as insufficient supply of products to remote areas, including Crimea, due to logistical problems. We recommend increasing the size of the garrison on the peninsula due to a new wave of "bread protests" by dissatisfied local radical germans over our prioritization of feeding ukrainians first." 

- With respect to His Excellency the Hetman, Minister of the "BreadBasket" Program, Mykhailo Starozhetskyi.
